fdroid:com.lorenzomarci.sosring.name: SOS Ring
fdroid:com.lorenzomarci.sosring.summary: Make VIP calls and messages audible even in Silent/DND
fdroid:com.lorenzomarci.sosring.description:
SOS Ring makes calls and supported direct messages from VIP contacts audible even if your phone is in Silent, Vibrate, or Do Not Disturb mode.
Perfect for families where someone always keeps their phone on silent but needs to be reachable in emergencies.
HOW IT WORKS:
• Add your VIP contacts (family, partner, etc.)
• Enable the monitoring service
• When a VIP contact calls, SOS Ring overrides Silent/DND mode, plays the ringtone at your chosen volume (25-100%), and vibrates
• Optionally pair their direct WhatsApp, SMS/RCS, or Telegram conversation and choose a separate message volume (5-100%) and sound
• After the alert ends, your phone is restored to its original state — silent mode, DND, volumes, everything
WHY THIS APP EXISTS:
Android 14+ removed per-contact DND exceptions. No built-in way exists to let specific contacts bypass silent mode. Google restricts READ_CALL_LOG on the Play Store, so this type of app can't be published there. SOS Ring is free, open source, and works where others can't.
FEATURES:
• Pick VIP contacts from your phonebook or enter manually; select any or all numbers for contacts with multiple numbers
• Configurable call override volume (25-100%)
• Sound from the first VIP call or the second within 3, 5 or 10 minutes, with per-number exceptions
• Optional volume doubling between successive calls when the base volume is below 50%, capped at 100%
• Optional VIP message alerts for WhatsApp, SMS/RCS (any default SMS app) and Telegram
• Separate message sound toggle, volume (5-100%), and Android default or VIP contact sound
• Works in Silent, Vibrate, AND Do Not Disturb mode
• Full state restore after call (including alarm volume)
• Quiet Hours and the temporary mute timer stop both call and message overrides
• Survives phone reboots (auto-start)
• Minimal battery usage (event-driven, no polling)
• Dark mode support
• No ads or tracking
REPEATED CALLS:
The default remains the first call. Choose the mode in Settings, Home or each VIP's menu. Only distinct cellular calls from the same number count; answering or pausing resets the sequence. The window does not slide. Messages do not count and stay silent during cellular calls. Pending counts use local hashed identifiers, expire within the window and are excluded from exports. See the README for details.
LOCATION SHARING (optional, peer-to-peer):
• No SOS Ring server required — you pick a UnifiedPush distributor app (e.g. ntfy on F-Droid); it relays only encrypted data
• End-to-end encrypted using Web Push encryption; the distributor never sees your location
• Each message is signed with a per-device key in the Android Keystore, so the recipient can verify the sender
• Pairing is explicit via QR code — no automatic connections
• Location sharing is off by default per contact; you control who can see your location
• Live tracking streams your position roughly every 10 seconds for a chosen duration, shown on an OpenStreetMap map in the app
• Tracked path is saved locally on the requester's device only — no data leaves without your explicit action
• No server, no analytics, no tracking
PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED:
• Phone State & Call Log: detect incoming calls and identify the caller
• Contacts: pick VIP contacts from your phonebook
• Notification access (optional): identify paired direct conversations; message text is never stored, and conversation identifiers are saved only as hashes
• Do Not Disturb access: override DND when a VIP calls
• Notifications: show a small persistent notification while monitoring
• Location (including background): used only to answer location requests from paired contacts you explicitly authorized, even while the app is not on screen; nothing is collected or sent otherwise
SOURCE CODE: https://github.com/JackRushante/SOSRing

fdroid:com.qfs.pagan.name: Pagan
fdroid:com.qfs.pagan.description:
Pagan is a mobile-first music sequencer. Instead of taking what works in a desktop setup and trying to smoosh that into a pocket-size interface, Pagan was made from the ground up - all-the-while reconsidering what is intrinsic to music and what is an artifact of systems created while numeracy was still considered heretical.
======== No staves, No piano-roll, No keyboard ========
 No need to learn an entirely new interface to input archaic glyphs and scribbles. No need to filter your music through C Major by introducing a piano. Notes are just numbers. What's more intuitive to calculate? How many semi-tones between A and C# or how many steps between 0 and 4?
============= Bring Your Own Soundfonts ===============
 Pagan uses .sf2 soundfonts so you're not limited to factory settings. Do you want to use the synth from one soundfont but the drums from another? No problem! You can load multiple at once.
==================== Midi Support =====================
 Play your creations through your favourite midi device or import, reorchestrate and export .mid files. 
========== Polyrhythm and Stepless Sequencing =========
 Have you ever been working on a step sequencer only to need to get out Euler's method to calculate a polyrhythm? With Pagan, you don't set a step count, you just divide the beats up however you want.
==== Microtonality and Variable-Temperament Tuning ======
 Have you ever wanted to play with more than 12 tones? Have you ever wondered what 16 or 21 tone equal temperament tuning sounds like? Pagan defaults to the familiar 12, but can be easily changed to any number you want.
====================== Exporting ======================
 It wouldn't be useful if you couldn't share your creations. Pagan can export a project into either a single .wav file or separate each line or channel for further processing.
=============== Made without genAI. ===================
 Music is an expression of human experience. Our instruments should be too. Pagan was (and always will be) made entirely **WITHOUT** the use of chatbots (or generative AI of any ilk). Nor will it ever introduce generative functionality.

fdroid:com.wmstein.tourcount.name: TourCount
fdroid:com.wmstein.tourcount.summary: A butterfly monitoring app for species-specific registering of butterflies in Eu
fdroid:com.wmstein.tourcount.description:
TourCount supports species-specific and individually GPS-localized registering of butterflies. 
New in Version 3.8.4:
- Code improvements
- Entering individuals notes proposed by predefined wordings like "Photo", "Flyby", "Fresh imago", …
- Entering species notes proposed by the predefined wordings "New species", "1st in season" and "Not sure"
- Cloud %-values rounded to multiples of 10
- More restrictive plausi for input of metadata numbers
- "Help" text updated
- Docs updated
- Bugfix for importing a species list
Features:
- Data recording is organized for a regional tour with its expected butterfly species.
- Databases can be individually created and adapted within the app regarding metadata and expected butterfly species.
- The app has an internal pool of many European species and comes with a prepared basic database with the most common species in Europe as a starting point for direct use.
- Separate counters for ♂-♀-indeterminate, ♂, ♀, pupa, larva or egg.
- You may use an individual species list per region.
- Results are prepared for easy readout to transfer them to the science4you entry mask for butterfly registration.
- The results can be exported in formatted XLSX or CSV format, as well as in an SQLite database file (e.g. to transfer them to a PC, for easier reading in a spreadsheet program, or for further processing).
- Help contains a detailed userguide.
- TourCount supports counting in German, English, French, Italian and Spanish language and provides locale species names in these languages.
Functions:
- Editor for metadata in preparation for an inspection
- Counter page with scroll-down list for species selection
- Editor for individual species data of a count (e.g. status, remark or bulk count entry).
- The app automatically inserts date, time, coordinates and height as well as location data by reverse OSM-geocoding provided that GPS and internet are accessible.
- The app provides functions to add, delete or edit the species for the current species list.
- The results page shows metadata, notes, totals and counting results per species.
Prerequisites:
The app requires permits for
- storage access for importing and exporting counting data, species lists and results,
- reading location data by GPS for coordinates and location info per counted individual,
- internet access for OpenStreetMap reverse geocoding requests (locality info) and
- preventing the sleep mode.
The smartphone screen should have a minimum resolution of 1920 x 1024 pixels. 
The app is usable with Android version 11 or newer.
Documentation is provided under 
https://github.com/wistein/TourCount/tree/master/docs.
TourCount is one of two apps for European butterfly monitoring. 
The 2nd app, TransektCount serves transect counters on their inspection walks. It supports species-specific counting of butterflies per transect section according to the European Butterfly Monitoring Scheme method.
Both apps use the coding scheme of Karsholt/Razowski for European butterflies and thus contain only European butterflies.

fdroid:org.keyoxide.keyoxide.name: Keyoxide
fdroid:org.keyoxide.keyoxide.summary: Verify decentralized cryptographic identities on the go
fdroid:org.keyoxide.keyoxide.description:
A modern, secure and privacy-friendly platform to establish your decentralized online identity
Keyoxide allows you to prove “ownership” of accounts on websites, domain names, IM, etc., regardless of your username.
That last part is important: you could, for example, be ‘alice’ on Lobste.rs, but ‘@alice24’ on Twitter.
And if your website is ‘thatcoder.tld’, how are people supposed to know that all that online property is yours?
Of course, one could opt for full anonymity! In which case, keep these properties as separated as possible.
But if you’d like these properties to be linked and, by doing so, establish an online identity, you’ll need a clever solution.
Enter Keyoxide.
When you visit someone’s Keyoxide profile and see a green tick next to an account on some website,

WHAT IT COSTS

NOTHING TO HAND OVER

Dario was designed with convenience in mind, to make it easier to see your medical trends and help build healthy new habits according to your results. With insights gained through the Dario app, you may learn which foods and activities lead to better results. You may see how following a treatment plan improves your blood pressure results. Getting this positive reinforcement in real-time can be a powerful motivator! One drop is all it takes to see where you stand with this innovative diabetes tracker.

Keep your medical care providers and family members up to date on your diabetic measurements. You can share all the data and logbooks inside the Dario application with anyone you like. Simply tap the share icon and select a contact from your address book to share your data instantly.
COUNT CARBS & TRACK ACTIVITY
Any diabetic knows how challenging it can be to keep track of carbohydrate intake. Dario does the math for you. Simply tag which foods you ate, and Dario will automatically calculate how many carbs that gave you. With time, you may even start spotting patterns between the foods you’ve eaten and your blood glucose results and learn how to choose foods that your body responds to better. The same goes for activity. With Dario, you can keep track of your daily exercise (even washing the dishes!) and see if it influences your blood glucose levels. The results of this diabetes tracker may surprise you!
HOW ACCURATE IS DARIO?
Dario has been tested extensively to ensure it meets FDA guidance for accuracy, that 95% of measurements are within ±15% of a true lab-tested value. This means you can be assured that the Dario meter will provide results you can trust. Dario has also presented several studies to the ADA, demonstrating how its system can help improve life for people living with diabetes.
HYPO ALERT SYSTEM WITH GPS LOCATOR
Hypo alerts may save your life! If you have diabetes and have suffered from hypo events in the past, or have a child with diabetes, Dario's hypo alert system with GPS location can help bring you peace of mind. Simply connect the Dario meter to your smartphone, and upon recording a dangerously low glucose reading in one drop of blood, the Dario app will prepare a complete text message, including current blood glucose level and GPS location, to send to up to 4 emergency contacts. apple-macos:6761128465.name: Flux News Reader
apple-macos:6761128465.description:
Flux News is the native Miniflux reader for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Built entirely in SwiftUI — not a cross-platform port or web wrapper — it looks and feels at home on every Apple device, and brings a fast, focused reading experience to the self-hosted RSS server you already control.
Connect once with your Miniflux server address and API key. Your feeds, folders, stars, and read state stay in sync across all your devices — no third-party cloud, no account to create, no tracking.
DEEP MINIFLUX INTEGRATION
• Manage everything Miniflux offers from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac — no web interface needed
• Edit each feed's Miniflux rules: scraper rules, rewrite rules with a built-in rule builder, URL rewrites, and block and keep filters
• Per-feed fetch options: full-content crawler, user agent, cookies, HTTP authentication, proxy, and more
• Add feeds with discovery, organise folders, and import or export OPML
• Refresh feeds on the server, flush history, and save articles to your Miniflux integrations
• Read state, stars, folders, and unread counts sync both ways through Miniflux itself
A REAL MAC APP
• Designed for macOS, not adapted from iPad: native menu bar, Settings window, resizable windows, and widgets
• Keyboard-first reading: J/K next and previous, M read/unread, B star, O open in browser, ⌘R refresh, ⌘K mark all as read
• One free download covers iPhone, iPad, and Mac
FAST AND OFFLINE
• Opens instantly to your feeds — even before syncing
• Read everything offline; mark, star, and save without a connection and changes sync when you're back online
• Search your articles instantly on device
READING, YOUR WAY
• Newspaper, List, and Topics layouts
• Clean article view with optional full-content fetch
• 10 fonts including New York, Charter, Georgia, Iowan Old Style, and Palatino
• 7 themes including Sepia, Midnight, OLED Dark, and two high-contrast themes, with light, dark, and automatic modes
• Inline YouTube, podcasts, and video, with AirPlay and Now Playing controls
SMART, ON-DEVICE INTELLIGENCE
• Articles are automatically tagged by topic with Apple Intelligence — browse tags just like folders
• Bullet-point summaries of any article, even long reads
• Everything runs on your device; article text never leaves it
LISTEN TO YOUR ARTICLES
• Read aloud with system voices, or natural ElevenLabs voices using your own key
• Background playback with lock screen and headphone controls
MADE FOR EACH DEVICE
• iPhone: swipe between feeds, articles, and the reader; pull to refresh; home and lock screen widgets; share extension to add feeds from Safari
• iPad: side-by-side split view with keyboard support
• Mac: menu bar, keyboard shortcuts, and widgets
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads
• Connects only to your Miniflux server
• Send feedback from Settings (or the Help menu on Mac) — it includes app and OS versions, never your server address or API key
REQUIREMENTS
• A Miniflux server — self-hosted, or a hosted account at miniflux.app
• iOS 17, iPadOS 17, or macOS 14 or later
• Tagging and summaries require iOS 26 or macOS 26 on an Apple Intelligence–capable device
Flux News is an independent app and is not affiliated with the Miniflux project.

apple-macos:1436522307.name: Transmit 5
apple-macos:1436522307.description:
The gold standard of macOS file transfer apps just drove into the future. Transmit 5 is here. Upload, download, and manage files on tons of servers with an easy, familiar, and powerful UI. Transmit 5 has…
MORE SERVERS.
Transmit now connects to 11 new cloud services, like Backblaze B2, Box, Google Drive, DreamObjects, Dropbox, Microsoft Azure, and Rackspace Cloud Files.
And yes, Transmit still handles the classics — FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, and S3 — better than any. We make complex services drag-and-drop simple.
MORE SYNC.
Transmit 5 now includes Panic Sync, our secure and fast way to sync your sites. And our robust File Sync feature adds support for local-to-local and remote-to-remote sync, while also giving you more fine-grained control.
MORE SPEED.
We disassembled Transmit’s engine and rebuilt it, again, to significantly boost speed. T5 is better at multithreading and smarter about complex folders. Plus it’s got a new activity view to better focus on what Transmit is doing right now. It’s very fast.
MUCH MORE.
- Get Info Sidebar. Inspect items as you browse, right in the browser.
- Batch Rename. Powerful, flexible, and built-in for local or remote.
- Places Bar. Jump to your favorite folders with a single click.
- Keys. Manage and generate secure keys right in Transmit.
- Tags
- Local-local sync
- 2-Factor Login
- Open in Terminal
- Brand New UI
- Extra Large Amazon S3 File Support
- And So Much More
We hope you enjoy using Transmit. Hit us up anytime if you have any ideas on how to make it even better!
SUBSCRIPTION INFO.

• After 7 days, you'll automatically be billed $24.99/year (or the equivalent in your country) through an auto-renewing subscription.

• You can cancel your subscription at any time. If you do, once you reach the end of your subscription period, the app will no longer function. But your data will not be deleted from the app, or from Panic Sync. Simply restart your subscription at any time to use Transmit again.

fedora-packages:bmap-tools/bmap-tools.description: Bmaptool is a generic tool for creating the block map (bmap) for a file and copying files using the block map. The idea is that large files, like raw system image files, can be copied or flashed a lot faster and more reliably with bmaptool than with traditional tools, like dd or cp. fedora-packages:ctpl/ctpl.description: CTPL is a template library written in C. It allows fast and easy parsing of templates from many sources (including in-memory data and local and remote streaming, thanks to GIO) and fine control over template parsing environment. CTPL has following features: * It is a library, then it can be easily used from programs * Separated lexer and parser * It is written in portable C * Simple syntax * Fast and strict parsing * Possible in-memory parsing, allowing non-file data parsing and avoiding I/O-latency, through GIO's GMemoryInputStream and GMemoryOutputStream

fedora-packages:cvc5/cvc5.description: CVC5 is a tool for determining the satisfiability of a first order formula modulo a first order theory (or a combination of such theories). CVC5 is intended to be an open and extensible SMT engine. It can be used as a stand-alone tool or as a library. It has been designed to increase the performance and reduce the memory overhead of its predecessors.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-ext-superscript
fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that converts `^superscript^` syntax into `<sup>superscript</sup>`.

Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that converts references that are wrapped in `[[]]` into wiki links with optional text separated by `|`. Optional syntax to convert `![[]]` to image links is available.

fedora-packages:ghc-bytestring-trie/ghc-.description: An efficient finite map from bytestrings to values. The implementation is based on big-endian patricia trees, like "Data.IntMap". We first trie on the elements of "Data.ByteString" and then trie on the big-endian bit representation of those elements. Patricia trees have efficient algorithms for union and other merging operations, but they're also quick for lookups and insertions. If you are only interested in being able to associate strings to values, then you may prefer the 'hashmap' package which is faster for those only needing a map-like structure. This package is intended for those who need the extra capabilities that a trie-like structure can offer (e.g., structure sharing to reduce memory costs for highly redundant keys, taking the submap of all keys with a given prefix, contextual mapping, extracting the minimum and maximum keys, etc.).

fedora-packages:ghc-generic-deriving/ghc.name: ghc-generic-deriving
fedora-packages:ghc-generic-deriving/ghc.summary: Generic programming library for generalised deriving
fedora-packages:ghc-generic-deriving/ghc.description: This package provides functionality for generalising the deriving mechanism in Haskell to arbitrary classes. It was first described in the paper: * /A generic deriving mechanism for Haskell/. Jose Pedro Magalhaes, Atze Dijkstra, Johan Jeuring, and Andres Loeh. Haskell'10. The current implementation integrates with the new GHC Generics. See <http://www.haskell.org/haskellwiki/GHC.Generics> for more information. Template Haskell code is provided for supporting older GHCs. This library is organized as follows: * "Generics.Deriving.Base" defines the core functionality for GHC generics, including the 'Generic(1)' classes and representation data types. On modern versions of GHC, this simply re-exports "GHC.Generics" from 'base'. On older versions of GHC, this module backports parts of "GHC.Generics" that were not included at the time, including 'Generic(1)' instances. * "Generics.Deriving.TH" implements Template Haskell functionality for deriving instances of 'Generic(1)'. * Educational code: in order to provide examples of how to define and use "GHC.Generics"-based defaults, this library offers a number of modules which define examples of type classes along with default implementations for the classes' methods. Currently, the following modules are provided: "Generics.Deriving.Copoint", "Generics.Deriving.ConNames", "Generics.Deriving.Enum", "Generics.Deriving.Eq", "Generics.Deriving.Foldable", "Generics.Deriving.Functor", "Generics.Deriving.Monoid", "Generics.Deriving.Semigroup", "Generics.Deriving.Show", "Generics.Deriving.Traversable", and "Generics.Deriving.Uniplate". It is worth emphasizing that these modules are primarly intended for educational purposes. Many of the classes in these modules resemble other commonly used classes—for example, 'GShow' from "Generics.Deriving.Show" resembles 'Show' from 'base'—but in general, the classes that 'generic-deriving' defines are not drop-in replacements. Moreover, the generic defaults that 'generic-deriving' provide often make simplifying assumptions that may violate expectations of how these classes might work elsewhere. For example, the generic default for 'GShow' does not behave exactly like 'deriving Show' would. If you are seeking "GHC.Generics"-based defaults for type classes in 'base', consider using the '<http://hackage.haskell.org/package/generic-data generic-data>' library. * "Generics.Deriving.Default" provides newtypes that allow leveraging the generic defaults in this library using the 'DerivingVia' GHC language extension. * "Generics.Deriving" re-exports "Generics.Deriving.Base", "Generics.Deriving.Default", and a selection of educational modules.

firefox-addons:2953074.name: Video Speed Controller
firefox-addons:2953074.summary: Use the keyboard to control online video/audio playback speed, perfect support for Youtube.
firefox-addons:2953074.description:
Use the keyboard to control online video/audio playback speed, perfect support for Youtube. It control video speed up, slow down, advance and rewind with shortcuts.
Faster HTML5 Video
HTML5 video provides a native API to accelerate playback of any video. The problem is many players either hide or limit this functionality. For the best results, playback speed adjustments should be easy and frequent to match the pace and content being covered: we don't read at a fixed speed, and similarly, we need an easy way to accelerate the video, slow it down, and quickly rewind the last point to listen to it a few more times.
Once the extension is installed simply navigate to any page that offers HTML5 video ( example ), and you'll see a speed indicator in top left corner. Hover over the indicator to reveal the controls to accelerate, slowdown, and quickly rewind or advance the video. Or, even better, simply use your keyboard:
 S - decrease playback speed.
 D - increase playback speed.
 R - reset playback speed.
 Z - rewind video by 10 seconds.
 X - advance video by 10 seconds.
 V - show/hide controller.
You can customize and reassign the default shortcut keys in the extensions settings page as well as add additional shortcut keys to match your preferences. As an example, you can assign multiple "preferred speed" shortcuts with different values, allowing you to quickly toggle between your most frequently used speeds. To add a new shortcut, open extension settings and click "Add New".
Unfortunately, some sites may assign other functionality to one of the shortcut keys - this is inevitable. As a workaround, the extension listens both for lower and upper case values (i.e. you can use Shift-<shortcut> ) if there is other functionality assigned to the lowercase key. This is not a perfect solution since some sites may listen to both, but it works most of the time.

bluejetty:00177897:ios.description:
Bibi ABC has arrived — the simple and fun way for your child to learn the alphabet!
The games in the app are designed to help your child get familiar with both writing and reading. Through lots of engaging educational activities, kids will start recognizing and memorizing letters with ease.
All the games are simple and perfectly suited for preschoolers. Children can also hear the correct pronunciation of each letter in different languages, thanks to the helpful audio.
In this amazing adventure, the Super Bibi.Pets will be right there with you — guiding your child through every letter of the alphabet!
Key Features:
* Learn to recognize and memorize the alphabet
* Step-by-step introduction to writing letters
* Audio pronunciation of every letter in your chosen language
* Designed for children ages 2 to 6
* Writing and reading letters has never been easier
* Packed with fun educational activities that encourage learning
--- Recognizing the Letters ---
The first stage — recognizing letters — is quick and easy thanks to playful, engaging activities made just for preschoolers. Each letter has its own Super Bibi, and by interacting with the letters again and again, kids naturally memorize both how they look and how they sound.
--- Writing the Letters ---
With our simple, intuitive interface, children can learn to trace letters step by step, following the right technique and practicing just the movements they need. This way, kids build confidence in writing, making it easier to move on to small letters and joined-up writing later on.
--- Designed for Little Ones ---
* Absolutely no ads
* Created to entertain children from ages 2 to 6 — from toddlers to big kids!
* Simple game rules, so children can play alone or with parents
* Perfect for preschool and nursery age
* Lots of fun sounds and interactive animations
* No reading required — great for pre-readers, too!
* Lovable characters for both boys and girls
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Who Are We — Bibi.Pet ---
We create games for our own kids — it’s our passion! All Bibi.Pet games are carefully designed for little ones, with no third-party ads to get in the way of play.
Many of our games offer free trial versions, so you can test them out before you buy — helping us keep developing new games and updating all our apps.
Our collection covers everything from colors and shapes, to dress-up, dinosaurs, games for girls, mini-games for toddlers, and many more fun and educational adventures — come try them all!
Thank you to all the families who trust Bibi.Pet!

The games in the app are designed to help your child get familiar with both writing and reading. Through lots of engaging educational activities, kids will start recognizing and memorizing letters with ease.

All the games are simple and perfectly suited for preschoolers. Children can also hear the correct pronunciation of each letter in different languages, thanks to the helpful audio.

In this amazing adventure, the Super Bibi.Pets will be right there with you — guiding your child through every letter of the alphabet!

Key Features:

* Learn to recognize and memorize the alphabet
* Step-by-step introduction to writing letters
* Audio pronunciation of every letter in your chosen language
* Designed for children ages 2 to 6
* Writing and reading letters has never been easier
* Packed with fun educational activities that encourage learning

--- Recognizing the Letters ---

The first stage — recognizing letters — is quick and easy thanks to playful, engaging activities made just for preschoolers. Each letter has its own Super Bibi, and by interacting with the letters again and again, kids naturally memorize both how they look and how they sound.

--- Writing the Letters ---

With our simple, intuitive interface, children can learn to trace letters step by step, following the right technique and practicing just the movements they need. This way, kids build confidence in writing, making it easier to move on to small letters and joined-up writing later on.

--- Designed for Little Ones ---

* Absolutely no ads
* Created to entertain children from ages 2 to 6 — from toddlers to big kids!
* Simple game rules, so children can play alone or with parents
* Perfect for preschool and nursery age
* Lots of fun sounds and interactive animations
* No reading required — great for pre-readers, too!
* Lovable characters for both boys and girls

--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---

Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.

• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use

--- Who Are We — Bibi.Pet ---

We create games for our own kids — it’s our passion! All Bibi.Pet games are carefully designed for little ones, with no third-party ads to get in the way of play.

Many of our games offer free trial versions, so you can test them out before you buy — helping us keep developing new games and updating all our apps.

Our collection covers everything from colors and shapes, to dress-up, dinosaurs, games for girls, mini-games for toddlers, and many more fun and educational adventures — come try them all!

Thank you to all the families who trust Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00160796:ios.description:
Guess in 10 is a fun educational game for kids of all ages - Learn about Animals, Dinosaurs, Countries and more in the most exciting way possible!
Guess in 10 offers children 10+ unique themes, all in one app! Get Guessing, Get Smarter!
5 Star - "It's a hit! Kids in my after school program can’t get enough of this game.", "Fun way for the whole family to test their animal knowledge and to even learn something new." - Amazon Customers
Guess in 10 is a global bestseller with over 20,000 great reviews on Amazon. We are thrilled to launch the digital version of Guess in 10. Families can now get instant access to new decks at lower prices, access enhanced gameplay modes and enjoy the flexibility to play anytime, anywhere! The app comes with 10+ unique themes including Animals, Dinosaurs, States of America, and Countries - each containing 50 game cards that are filled to the brim with facts, figures and gorgeous artworks.
Guess in 10 is the perfect way for children to build skills and expand their general knowledge while taking on each other in a test of strategy and intelligence. 
SUPER SIMPLE GAMEPLAY - Divide yourselves up in teams, ask up to 10 questions and try to guess your opponent’s Game Card. It's that simple!
STRATEGIZE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY - Make use of exciting features such as Clue Cards and Bonus Questions to plan your way to winning 7 cards. First to 7 cards wins it all
HUNDREDS OF FUN CARDS - Guess in 10 includes over 500+ unique cards that are spread across 10 game sets such as Animals, Dinosaurs, Countries, Landmarks, Sports and much more! Each set will have you thinking and guessing your way to winning while you learn about an array of topics that will turn you into a human encyclopedia!
BUILDS CRITICAL SKILLS - Guess in 10’s age appropriate content and gameplay focuses on building key skills in young learners such as Communication, Decision Making, Problem Solving and Creative Thinking!
FUN FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY! - This is the most exciting game you’ll find for Family Game Night, filled with amazing content that can be thoroughly enjoyed by all ages – from 6 to 99!
MIX IT UP AS YOU GET BETTER - Guess in 10 lets you change everything about the game to make it easier or harder. Want to play with only 3 questions and no clue cards? Best of luck and yes, you can!
PLAY WITH CHARACTERS YOU LOVE! - Guess in 10 is loaded with Avatars that you can pick and choose from, so you can play with the one you love!

bluejetty:00096562:android.description:
🎋 Welcome to Joy Mahjong: A Fresh Twist on Tile-Matching!
Immerse yourself in a serene puzzle experience where classic matching meets innovative gameplay. Connect mahjong-themed tiles to clear the board while mastering a dynamic shifting mechanic that brings new challenges with every move.
🀄 How to Play
Pair two identical tiles to remove them
Clear all tiles to complete each level
Watch the board shift after each match, unveiling fresh opportunities
🎴 Unique Gameplay
After every match, the board slides in a fixed direction, drawing new tiles toward the center. Your strategy shapes the upcoming layout—every move influences the next!
**✨ Key Highlights
🎍 Evolving Challenges**: The layout transforms with every match.
🎎 Tranquil Aesthetics: Elegant mahjong art and soothing ambient sounds.
💡 Smart Aids: Use hints and reshuffle tools to overcome tricky layouts.
🀇 Perfect For You If...
You love strategic puzzles with a calming vibe! Download Joy Mahjong now and embark on a mindful matching journey!

bluejetty:00089566:ios.summary:

Created by conscious parents, StoryNest offers famili
bluejetty:00089566:ios.description:
StoryNest is a calm, screen-free audio app for children ages 3–9, filled with 750+ beautiful stories and songs from award-winning storytellers, musicians, and creators around the world.
Created by conscious parents, StoryNest offers families something increasingly hard to find: children’s media you can genuinely feel good about.
No ads. No addictive feeds. No overstimulating videos competing for your child’s attention. Just wonderful stories and songs, thoughtfully chosen to nurture imagination, inspire wonder, and bring more calm and connection into everyday family life.
STORIES THAT GIVE IMAGINATION ROOM TO GROW
When children listen to a story, they become part of creating it.
They imagine the characters, build faraway places in their minds, and wonder what might happen next. In a world where so much is shown to children on a screen, audio storytelling leaves something precious untouched: room for their own imagination.
Discover magical adventures, funny tales, gentle bedtime stories, animals and nature, meaningful life lessons, beautiful music, and much more — all carefully selected with young listeners in mind.
MORE CONNECTION. LESS SCROLLING.
StoryNest fits naturally into the rhythms of real family life.
Listen together on a long car ride. Put on a story while your child draws, builds, or rests. Create a peaceful quiet-time ritual. Curl up and listen together, or let a gentle story help everyone slow down as bedtime approaches.
And when you need a little time to yourself, StoryNest gives children something engaging they can enjoy independently — without handing them another screen.
A CALMER KIND OF CHILDREN’S MEDIA
Today’s children are surrounded by stimulation — fast-moving screens, autoplay, advertising, and content designed to keep their attention.
We wanted to create something different.
The simple act of listening invites children to slow down, focus inward, and become absorbed in a story at their own pace.
StoryNest can become a trusted companion for car rides, quiet afternoons, creative play, transitions, bedtime, travel, and everyday moments when your family needs a gentler pace.
CREATED BY PARENTS, FOR FAMILIES
We built StoryNest because it was something we wished existed for our own children.
We wanted an alternative to screen time we could actually trust — without advertising or the worry of what our children might encounter next.
Every storyteller and collection in StoryNest is intentionally selected by our team. We seek out stories filled with imagination, beauty, humour, kindness, courage, adventure, wonder, and heart.
Our goal isn’t to capture more of your child’s attention. It’s to nourish childhood.
REAL STORIES. REAL ARTISTS. REAL VALUES.
Our growing library brings together real storytellers, authors, musicians, and independent creators from around the world, including award-winning artists whose stories and songs have delighted generations of children.
FEATURES
• 750+ audio stories and songs for ages 3–9
• Award-winning storytellers, musicians & creators
• 100% ad-free listening
• Thoughtfully curated by conscious parents
• New stories and songs added regularly
• Offline downloads for car rides, flights & travel
• Age filtering to find the perfect stories
• Listen across supported mobile, tablet & desktop devices
WORDS FROM REAL STORYNEST FAMILIES
“Our family LOVES StoryNest!”
“We look forward to getting in the car to listen — sometimes finding ourselves at our destination yet unable to exit the car because we just have to finish the story!”
— Amy F
“My kids just LOVE it... I LOVE that there is no advertising and I don’t have to worry about the messages they are being sold.”
— Rebecca W
Childhood is short. We believe the stories children hear, the worlds they imagine, and the quiet moments families share together matter.
Real stories. Real artists. Real imagination.

bluejetty:00061462:ios.summary:

Maintain the same 360° contro
bluejetty:00061462:ios.description:
The official NetSuite for iPhone app enables unparalleled access to the World’s #1 Cloud Business Software Suite – the unified business management suite, encompassing ERP / financials, CRM, HCM and ecommerce. 
Maintain the same 360° control of your business as you do from your PC with this free app. Works out-of-the-box with all standard roles including Employee, Standard and Custom Center (Customer, Vendor and Partner Center roles are not supported).
Stand out features include:
- Full Record support – view, create, and edit records including Custom records.
- Complete Dashboard Access - Access and synchronize all your personalized dashboards from the web, encompassing KPI metrics, Scorecards, Trend Graphs, Report Snapshots, and any other dashboard content.
- Record customization support – all existing customizations including custom forms, fields and scripts work out-of-the-box.
- Expense management – track your expenses using the Expense Log (including receipt capture), then create an Expense Report with just a few taps.
- Time Management – track your time using the convenient Timer and My Time functions, create Time Entries directly into NetSuite.
- Complete Activity management – Manage your calendar across list, week and month views. View other calendars including fellow employees.
- Business action support – approve Sales Orders and Expense Reports, convert Estimates, accept Customer Payments, bill Sales Orders and more.
- Saved Search support – get all the results and drill down to record level using any existing Saved Search (including Summary types).
- Swipe Actions – simply swipe to map customer locations, initiate phone calls, respond to events or quickly start Editing.
- Localization – instantly adapts to your NetSuite language setting.
- Time Zone Synchronization, Global Search, Quick Add, Recent Records and loads more.
- Push Notifications – have NetSuite instantly notify you of any changes to business critical information.
Note: Users with Custom roles may require Mobile Device Access permission to log in. For further information, please contact NetSuite Technical Support.

bluejetty:00177441:ios.description:
Add bright mood and colors to your social media feed!
Feel the freedom of action! Create atmospheric and memorable photo collages in a few seconds.
Experiment with paints and lettering. Frame your most vivid photo memories into amazing collages to your liking.
Get cool photo content with important moments of your life!
~~~ Features ~~~
• A variety of templates with a large selection of aspect ratios;
• Quick and easy adding text to photos;
• Variety of fonts;
• Gradient background filling;
• Support for iPhone, iPad;
• Saving collages in the photo gallery of the device;
• Publication of finished collages in any social network.
~~~ Create a unique photo collage ~~~
Do you have a lot of vacation photos and want to add colors to your memories? Our app will help you quickly and easily combine photos of different sizes into one beautiful frame, edit them to your liking and turn interesting ideas into reality.
~~~ Add a bright background and catchy text ~~~
Decorate your photo collage with interesting text and vibrant backgrounds. Choose a color for the background and frame from a wide range of gradient color palettes. Use beautiful signatures made in different fonts. Turn interesting ideas into reality!
~~~ Be the center of attention ~~~
Share your adventures with your friends on social media. Post photo collages that capture your experiences. Express your thoughts and impressions to keep your followers engaged and excited about everything you do!
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe and get right now:
1. premium templates.
2. additional sticker packs.
3. content with no ads.
- Evaluate its benefits by getting a free 3-day trial period. After 3 days, the trial period will automatically switch to a weekly paid subscription.
- Paid subscription is divided into 3 types: weekly, monthly and annual.
- The cost of a weekly paid subscription is $9.99. Monthly - $19.99. Annual - $49.99.
- The amount will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel a subscription or trial period at any time, but no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE it will be automatically renewed.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- After payment, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
- Any unused portion of the free period will be forfeited upon purchase of the subscription.
- Please read our privacy policy https://appenvisions.com/privacy.html.
And EULA https://appenvisions.com/eula.html.

bluejetty:00151438:ios.description:
NeuroBoost – Brain Training, Brain Games & IQ Tests
NeuroBoost is a simple and engaging brain training app designed to keep your mind active every day. Enjoy Brain Games, Brain Tests, IQ Tests, Memory Games, Logic Games, Attention Games, and Critical Thinking Games in short, easy-to-use daily sessions.
Short daily exercises help train memory, logic, attention, focus, concentration, problem-solving, critical thinking, and other cognitive skills. No complicated rules — just a few minutes a day to build a consistent brain training habit.
Brain Test, ADHD Test & Cognitive Assessments
Explore Brain Test, IQ Test, ADHD Test, ADHD Quiz, Attention Test, Focus Test, Concentration Test, and Brain Quiz to learn more about your current cognitive performance.
NeuroBoost includes assessments covering memory, logic, attention, focus, concentration, reasoning, problem-solving, and other cognitive skills. Clear and easy-to-understand results help you identify strengths and discover areas you may want to improve.
You can also explore IQ Games, Intelligence Tests, Cognitive Challenges, and Mental Age Tests for more ways to challenge your thinking.
Brain Games for Daily Training
• Memory Games – challenge your memory and recall
• Logic Games – train logical thinking and pattern recognition
• Critical Thinking Games – challenge reasoning and decision-making
• Attention Games – train attention and concentration
• IQ Games – challenge reasoning and problem-solving
• Brain Quiz – test memory, knowledge, and thinking
• ADHD Games – activities focused on attention and focus
• Cognitive Games – train different thinking skills
Whether you’re looking for Brain Test, Brain Games, IQ Test, Logic Test, Attention Test, Focus Test, ADHD Test, or Critical Thinking Games, NeuroBoost provides quick and accessible activities for daily mental training.
Personalized Brain Training
Based on your test results and daily performance, NeuroBoost recommends suitable training exercises. Choose to train memory, logical thinking, attention, focus, concentration, reasoning, problem-solving, and critical thinking.
Just about 10 minutes a day can help you build a consistent brain training routine.
Track Your Progress
Your daily training activities and results are recorded in simple reports. Track your performance across memory, logic, attention, focus, concentration, and other cognitive skills as you continue your training.
Simple & Comfortable Design
A clean interface, easy-to-read layout, and smooth interaction make Brain Games and cognitive training comfortable for everyday use.
Privacy & Security
Your personal data is securely protected and is not shared without your permission.
Subscription Information
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually, depending on the plan selected.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. The renewal cost depends on the subscription plan you choose.
After purchase, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal through your Account Settings.
By using NeuroBoost, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Start your daily brain training with NeuroBoost and explore Brain Games, Brain Test, IQ Test, Memory Games, Logic Games, ADHD Games, and Critical Thinking Games in one app.

bluejetty:00014823:ios.description:
Trux is the most trusted app for dump truck owners and drivers to manage their business. ACCESS additional work in your area. Trux connects you with contractors in need of your skills. We provide clear rate information, and you only select the work that works for you! SCHEDULE work for you and your drivers easily. MANAGE your business from the palm of your hands. GET PAID weekly and don’t stress about creating invoices for contractors - we take care of that for you!
Join the nation’s largest network of technology-enabled dump truck drivers today. It’s FREE and EASY to use. 
How Trux Works:
1) View Available Jobs on the Trux Marketplace
2) Claim jobs and add them to your schedule (or schedule jobs for your entire fleet!)
3) Punch-in when you arrive at the start location
4) Upload load slips throughout the day
5) Punch-out when work is completed. 
6) Get paid directly by Trux, on-time, every week!
Trux offers solutions for dump truck owners, brokers, contractors, and material producers. To find out more head to www.truxnow.com.
*The Trux Drive app is exclusively for providers of construction trucking services. You must have access to and be authorized and licensed to drive construction-grade trucks in order to use the app. Before you can begin using the app, we’ll confirm that you and your truck are approved to use Trux Drive.

bluejetty:00122929:ios.description:
Mehr Service für Sie – komfortabel, einfach und persönlich.
Mit der neuen Mein Magenta App haben Sie Ihre Handy- und Internet-Verträge jederzeit im Blick!
Informieren Sie sich über Ihr verbleibendes Datenvolumen, Inklusiv-Kontingente, Guthaben und aktuelle Kosten – schnell und übersichtlich auf der Startseite.
Und das Beste: Die Mein Magenta App ist Ihr direkter Zugang zu exklusiven Magenta Moments! Jeden Monat warten neue, unvergessliche Vorteile, attraktive Rabatte und einzigartige Angebote auf Sie. Entdecken Sie jetzt, wie Sie Monat für Monat von Magenta Moments profitieren  – für Ihre Treue und ganz einfach per App.
DAS WICHTIGSTE AUF EINEN BLICK
- Verbrauch & Kosten prüfen
- Rechnungen einsehen
- Verträge verwalten
- Guthaben auf Ihre Wertkarte laden
- Mit Magenta Moments laufend neue Vorteile sichern
LOGIN
Wir haben den Login für Sie vereinfacht:
Die App erkennt sie automatisch anhand Ihrer Rufnummer - wenn Sie das möchten. Sie können sich aber auch einen SMS PIN zuschicken lassen, sollten Sie Ihr Mein Magenta Passwort gerade nicht parat haben.
Um alle angebotenen Funktionen und Services nutzen zu können sowie stets aktuelle Informationen zu erhalten, loggen Sie sich am besten mit Ihrer Rufnummer und Ihrem Mein Magenta Passwort ein.
VERBRAUCH & KOSTEN PRÜFEN
Sehen Sie ganz einfach, wie viel Datenvolumen Sie noch zur Verfügung haben oder buchen Sie einen Volume Boost, um in voller Geschwindigkeit weiter zu surfen. Prepaid-Kunden können ihr Guthaben kontrollieren und bequem aufladen.
RECHNUNGEN EINSEHEN
Behalten Sie Ihre Ausgaben im Blick und vergleichen Sie Ihre monatlichen Rechnungen. Einzelne Leistungen können Sie sich in den Rechnungsdetails ansehen.
VERTRÄGE VERWALTEN
Lassen Sie sich übersichtlich die wichtigsten Daten Ihres Tarifs, gebuchte Optionen und Ihre persönlichen Angaben anzeigen.
VOLUME BOOST
Für alle, die mehr Daten wollen - einmalig oder monatlich buchbar. Nutzen Sie Ihr Datenvolumen im Inland & in der EU-Zone. Für mehr Videostreams und Surfvergnügen.
GUTHABEN AUFLADEN
Jetzt ist es noch einfacher Guthaben für Ihre Klax-Wertkarte aufzuladen. Wählen Sie in der App einfach den gewünschten Aufladebetrag. Durch das Aufladen ist Ihre Klax-Wertkarte für weitere 12 Monate aktiv.
Viel Spaß mit der App!
Ihr Magenta Service Team
Hinweis: Apple steht in keiner Weise in Verbindung mit der Mein Magenta App und den darin angebotenen Kampagnen oder Gewinnspielen.

bluejetty:00177932:ios.name: Ice Scream 4: Rods Factory
bluejetty:00177932:ios.summary: After having rescued your three friends from Rod’s clutches on several occasions, the evil ice cream maker has captured them yet again and, this time round, has taken them to his factory. In the previous installment, J made his own special
bluejetty:00177932:ios.description:
After having rescued your three friends from Rod’s clutches on several occasions, the evil ice cream maker has captured them yet again and, this time round, has taken them to his factory. In the previous installment, J made his own special ice cream with the ingredients your friends had collected to fatten up and let Rod capture him.
In this new chapter, Rod will take you to his factory, where you’ll find out more about both his past and that of the Sullivan family. Explore the different areas of the factory, square up to the ice cream maker’s mysterious helpers and uncover many more surprises.
Free your friends from their cages before anyone ends up in the extraction room!
A few features:
- New enemies: Confront Rod’s new helpers—the Mini Rods. The factory guards who’ll try to stop you escaping and will alert Rod if they see you. Show off your skills by dodging and escaping them.
- Free exploration: For the first time in the saga, freely explore a vast, interconnected setting, free from loading times, that’s full of secrets about Rod’s past and that of his father’s, Joseph Sullivan.
- Fun puzzles: Solve ingenious puzzles to free your friends from their cages.
- Narrative cinematics: Detailed cinematics that will help you understand everything that’s going on.
- Original soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the world of Ice Scream with its unique music in step with the saga, and voices exclusively recorded for the game.
- Hints system: If you get stuck, there’s an in-depth hints window full of options that will help you solve the puzzles in line with your gaming style.
- Different difficulties: Play at your own pace and explore risk-free in ghost mode, or confront Rod and his helpers in the different levels of difficulty that will really put your skills to the test.
- A terrifyingly fun game suitable for all audiences!
If you’re after a scary, fantastical, fun experience, then be sure to play "Ice Scream 4: Rod’s Factory” now! Action and frights guaranteed.
Headphones are recommended for a better player experience.

• Tốc độ tải trang tức thì: Tối ưu hóa dung lượng, mở bài viết nhanh như chớp ngay cả khi mạng yếu.
• Siêu tiện ích Đời sống: Tích hợp trực tiếp xem Thời tiết, Kết quả Xổ số, Lịch phát sóng TV, Tỷ giá vàng/ngoại tệ, Chứng khoán, Lịch thi đấu Bóng đá và Từ điển.
• Chế độ Ban đêm (Dark Mode) thông minh: Chuyển đổi nhanh chóng chỉ với 1 chạm, dịu mắt và tiết kiệm pin khi đọc tin buổi tối.
• Trình xem ảnh & Video sắc nét: Phóng to toàn màn hình, vuốt để chuyển ảnh và lưu trữ dễ dàng.
• Cá nhân hóa trải nghiệm: Tùy chỉnh cỡ chữ to/nhỏ linh hoạt, phù hợp cho mọi độ tuổi người dùng.
• Lưu và Chia sẻ: Đánh dấu (Bookmark) bài viết yêu thích và chia sẻ tin tức hấp dẫn lên Facebook cùng bạn bè.

bluejetty:00086852:ios.description:
Chuck is email with superpowers. Clean up thousands of emails in seconds. Swipe through batches, bulk delete, archive, and unsubscribe — all processed privately on your device.
Unlike other email apps, Chuck never reads your email content. Our on-device AI analyzes only metadata (senders, subjects, timestamps) to intelligently group and suggest what to clean up. Your emails stay on your phone, never on our servers.
ALL YOUR ACCOUNTS IN ONE PLACE
Connect Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, AOL, Microsoft 365, Fastmail, and any standard IMAP account. See all your inboxes in one unified view and clean them all at once.
AI-POWERED BATCH PROCESSING
• Swipe left or right to delete or archive hundreds of emails at once
• AI Select suggests messages you can safely remove, trained privately on your device
• Group by Sender, Subject, or Time to find and act on email in bulk
• Filter by contact, attachments, starred, unread, and more
UNSUBSCRIBE & DECLUTTER
• Unsubscribe from mailing lists with one tap
• Mark as Spam, Snooze, or Move to folders and labels

bluejetty:00124199:ios.description:
►Catch a ball!
Turn right, now a little to the left, and right again, than free up more space so the ball can move, and finally… Yes! Catch it!
Make sure you're careful and really pay attention—this is no simple football or volleyball. It's still a game, but with a sand ball! Have you ever seen anything like it before?
Even though it's made of sand, it's not yellow like you'd expect. Guess what color a sand ball can be? Orange, green, pink, purple, blue, and many other vibrant colors of the rainbow and beyond! Your imagination will truly take flight!
►Why do you need to collect these sand balls?
The first reason is "just for fun", and it's completely true. Why not? Everyone deserves to relax after the a hectic pace of a work day, and this game knows how to help with that! Simple actions, а fresh and cool design, a wide variety of tasks - this game has hundreds of levels so you can have lots of fun in your spare time.
The second reason is for strategy. The app features a tricky puzzle where you have to think carefully to beat the level: put colorful balls into the truck and transfer them to a wonderful island located in the middle of nowhere. What's the point?
Now we come to the third reason. The game is well-organized in terms of plot. This means that while you play, you will be provided with challenging goals and inspiring missions like repairing buildings and advancing the overall infrastructure of the beautiful island. 
To sum up, collecting the balls is a good way to relax after a long day and improve your logical thinking at the same time. Press the button and download!
► A bubble of additional interest is gained through
• Golden keys. They open boxes with different surprises or even money inside.
• Sticks and other obstacles in the way. This is no walk in the park!
• A secret weapon that can destroy all balls. (You can restart the level.)
• Long and varied routes. They look like a real puzzle. What road will you choose? Try to avoid getting lost!
• A special white bubble. It turns into…..you'll find out on your own.
► Make sure that you discover all the WOW effects…and hurry up! Your first truck is coming! Don't miss your chance to build an island! 
P.S. or maybe not just one incredible island, but several…

bluejetty:00121788:ios.name: Paintstorm Studio
bluejetty:00121788:ios.summary: Paintstorm Studio is the first iOS App designed not only for simple sketches, but professional digital painting of any level, genre and technique. Paintstorm helps you to discover the magnificence and unleash the full potential of Apple Pen
bluejetty:00121788:ios.description:
Paintstorm Studio is the first iOS App designed not only for simple sketches, but professional digital painting of any level, genre and technique. Paintstorm helps you to discover the magnificence and unleash the full potential of Apple Pencil and brings you to a whole new level of drawing. Creating an art masterpiece has never been so mobile.
 A major feature of Paintstorm Studio is the array of brushes to choose from. We did our best so that you can easily and quickly adjust the brushes suitable to your painting style.
 Anyone who has ever painted knows it's hard to overestimate the painting tool and the importance of all the seemingly insignificant details. We tried not to miss any of them. Our goal was to create an intuitive, simple-to-use but at the same time functionally powerful tool that brings the process of digital painting to a new level, making it as comfortable as possible.
- Full control of all brush options (Incredible possibilities for brush settings)
- Bristle brushes of any form and kind
- Stroke post correction (You can take an action on any option. Not only on the stroke thickness)
- Parameters binding to the perspective
- Dynamic interface (Global interface scale, panels scale, opacity, color)
- Custom panels
- Full controlled mask-brush (Each brush can work as mask for other brush)
- Takes underlayer's color while blending
- "Close gaps" function when you fill or select
- Dirty brush mode
- Stroke stabilizer
- Usable color mixer
- Different gradient strokes
- Mirror drawing
- Standart tools pack (Lasso, Magic wand, Crop, Fill, Gradient and etc)
- Control of the random amounts
- Photoshop PSD and ABR supported
- Apple Pencil support (Pressure, Tilt, Direction)

bluejetty:00174816:ios.name: RobotMania: Physics Sandbox
bluejetty:00174816:ios.summary:
Build. Play. Destroy.
RobotMania is a creative physics sandbox where you can design, program, and play your own games just like in Roblox or Minecraft, but with full physics and complete freedom.
It is also inspired by Melon Playground, Alg
bluejetty:00174816:ios.description:
Build. Play. Destroy.
RobotMania is a creative physics sandbox where you can design, program, and play your own games just like in Roblox or Minecraft, but with full physics and complete freedom.
It is also inspired by Melon Playground, Algodoo, and Incredibots, combining the best of sandbox creativity and realistic physics.
Create anything from robots and vehicles to entire worlds and challenges. The only limit is your imagination.
Create Your Own Games
* Design interactive mini-games, puzzles, and simulations.
* Set custom rules, win conditions, and leaderboards.
* Compete in community challenges or make your own worlds for others to play.
* Combine creativity, engineering, and logic to become both a player and a game developer.
Endless Building Possibilities
* Build cars, tanks, airplanes, rockets, and spaceships.
* Craft houses, castles, cities, and mechanical creatures.
* Add motors, thrusters, and weapons like cannons or lasers.
* Animate your robots using joints, sliders, and buttons just like real engineering.
Powerful Yet Simple Editor
* Draw shapes freely and set physical properties like weight, friction, and bounce.
* Connect pieces using rotating or sliding joints for realistic motion.
* Scale, rotate, and duplicate parts with intuitive touch controls.
* Supports multitouch and both portrait and landscape play.
Join a Creative Community
* Discover and play thousands of creations from other players.
* Share your robots, vehicles, and games online.
* Like, comment, and compete on global leaderboards.
* Follow your favorite creators and get inspired every day.
Whether you love building like in Minecraft, creating games like in Roblox, or experimenting with physics like in Melon Playground, Algodoo, and Incredibots, RobotMania gives you the tools to make anything you imagine, from fun mini-games to advanced mechanical inventions.
Download RobotMania today and start creating your own world!

bluejetty:00023784:ios.name: Play: Save Videos Watch Later
bluejetty:00023784:ios.summary: Play helps you save and organize videos for later, discover what to watch next, follow your favorite channels, and watch with powerful features. Critically acclaimed by The Verge, Daring Fireball, 9to5Mac, MacStories, Mac Power Users, iMore
bluejetty:00023784:ios.description:
Play helps you save and organize videos for later, discover what to watch next, follow your favorite channels, and watch with powerful features. Critically acclaimed by The Verge, Daring Fireball, 9to5Mac, MacStories, Mac Power Users, iMore, AppAdvice, and more.
The Verge: “This is so much better than trying to manage a library in the YouTube app”
Daring Fireball: “I queue videos from my Mac and iPhone, then watch them later on my TV”
MacStories: “Play is an excellent example of how purpose-built apps often outshine more general solutions”
AppAdvice: “Play is easy to use and synced across all of your Apple devices”
iMore: “You’ll never want to use YouTube’s 'Watch Later' function again”
■ MacStories Selects 2024: Readers’ Choice Award
■ MacStories Selects 2024: Best New Feature
Save videos from any app or website to your personal watchlist. Follow YouTube channels and get a chronological subscription feed — free from the algorithm. Build your own personal video management system with tags, notes, and more. iCloud keeps your entire video library in sync across your iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro.
SAVE & BOOKMARK VIDEOS
- Save video links from your favorite apps and websites.
- Play automatically fetches metadata — title, channel, duration, and thumbnail — so your queue stays organized.
- Supports YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Instagram Reels, movies, TV shows, and many other sources.
- Use the share sheet, Safari and Chrome extension, drag and drop, or App Shortcuts to add videos.
KEEP UP WITH YOUR FAVORITE YOUTUBE CHANNELS
- Follow YouTube channels and playlists and receive new videos as they’re released.
- Browse your subscription feed in chronological order, without algorithmic recommendations.
- Save videos to your watchlist or remove them from your inbox.
- Organize channels into folders, set per-channel filters, and hide YouTube Shorts.
- Supports channels and creators from YouTube, Vimeo, and Nebula.
WATCH WITH POWERFUL FEATURES
- Watch YouTube videos in-app and play through a list without leaving Play.
- Read and search transcripts, follow along during playback, and jump to specific moments.
- Ask AI Assistant questions and generate summaries.
- Bookmark key moments with timestamped notes.
- Prefer the original audio track to avoid YouTube auto-dubbing.
- Resume playback exactly where you left off.
- Watch on Apple TV: save videos throughout the day and watch them on the big screen later.
ORGANIZE YOUR COLLECTION
- Add notes and star ratings to your videos.
- Tag videos for better organization, or let Auto-Tagging apply tags automatically based on rules you set.
- Create Collections of videos tailored to your preferences or simply describe one in natural language and let Apple Intelligence build it for you.
- Use Focus Filters to control which videos and tags appear in the app.
- Manage multiple videos at once with bulk actions.
- Automate adding, finding, editing, and organizing videos with App Shortcuts.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
- Add interactive widgets to your Home Screen to view and open saved videos at a glance.
- Available in multiple sizes with customizable filters, sorting, and accent colors.
Play is a modern app with support for the latest system features. It is also available on the Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro as a universal app, so you can enjoy it across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS with a single purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://marcosatanaka.com/privacy/play.html
Terms of Use: https://marcosatanaka.com/terms/play.html

bluejetty:00168827:ios.description:
Weather 24 is a lightning tracker and storm radar in one app: watch strikes land in real time and get a heads-up before the thunderstorm reaches you.
Hurricane tracking, flood and heat warnings and a 14-day forecast sit side by side, so one look tells you whether to head out, wait it out or move the car under cover.
LIGHTNING TRACKER AND THUNDERSTORM ALERTS
• Live strikes on the map, each marked with how many seconds or minutes ago it hit
• "Lightning nearby" push notification when a strike lands inside the radius you set
• Choose your distance: close for fewer pings, far for earlier warnings
• Thunderstorm and hail warnings in the day's outlook, so a ballgame or hike never catches you off guard
RAIN RADAR AND LIVE MAP
• Animated precipitation radar that shows where showers and snow are moving next
• Layers for wind, temperature, thermal comfort, cloud cover and barometric pressure
• Timeline playback to follow a storm system as it crosses your area
• A push about an hour before it starts pouring at your location
HURRICANE TRACKER
• Every active tropical system worldwide, from Tropical Depression and Tropical Storm up to Category 5
• Past and forecast track drawn on the map, colored by category
• Sustained wind, gusts and alert level for each one
• Push alerts through the season, from the Gulf Coast to the Atlantic seaboard, plus typhoons and cyclones overseas
SEVERE WEATHER ALERTS
• 12+ warning types: flash flood risk, downpours, strong wind, extreme heat, heat waves
• Winter hazards: freezing rain, icy roads, heavy snowfall, first frost, dense fog
• Rapid pressure drop and geomagnetic activity warnings for people who feel every change
• Pushed to your lock screen the moment conditions turn
BAROMETER, UV AND AIR QUALITY
• Pressure in inHg, hPa or mmHg with a daily fluctuation index
• A sensitivity index built from Kp geomagnetic activity and sharp changes, handy if pressure swings bring on headaches
• UV index with clear sun protection advice
• Air quality index with levels from Good to Hazardous
FORECAST AND WIDGETS
• Hourly and 14-day outlook, updated every 15 minutes
• Feels-like temperature, humidity, visibility, dew point, snow depth, sunrise, sunset and moon
• Charts for temperature, precipitation and gusts
• Wave height and sea temperature for coastal spots
• Home screen and lock screen widgets
Made for anyone who plans around the sky across the US: campers, golfers, boaters, parents at practice, drivers on a long road trip.
WEATHER 24 PREMIUM
• High-resolution radar with a 2 km precipitation grid
• Severe alerts about 30 minutes before impact
• Live storm map with lightning, precipitation and wind
• Rain detector: know when it starts, to within 15 minutes
• 14-day forecast hour by hour, plus advanced charts
• Weather sensitivity and air quality indexes, home screen widget, daily report and no ads
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

listings.name: Live Storm Radar: Weather 24
listings.description:
Weather 24 is a lightning tracker and storm radar in one app: watch strikes land in real time and get a heads-up before the thunderstorm reaches you.
Hurricane tracking, flood and heat warnings and a 14-day forecast sit side by side, so one look tells you whether to head out, wait it out or move the car under cover.

LIGHTNING TRACKER AND THUNDERSTORM ALERTS
• Live strikes on the map, each marked with how many seconds or minutes ago it hit
• "Lightning nearby" push notification when a strike lands inside the radius you set
• Choose your distance: close for fewer pings, far for earlier warnings
• Thunderstorm and hail warnings in the day's outlook, so a ballgame or hike never catches you off guard

RAIN RADAR AND LIVE MAP
• Animated precipitation radar that shows where showers and snow are moving next
• Layers for wind, temperature, thermal comfort, cloud cover and barometric pressure
• Timeline playback to follow a storm system as it crosses your area
• A push about an hour before it starts pouring at your location

HURRICANE TRACKER
• Every active tropical system worldwide, from Tropical Depression and Tropical Storm up to Category 5
• Past and forecast track drawn on the map, colored by category
• Sustained wind, gusts and alert level for each one
• Push alerts through the season, from the Gulf Coast to the Atlantic seaboard, plus typhoons and cyclones overseas

SEVERE WEATHER ALERTS
• 12+ warning types: flash flood risk, downpours, strong wind, extreme heat, heat waves
• Winter hazards: freezing rain, icy roads, heavy snowfall, first frost, dense fog
• Rapid pressure drop and geomagnetic activity warnings for people who feel every change
• Pushed to your lock screen the moment conditions turn

BAROMETER, UV AND AIR QUALITY
• Pressure in inHg, hPa or mmHg with a daily fluctuation index
• A sensitivity index built from Kp geomagnetic activity and sharp changes, handy if pressure swings bring on headaches
• UV index with clear sun protection advice
• Air quality index with levels from Good to Hazardous

FORECAST AND WIDGETS
• Hourly and 14-day outlook, updated every 15 minutes
• Feels-like temperature, humidity, visibility, dew point, snow depth, sunrise, sunset and moon
• Charts for temperature, precipitation and gusts
• Wave height and sea temperature for coastal spots
• Home screen and lock screen widgets

Made for anyone who plans around the sky across the US: campers, golfers, boaters, parents at practice, drivers on a long road trip.

WEATHER 24 PREMIUM
• High-resolution radar with a 2 km precipitation grid
• Severe alerts about 30 minutes before impact
• Live storm map with lightning, precipitation and wind
• Rain detector: know when it starts, to within 15 minutes
• 14-day forecast hour by hour, plus advanced charts
• Weather sensitivity and air quality indexes, home screen widget, daily report and no ads

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

How ImmediatePay Works
Your earned pay is available to access after you finish your workday, thanks to time tracking and payroll connections with Immediate. Simply choose the amount you’d like to transfer, select where to send the funds, and confirm the details. It’s that simple—you’ve just been paid!
Financial Wellness Tools
Whether you’re looking to manage your expenses better, start saving for a financial goal, or build healthier habits, ImmediatePay gives you access to tools that can help improve your overall financial wellness.

Prescription Savings: Save big on prescriptions for you and your family with up to 80% savings on medications at over 65,000+ pharmacies nationwide. 
Get Started with ImmediatePay Today
ImmediatePay is offered through participating employers as a financial wellness benefit. If your workplace doesn’t have it yet, ask your employer to consider offering ImmediatePay so you can access the pay you’ve earned when you need it most.

bluejetty:00162102:ios.description:
Your PRATIQUE FITNESS app goes beyond just working out!
Train at the gym or at home, enjoy our benefits club, access nutritional consultations, earn rewards for attendance ($0.20 per workout), refer friends for cashback, connect with verified personal trainers, build your own workouts, and use corporate partnerships like Wellhub or discounted employee plans.
◉ Train wherever you want
The PRATIQUE FITNESS app is with you every step of the way—whether you're working out at the gym or at home—with access to free classes exclusive to subscribers.
◉ Benefits Club
Take advantage of our perks club featuring thousands of partner stores, securing discounts and benefits across a wide range of categories.
◉ Nutrition in the palm of your hand
Find online nutritional consultation options within the app, including follow-ups every 45 days to help you stay disciplined and track your progress.
◉ Attendance Rewards
We’re the only gym that pays you to show up! Earn $0.20 in credits for every workout; these can be redeemed for products, services, or even used to lower your monthly membership fee.
◉ Pratique Affiliate Club
Refer friends to the gym and earn money through our affiliate program, receiving cashback directly in the app.
◉ Personal Trainer Area
Access a network of personal trainers verified by Pratique, ready to provide high-quality, reliable service.
◉ Power Flix | You're in control
With Power Flix, you call the shots: choose your workouts, customize the intensity, and track your progress in a practical, interactive way.
◉ Build your own workout
Our app features a "Build Your Workout" option, allowing you to create your own program, including exercises, reps, and weights. Alternatively, have a Pratique instructor design it for you—it's simple and done right in the app.
Pratique Fitness is the third-largest wholly-owned gym chain in Brazil, boasting over 160 locations, more than 270,000 active members, and a 23-year history dedicated to transforming lives through physical activity, health, and wellness. Since its inception, the chain has established itself as a national benchmark for democratizing access to sports, combining modern facilities, highly qualified professionals, and constant innovation.
Our mission is clear: to inspire people to find joy and enthusiasm in exercising. Our purpose goes beyond workouts—we aim to make the world happier and healthier by promoting quality well-being and celebrating every daily achievement of our members.
We offer a wide range of activities, including weight training, swimming, Muay Thai, martial arts, dance, spinning, jump classes, and Pilates. Each activity is designed to stimulate both body and mind, fostering balance, personal growth, and lasting results.
With over two decades of experience, Pratique Fitness combines tradition and innovation to deliver unique experiences. Each location is designed to provide technology, comfort, and excellent professional guidance, turning energy into achievements and encouraging a more active, healthy lifestyle.
Download the Pratique Fitness App now.
