bluejetty:00165359:ios.summary:
Securely exchange Bitcoin and 1400+ altcoins with great rates and lowest fees! Buy almost every crypto with a credit card or a bank transfer! This is the official ChangeNOW app, an instant crypto swap service.
LIMITLESS NON-CUSTODIAL CRYPT
bluejetty:00165359:ios.description:
Securely exchange Bitcoin and 1400+ altcoins with great rates and lowest fees! Buy almost every crypto with a credit card or a bank transfer! This is the official ChangeNOW app, an instant crypto swap service.
LIMITLESS NON-CUSTODIAL CRYPTO EXCHANGE
ChangeNOW is an instant cryptocurrency exchange service that allows for simple, fast, and secure crypto swaps. We focus on simplicity and safety — the service is registration-free and non-custodial. To swap your crypto, you only have to set the pair, choose the amount, enter your wallet address, and send the funds to the address provided. Three minutes later and your transaction is on its way.
1400+ COINS AND TOKENS
Swap between more than 1400 cryptocurrencies, including the most popular ones: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Monero (XMR), Ripple (XRP), Litecoin (LTC), Binance Coin (BNB), Cardano (ADA), Dogecoin (DOGE), Polkadot (DOT), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), ERC-20, BEP-2 tokens, and more.
STABLECOINS: Tether (USDT), TrueUSD (TUSD), USD Coin (USDC), Binance USD (BUSD), Dai (DAI), Gemini Dollar (GUSD), etc.
DE-FI TOKENS: Uniswap (UNI), Yearn.finance (YFI), SushiSwap (SUSHI), Pancakeswap (CAKE), Chainlink (LINK), Maker (MKR), Basic Attention Token (BAT), Bancor (BNT), etc.
SWAP CRYPTO ANONYMOUSLY
No registration is required to start exchanging crypto on ChangeNOW. We don’t collect any of your data to ensure it's 100% safe. For more security, use two-factor authentication, a 6-character pin, or authentication via face id or touch id. You can also set the screen lock time: immediately, 1 or 5 minutes, 1 or 5 hours.
REST ASSURED – YOUR CRYPTO IS SAFE
As a non-custodial crypto exchange platform, we don’t store your funds. This means we will never ask you to hold your funds in any accounts, or your private keys. With ChangeNOW, you remain in full control over your digital assets.
IN A MATTER OF SECONDS
It takes about 3 minutes to create an exchange, and another 5 to process it. The time span can vary from 2 to 40 minutes depending on the coin’s network congestion.
BEST EXCHANGE RATES
What's the current Bitcoin exchange rate? With ChangeNOW, you don’t have to worry that you’re missing a better one anywhere else. At the moment of the exchange, our algorithms search for the best Bitcoin rate and other cryptos’ rates at the market — and always pick the best ones. We do not charge any hidden or unreasonable fees. If the fees are more than 10% of the estimated value, we will warn you about it.
NO LIMITS — SWAP AS MUCH CRYPTO AS YOU WANT
Exchange limits are lame — this is why we’ve cut them off. On the ChangeNOW crypto exchange app, the minimum limits are about $2 depending on the coin, and the maximum ones simply don’t exist. Make a zillion Bitcoin exchange — it will go through just as quickly!
CASHBACK FEATURE
If you created an account, you will receive a 0.1% cashback for every transaction. Cashback can be withdrawn through the app & ChangeNOW website. The transaction history displays info on the accrual and withdrawal of your cashback balance.
BUY CRYPTO WITH FIAT
Want to purchase Bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies with USD, EUR, or a dozen other fiat currencies? Feel free to do so with Visa or MasterCard in just a few minutes!
HELP US MAKE OUR CRYPTO EXCHANGE APP BETTER!
If you have any questions or comments, please contact us:
Support: support@changenow.io
Website: https://changenow.io 
X / Twitter: https://x.com/ChangeNOW_io 
Telegram: https://t.me/changeNOW_chat 
The ChangeNOW Team

bluejetty:00127538:ios.description:
Unlock Your Mind's Potential with BRN: The Ultimate Brain Training Challenge!
Welcome to BRN, where the enhancement of your cognitive abilities becomes an exhilarating adventure. BRN invites you on a unique journey to explore the untapped potential of your mind through a series of engaging, challenging games and exercises. Crafted to elevate your memory, attention, and problem-solving skills, BRN is your ultimate partner in achieving cognitive excellence.
Why Choose BRN?
Diverse Game Selection: Embark on a cognitive journey with BRN’s extensive collection of brain training games. From memory quizzes and pattern recognition to intricate puzzles and logic games, each activity is designed to target specific areas of your brain, ensuring a comprehensive mental workout.
Personalized Training Programs: At BRN, we understand that everyone’s brain training journey is different. Choose your difficulty level, set your own pace, and let us create a personalized program that aligns with your cognitive enhancement goals. Watch your abilities flourish as you progress.
Age-Inclusive Gameplay: BRN welcomes users of all ages. Whether you’re a student looking to sharpen your focus, a professional aiming to enhance problem-solving skills, or a senior interested in maintaining cognitive health, BRN’s age-specific games offer something for everyone.
Engagement and Retention: Dive into a variety of mind-bending puzzles that challenge different regions of your brain and keep you engaged. From stimulating logic puzzles and math problems to IQ tests, BRN turns brain training into an addictive and rewarding experience.
Progress Tracking: Witness your cognitive transformation with BRN’s detailed progress tracking. Celebrate your milestones, pinpoint areas for growth, and tailor your training to continuously challenge yourself.
Embark on Your Cognitive Adventure with BRN Today!
Are you ready to explore the full potential of your mind? Download BRN now and kickstart your journey to a more agile, sharper brain. Accept the challenge, enjoy the fun games, and discover the limitless capabilities of your mind with BRN. Cognitive improvement has never been so exciting.
In order to use BRN app, you should subscribe and have a premium account.
Premium Terms:
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Note that subscriptions are automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.
BRN subscriptions are being managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. During an active subscription, no cancellation of the current subscription will be allowed.
For more information:
Privacy Policy: https://www.sharplylabs.com/privacy-policy-brn
Terms of Service: https://www.sharplylabs.com/terms-of-service-brn
Payment Policy: https://www.sharplylabs.com/payment-policy-brn
Feedback: support@sharplyapp.com

bluejetty:00173880:ios.description:
Join MyRaif – a simple, free and fast mobile app from Raiffeisen Bank in Ukraine for managing your finances without branches or queues, trusted by millions of Ukrainians. Over 800 000 users, 200 000+ clients connected cashback, and more than 2 million transactions every day. Express yourself with stylish money manager!
Digital banking is on top - let no air raid alert or power outage stop you from:
- Paying your café bills, for a taxi, cinema tickets, food delivery, tuition, medical insurance, mobile or car expenses on time
- Shopping in stores or online
- Repaying loans and getting online credit: money directly to your card
- Paying utilities bills
- Making transfers or control your child’s expenses
- Getting credit money until salary or any quick loan for your needs
- And even paying traffic fines or games fees
Trust yourself and your money wallet: keep your daily expenses and income under control – just pay and be calm “My Raif is MyRaif”!
NEED TO OPEN A CARD?
- Download and install MyRaif mobile application.
- Follow identity verification with the help of id-card/foreign passport/tax number or via Diia, confirm your mobile number
- Select the card and follow the prompts on the screen
Your card is ready, no paper documents needed!
CONVENIENT BANKING
- Catch discounts with cards Visa Fishka on OKKO and ATB in shops daily – convenient wallet is always nereby.
- Easily analyze your spending with detailed and transparent transaction history. Be sure: “My expances are under control!”
- Want to find nearest ATMs and branches? Interactive map will help.
- Get support through a convenient chat. Our operators will help you quickly resolve any issues.
- Protect yourself and your loved ones – apply for insurance just in one click – our health and cars are protected!
- Security is first: 3DS protects your online purchases.
TRANSFERS
- Transfer money from card-to-card of any Ukrainian bank quickly – no commission. Use easy and fast IBAN transfers. Save your main transfers in “Favorites” and easily repeat them.
- Receive international MoneyGram transfers directly in the app. Safe and convenient.
- Stay in touch with your family and friends - top up your mobile account in MyRaif for free!
- Send and receive money using only a phone number – no card number needed.
DEPOSITS
- Save with SKRYNYA for gifts, vacation, car, support for the Armed Forces of Ukraine, education, or a financial cushion.
- Open Progressive and Classic deposits in UAH and foreign currency.
CASHBACK
- Choose cashback categories in our app and make your purchases even more enjoyable. View your cashback and purchase history to see what brings you most benefits.
- Connect your existing cards to National Cashback program and get benefits from your purchases! Or open new National Cashback card in MyRaif and get cashback on it.
CURRENCY EXCHANGE
- View valid currency exchange rates and buy currency quickly. Keep in mind profitable kursopad!
- Open currency cards for dollars and euros. 
MY CREDIT
- A credit card with a 100-day grace period for all your ideas.
- Cash loans for repairment, electronic devices, auto or other purposes. Choose a convenient payment date to be in line with your plans.
FOR ENTREPRENEURS
- Open a sole proprietorship (FOP) account to work with clients and partners. No fees for account opening, maintenance, or transfers — details available immediately. Order a POS terminal and enjoy no subscription fee for the first month of use.
- Instant switch between “personal cards vs business account” within a single profile. Full control over cash flow, up-to-date card and account statuses, account statement generation, payment search by name or amount, copying card and account details, and creating QR codes from details.
Follow the update to take advantage of even more MyRaif features.
Raiffeisen Bank JSC. Entered in the State Register of Banks on March 27, 1992, under No. 94, with a record of the right to conduct banking activities under No. 10.

bluejetty:00071050:ios.summary:

This app offers the same extra features as the Pro upgrade in Soundboard Studio as a s
bluejetty:00071050:ios.description:
Soundboard Studio is the professional and smart sound playback app, perfect for for music, sound effects, voiceovers, pads, soundbites or anything else!
This app offers the same extra features as the Pro upgrade in Soundboard Studio as a standalone App Store purchase instead of an in-app purchase.
Soundboard Studio is designed for playing ad-lib sounds and music, with its large grid of buttons for each of your tracks. You can customise the layout, colours and detailed settings for all of your tracks. Make the PERFECT soundboard for your show, studio or event!
Soundboard Studio is the fully featured soundboard solution for iOS, with all of the reliable pro tools you need for a great show.
For years, Soundboard Studio has been the app of choice for many pro podcasters, studios, event venues and more. Here's just a few of their thoughts:
• “For the price it knocks everything else out of the ring that compares to work on a tablet or laptop.”
• “For me, this is the best of any program out there, and I’ve tried a lot.”
• “My worship Live looping is in a whole new Level! Thank you guys!”
• “This app is professional grade and made for—you guessed it—professionals! You won't regret this investment.”
• “Podcasters, look no further: This is your soundboard app!”
• “This is for serious professionals, so if that's you, add this app to your arsenal immediately.”
Top Features:
• Play multiple tracks simultaneously
• Set tracks to fade in and/or fade out
• Set individual volume levels for each track
• Trim the start and end of individual tracks
• Program smart Track Automations to trigger events such as playing other tracks, or changing other track volumes
• Set tracks to automatically play the next adjacent track when they reaches their end
• Background audio playback: Your tracks will continue playing when you close the app
• Monitor and control multiple playing tracks
• Add images to your tracks to make them instantly recognisable
• Create multiple 'Boards' of tracks and quickly navigate between them
• Assign default track settings to apply to all newly imported tracks
• Import tracks from the Music library on your device
• Import audio files from your favourite apps and services like Dropbox, Google Drive, iCloud Drive and more via the Files app
• Use iTunes File Sharing to import files directly from your computer
• Drag & drop support – Drag any compatible audio files into Soundboard Studio to quickly import them as tracks
• Connect your device to an external display and chose from three realtime visualisers fo your sound
• See which tracks you have already played
• Low latency playback using the power and simplicity of iOS
What's New in Soundboard Studio 2?
• Create unlimited boards
• Colours! Select from 6 colours for your tracks and boards
• Collapsible view of all playing tracks for better control
• Easier drag & drop track arrangement
• Move tracks between boards
• Import multiple files at once from the Files app
• iPad split-screen multitasking support
• iPad slide-over multitasking support
Soundboard Studio was designed to be perfect for...
• Podcasts
• Events
• Live theatre
• Church services
• Workshops
• Voice presenters
• Wedding planners
• Choreographers
• Stage Managers
• Magicians
• Puppeteers
• Dance recitals
No other soundboard app comes close to the versatility, usability and experience of using Soundboard Studio.

Il terzo Tab è dedicato agli Sfondi, powered by Wallpapers Central e vi permetterà di personalizzare il vostro dispositivo con lavori originali e sempre molto particolari, insieme alle Suonerie.
Il quarto Tab "Altro" è davvero speciale. Visitatelo di tanto in tanto perchè i contenuti al suo interno cambieranno nel corso del tempo e vi torneranno sempre più utili.

Abbiamo anche una splendida Dark Mode realizzata davvero con tantissima precisione per offrirvi la migliore esperienza possibile.
L'app utilizza le ultime tecnologie ed i Widget per cui richiede iOS 17 o superiori.
L'APP E' COMPLETAMENTE PRIVA DI PUBBLICITA'!

listings.name: iSpazio: News about Apple
listings.description:
iSpazio keeps you up to date on everything happening in the Apple world: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, AirPods and every Apple service.

NOW IN YOUR LANGUAGE
iSpazio is written by an Italian newsroom and the app is now available in 11 languages. Every article can be translated into more than 20 languages right on your iPhone, even automatically as soon as you open it: the title and first lines are ready in moments, and the rest of the article is translated paragraph by paragraph while you read. Headlines on the Home screen can be translated too. Article translation requires iOS 18 or later.

NO ADS
The app is completely free of advertising.

WHAT YOU'LL FIND
- The latest news, guides and tutorials to get the most out of your devices, plus reviews of accessories and apps with our verdict, pros and cons.
- An AI Summary for every article, with the key points in a moment.
- Push notifications for the most important news and live blogs of Apple events.
- AppyDeals: the best apps and games that just went free or on sale, with price history, price alerts and promo codes from developers.
- Wallpapers, powered by Wallpapers Central: thousands of original, high-quality wallpapers.
- The Other tab, with your favorite categories, polls, most read articles and more.
- Your Account: public profile, comments, badges to unlock and your reading stats month by month.
- Favorites synced with iCloud, offline reading, Home Screen widgets and a carefully crafted Dark Mode.

The app is optimized for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, in portrait and landscape.

With the optional iSpazio+ subscription you support our work and unlock unlimited AI Summaries, offline reading, relaxed reading, adjustable text size, alternate icons and the Vintage theme, the Plus badge and the blue check in comments.

Requires iOS 17.6 or later.

Privacy: https://www.ispazio.net/policy-app
Terms of Use: https://www.ispazio.net/term-of-use-app

________
iSpazio is an independent news blog. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Apple Inc. Apple, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, AirPods and iOS are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. Other names, logos and images belong to their respective owners.

bluejetty:00114980:ios.name: Cat On Chair: Pomodoro Timer
bluejetty:00114980:ios.summary:
Focus app doesn't have to feel cold or boring.
When you enter focus mode, a cat appears on the chair keeping you company. With a hand-drawn style and rich colors, Cat On Chair brings you a cozy, aesthetic pomodoro focus experience. The cat
bluejetty:00114980:ios.description:
Focus app doesn't have to feel cold or boring.
When you enter focus mode, a cat appears on the chair keeping you company. With a hand-drawn style and rich colors, Cat On Chair brings you a cozy, aesthetic pomodoro focus experience. The cat isn't only there to "supervise"; they're sharing the moment with you.
Stay motivated with gifts and rewards.
Complete a session, and your cat will bring you a gift. Fail, and you may be left with a little trash.
Gifts can be traded for fish, which unlock furniture and decorations for your cat's room. Seasonal updates bring new gifts, decor, and even more cats to collect.
Attention: May cause increased productivity, spontaneous cat adoption urges, and the inexplicable need to explain your work schedule to a digital pet.
Basic Features (Free Version)
- No ads
- Support for both Pomodoro and count-up modes
- Collect gifts and trash, sell for fish to buy new furniture and decor
- Block apps and websites to avoid interruptions
- Use a whitelist to pick the apps you want to use during focus sessions
- Note down your important tasks in a to-do list with due dates and reminders
- Focus Timeline to see today's sessions at a glance
- Stats overview to track your overall progress
- Export your cat's room as wallpaper to save your focus moments
- With Shortcuts, you can create automation to start a focus session whenever you need
- Earn achievements to show off in your cat's room
- Lock screen widget to start a session without unlocking the phone
- iCloud multi-device sync—seamlessly switch between iPhone and iPad
Upgrade to Pro for More Features
- Mix and match ambient sounds—cat purring, rain, fireplace, waves, café chatter—to create your perfect atmosphere
- Record your own custom alert sounds for session notifications
- Write custom cat quotes for session completion and failure messages
- Call your cat by name using your voice—they'll react when they hear you
- Apple Watch companion app—start, pause, and track sessions from your wrist
- Focus Timeline with full history—browse any date and add stickers to your timeline
- Detailed statistics: see your progress in day, week, month, and year view
- Sync focus sessions to Apple Health, Calendar, and Reminders
- Unlock different coat styles for your cats—change their look anytime
- Save and switch between whitelist presets for different focus scenarios
- More exclusive gifts, decorations, chairs, carpets, and room items
- Customize break length, cycles, and long breaks
- Add custom focus tags for better task management
- Multiple cat-themed app icons—change anytime to match your mood
- Home screen widgets: to-do list, focus status, and animated cat widgets
Currently supports iOS 17 and above.
Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you:
Email: hello@catonchair.app
Discord: catonchair.app/discord
Instagram: xingrui_m
Privacy Policy: https://catonchair.app/en/privacy
Terms of Services: https://catonchair.app/en/terms

bluejetty:00120073:ios.description:
Learn Japanese, starting from the "Easy"! Easy Japanese makes learning Japanese easy.
Accumulate knowledge through reading and intensive listening to Japanese articles, and strengthen your Japanese skills through AI oral conversations to ultimately improve your Japanese proficiency.
Designed with beginners in mind, each article is annotated with word types and hiragana, allowing you to look up unfamiliar words at any time, making learning Japanese no longer difficult.
Rich content updated daily to meet the needs of learners at different levels, while also learning about Japanese culture and the latest trends!
Key Features:
- AI Scenario Conversations: Provides practical topics for various situations such as job interviews, school admissions, and medical appointments, allowing you to quickly learn everyday conversations.
- Japanese Article Reading: Authentic Japanese articles with word segmentation, word type annotations, and Japanese-Chinese character hiragana markings.
- Multiple Voice Readings: Near-native voice pronunciation, with adjustable speed to help improve listening and pronunciation.
- Intensive Listening: You can customize your listening sessions with adjustable intervals and repetitions.
- Japanese Dictionary: Click on underlined words to view explanations, covering vocabulary levels from N5 to N1.
- Watch Videos: Rich video content featuring professional Japanese teaching and insights into Japanese life.
- Picture-in-Picture Mode: Supports picture-in-picture mode for multitasking while watching videos, making it easy to switch to other apps.
- Split-screen Mode: Supports split-screen mode on iPad, allowing you to take notes and work with other apps more conveniently.
- Export PDF: You can export articles as PDFs for easy printing.
Contact Us:
Email: feedback@easyjapanese.club
If you like the Easy Japanese App, please download it and share it with your friends!
If you have any feedback, please let us know through the above channels to help make Easy Japanese even better!

You have to make a decision and don't know what to choose?
Sometimes it is better to leave it all to fate!

Good luck!

VOA operates one of the world's largest international news media networks on TV, radio and digital properties with a total weekly audience of more than 200 million people around the world, including Africa, The Middle East, Asia and beyond. To do this, VOA employs more than 3,500 journalists, focused on countries without a free or established press or free and open internet access.

- Hear podcasts and newscasts on demand
- Download stories, videos, and photos for offline reading, watching, and listening
- Customizable interface
- Stream multimedia
- Offline-downloading and saving of news content for later enjoyment
- Social media sharing on Facebook, Twitter, email and other platforms

bluejetty:00096474:ios.description:
Quick battles with dramatic turnarounds!
An exhilarating card battle game right on your smartphone!
Brave Frontier, a series boasting 38 million downloads worldwide across multiple titles, now reborn as a worldwide card battle game!
Brave Frontier Versus features an innovative system unique to digital trading card games that allows anyone from card game beginners to veterans to engage in exhilarating, high-paced battles!
◆ Experience Pocket-Sized Battles and Spectacular Victories in an All-New Battle System!
Brave Frontier Versus features five-turn battles that don't require you to wait for your opponent. Battles are lively and quick, allowing players to experience fierce matches without the heavy commitment!
Hit the ground running by playing multiple units even on the very first turn! No time is wasted as each exciting round unfolds. Create synergy with up to six units on the field for a thrilling offensive and defensive battle. As cards revive each turn, you can build strategies effectively as you strive for victory!
◆ Build an Exhilarating Deck and Unleash Your Dream Team!
No need to worry over complexities. Decks can be comprised of only character cards, so even card game beginners can get started easily. Build you own party, devise your own strategy, and enjoy the excitement of battle!
◆ Manifest Your Victory and Deliver Devastating and Exhilarating Brave Bursts!
Seize your destiny with Manifestation Cards! Draw Manifestation Cards on the third and fifth turns and vie for the advantage in battle with their enhanced stats and powerful skills!
A signature of the Brave Frontier series, Brave Bursts are back in this trading card game! Unleash these killer moves and turn the tide of battle!
◆ Brave Frontier Versus is the game for people who...
・Like trading card games
・Enjoy strategy and tactics
・Want to test their skills in PvP
・Prefer games that can be played quickly and easily
・Want to enjoy collecting and trading cards
・Want to form guilds and work together with other players
・Want to have fun in the in-game chat
・Want to interact and play with people from around the world
・Love the Brave Frontier series
■ Price
Base App: Free
*Some in-game items are available to purchase
■ System Requirements
iOS 13.0 and above
iPhone 8, iPad (8th generation) and above
Devices with 3GB or more memory (RAM)Download Brave Fr

bluejetty:00157170:ios.description:
Warlands is a turn-based strategy game where your goal is to destroy your enemies and take over the map until you achieve total world domination. 
You can play up to 7 other people or computers, either on the same device or over the internet.
You are able to place two different types of units (one that is better at attacking, and one that is better at defending), and there are six different types of territory: plains, impassable mountains, treacherous water, defensive towers, cunning forests, and unit production centers.
The free base game comes with three styles of maps in three sizes each. Additional map packs can be purchased for 99 cents. Purchase of any map pack removes advertisements.
Full instructions at WarlandsGame.com
---------
Map Packs:
The Divided Lands - Includes spiral, layers, and cubes maps
The High Seas - Includes fire-islands, whirlpool, and water-world maps
The Desolate Country - Includes bases, rapid-growth, and continents maps

bluejetty:00179782:ios.description:
LandScape celebrates the best of the British countryside throughout the seasons, including its fascinating wildlife and rich heritage. You’ll find easy-to-follow crafts to try, delicious recipes to savour, historic places to visit and a host of inspiration for the garden. Filled with beautiful photography and informative features, LandScape guarantees an inspiring read from start to finish. 
Our exciting new digital membership offers specially selected content, member-only rewards, full access to previous issues, and more! 
A LandScape membership offers: 
- Full access to LandScape archives, meaning you can read inspiring articles from previous issues 
- The ability to search for topics and bookmark articles for later 
- Access to member-only rewards from partners we know you'll love 
- Extra content sent directly from the editor by email 
Features of the app you’ll love:   
- Read or listen to articles (choice of three voices) 
- Browse all current and back issues   
- Free articles available to non-members  
- Search content that interests you  
- Save articles from the content feed to enjoy later 
- Switch between Digital View and Magazine View for the best experience 
In each issue of LandScape, you will find: 
Inspirational gardens 
Discover the beauty and diversity of British gardens and seasonal plants. Step into gardens where nature flourishes and gain ideas and advice. 
Tempting recipes.
Serve delicious dishes that make the most of the season's produce. Find new ways to enjoy traditional favourites. 
Simple crafts.
Follow step-by-step guides to creating beautiful items for the home and garden. 
History and heritage. 
Meet talented craftspeople who keep Britain's traditional skills alive. 
Travel and walks. 
Explore Britain's beautiful countryside and coast through the changing seasons and uncover the hidden secrets of its ancient towns and villages. 
Country life.
Learn about the animals and birds that inhabit our fields, rivers, and coastline, as well as farmyard companions and much-loved pets. 
For gorgeous photography and in-depth features about places to visit in Britain, including stunning landscapes, food recipes, and more, download LandScape today! 
PLEASE NOTE: This app is optimised for iOS 14 and up. If you're using an iPad 1 or 2, iPad Mini 1 or iPhone 5 (or before) you may struggle to run this app smoothly. 
Your subscription will automatically renew each billing period, and you will be charged through your iTunes account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current cycle. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings up until 24 hours before the end of the current period, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Please visit our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information:

bluejetty:00073642:ios.description:
We are the original and best hidden city booking engine. Find cheap flights and hotel rates you won’t see anywhere else. Save hundreds of dollars compared to other travel sites.
Discover extraordinary travel deals, set fare alerts, and uncover great hotel rates.
We’re so good, United Airlines actually sued us for it!
• Find flights other search engines won’t show you -- including HIDDEN-CITY flights and arbitrary round-trips
• Filter flights by duration, number of layovers, takeoff/landing time and more

For example, a flight from New York to San Francisco might be $300, but a similar flight from New York to Seattle with a layover in San Francisco might be $200. If you’re going to San Francisco we’ll show you both flights, and if you choose the cheaper one, you get off the plane at the layover (San Francisco) rather than going to the final destination (Seattle).
This is perfectly legal and the savings can be significant, but if you’ve never traveled like this before, you should read our HIDDEN-CITY FAQ at http://skiplagged.com/faq
We’ll always show you all the options, so YOU can pick the deal you want!

bluejetty:00027374:ios.description:
Whether you're a streamer building a channel, an industry veteran looking for new ways of working or a creator with a passion for filmmaking, Mavis Camera has something for you. 
-- MAIN FEATURES --
• Record in a range of resolutions, frame rates, and codecs including Open Gate, HEVC 10-bit, ProRes and ProRes RAW
• Record and preview using custom LUTs, and achieve a filmic look with built-in Filter LUTs
• Monitor tools including focus peaking, zebras, false color, expanded focus, guides, flip
• Manual camera controls including focus, exposure, shutter and color
• Hardware Remote Controllers: SKAARHOJ, Teradek RT, CyanView RCP, Tilta Nucleus (USB dongle only)
• NDI® Send and Receive HX3 Certified
• Pro HDMI output
• HDMI input via Atomos Ninja Phone support
• HDMI / SDI input via Accsoon SeeMo series support
• Adobe Frame.io Camera to Cloud
• Streaming including YouTube, Twitch, Instagram and Facebook
• Custom audio inputs
• Audio mixer including gain, pan and solo controls for individual channels
• Real-time audio passthrough for monitoring in headphones
• HDR video pipeline
• Custom RTMP destination & SRT (TX Caller) streaming
• Mavis C2C including Framelight X, MediaSilo, Sony Ci & Amazon S3
• Mavis Cloud Hub remote configuration for Mavis C2C and streaming settings
• Timecode including Time-of-Day, Offset and UltraSync BLUE
• Vertical and landscape recording and streaming
• API
-- AUDIO TOOLS --
• Integrated audio mixer with stereo output
• Gain & pan control per input channel
• External mic inputs
• Internal mic selection
• Multi-track ISO recording
• Bluetooth monitoring
-- CONNECTED WORKFLOWS --
NDI
• Send or Receive with NDI
• NDI HX3 Certified
• Automatically find all NDI sources on local network
• Set NDI Groups, Discovery Server, UDP/TCP Mode
Camera to Cloud
• Mavis C2C integrations with Framelight X, MediaSilo, Sony Ci & Amazon S3
• Direct integration with Adobe Frame.io
• Direct integration with Atomos ATOMOSphere 
• Progressive uploads while you record
• Manage Mavis C2C devices from hub.mavis.cloud
Live Streaming
• Vertical and landscape streaming
• Simultaneously record and stream
• Custom RTMP and SRT Caller destinations
• Manage Streaming devices from hub.mavis.cloud
-- CAMERA CONTROLS --
Manual controls including
• Focus
• Exposure
• ISO
• Shutter
• Color temperature
• Shutter lock
• Custom frame rates
• Range of resolutions
• Range of bitrates
• Codecs including ProRes
-- MONITOR TOOLS --
What they do
• Mavis LUTs let you record or preview your footage with a filmic grade, helping you visualise the final look while you shoot
• Focus peaking and expanded focus features help you achieve consistently sharp and precise shots
• Zebras help ensure your shots are never overexposed 
• Guides help you frame your shot
• Aspect Ratio overlay lets you preview your image in a different width/height
• Waveform monitor helps you shoot with the optimal dynamic range
• Vectorscope helps maintain consistent colors and ensures accurate white balance
Notable settings
• Record and preview LUTs
• Focus peaking color and sensitivity
• Guides including thirds, portrait safe and square
• Zebras, color and sensitivity range
• Aspect Ratio overlay cross hairs, safe area and transparency
-- API --
• Control the internal camera from an API
• Discover and learn the API with a built in API Playground web server
• Develop your own control interfaces with a WebSocket based interface
• Full RCP based control including color shading 
• Secure your connections with API keys
Device restrictions apply. Some features require In-App Purchase or App Subscription. 
Check out the support pages for full details - support.mavis.cloud
EULA - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Mavis Camera was developed by people who love what they do. We hope you enjoy it as much as we do! :-)

bluejetty:00146416:ios.description:
## Focus Timer
## App Blocker
In a world full of distractions, FocusFlight offers a unique way to focus: turning every session into an immersive flight journey.
From boarding and takeoff to staying focused in the air and landing at the end, FocusFlight combines aviation-inspired design with practical focus tools. It is more than a timer or app blocker — it is an experience that helps you avoid distractions, get into flow, and complete what matters.
FocusFlight has been featured by the App Store as App of the Day. Whether you are studying, working, reading, or simply trying to put your phone down, FocusFlight helps you start with intention and end with a sense of completion.
FOCUSFLIGHT FEATURES
【Immersive Flight Experience】
Opening FocusFlight feels like boarding a focus flight. Set your boarding pass, choose your task and focus duration, then begin your own deep focus journey. When the session ends, your flight lands safely with a clear sense of achievement.
【Airplane Mode, Block Distractions】
Turn on “Airplane Mode” to block distracting apps and websites during your focus session. Powered by Apple’s Screen Time integration, FocusFlight helps you stay away from interruptions and focus on what matters.
【3D Map Window View】
During your focus session, watch your journey through a 3D map window. As time passes, your flight moves across the world map, turning focus into a journey you can see and feel.
【3D Flight Routes】
Every focus session becomes a visualized flight route. See where you departed, where you are heading, and review the routes you have completed.
【Random Route Mode】
Not sure where to fly? Start with Random Route Mode. No need to choose a destination in advance — just begin focusing, and discover where you land when the session ends.
【FlightLog】
Every focus flight is saved in FlightLog. Review your departure city, landing city, focus duration, flight distance, and route history.
【Membership Cards & Flight Miles】
As your focus time and flight miles grow, you can unlock and upgrade your own membership cards. Each card marks your progress and gives your journey a stronger sense of identity.
【Multiple Map Modes】
FocusFlight offers 3D, satellite, and classic map modes. Explore routes and destinations from different perspectives, and enjoy traveling the world while staying focused.
【White Noise & Focus Music】
During each focus flight, you can turn on white noise or focus music to create a calmer environment for studying, working, or reading. From airplane ambience to soothing focus tracks, FocusFlight helps you enter a quieter, more focused state.
【Focus Records & Data Tracking】
Each session leaves a clear record, including your boarding pass, flight data, route, and focus duration. Use these records to review your focus habits and see the value of every session.
【Different Focus Types】
Choose focus types through seat options, such as study, work, reading, or creative time. Make every flight better matched to your current task, and make focusing more flexible and fun.
SUBSCRIBE TO FOCUSFLIGHT
• Subscription Plans: “FocusFlight All-Access Plan (Annual Auto-Renewal)” and “FocusFlight All-Access Plan (Monthly Auto-Renewal)”;
• Subscription Type: Auto-renewable subscription;
• Subscription Price: $18.99/year / $3.99/month;
• Cancel Subscription: To cancel your subscription, go to iPhone Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions, and select “FocusFlight All-Access Plan (Annual Auto-Renewal)” or “FocusFlight All-Access Plan (Monthly Auto-Renewal)” to cancel. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the subscription period ends, the subscription will automatically renew.
• Renewal: The Apple ID associated with the auto-renewable subscription will be charged through your App Store account within 24 hours before each billing period ends to extend the subscription.
• Terms of Service, including subscription policies: https://focus.flights/terms
• Privacy Policy: https://focus.flights/privacy

Turn on “Airplane Mode” to block distracting apps and websites during your focus session. Powered by Apple’s Screen Time integration, FocusFlight helps you stay away from interruptions and focus on what matters.

【3D Map Window View】
During your focus session, watch your journey through a 3D map window. As time passes, your flight moves across the world map, turning focus into a journey you can see and feel.

【3D Flight Routes】
Every focus session becomes a visualized flight route. See where you departed, where you are heading, and review the routes you have completed.

【Random Route Mode】
Not sure where to fly? Start with Random Route Mode. No need to choose a destination in advance — just begin focusing, and discover where you land when the session ends.

【FlightLog】
Every focus flight is saved in FlightLog. Review your departure city, landing city, focus duration, flight distance, and route history.

【Membership Cards & Flight Miles】
As your focus time and flight miles grow, you can unlock and upgrade your own membership cards. Each card marks your progress and gives your journey a stronger sense of identity.

【Multiple Map Modes】
FocusFlight offers 3D, satellite, and classic map modes. Explore routes and destinations from different perspectives, and enjoy traveling the world while staying focused.

【White Noise & Focus Music】
During each focus flight, you can turn on white noise or focus music to create a calmer environment for studying, working, or reading. From airplane ambience to soothing focus tracks, FocusFlight helps you enter a quieter, more focused state.

【Focus Records & Data Tracking】
Each session leaves a clear record, including your boarding pass, flight data, route, and focus duration. Use these records to review your focus habits and see the value of every session.

【Different Focus Types】
Choose focus types through seat options, such as study, work, reading, or creative time. Make every flight better matched to your current task, and make focusing more flexible and fun.

bluejetty:00044799:ios.summary: Are you applying for the Washington DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the s
bluejetty:00044799:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Washington DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the state of Washington in order to obtain your permit on the very first attempt. 
This app contains quizzes that are derived from the official Washington Department of Motor Vehicles state manual. This application will help you in preparing for and practicing for the Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Driver's License (CDL) tests required by the state of Washington. All of the practice tests included in this application are based on the most recent editions of the applicable manuals. Therefore, if you are looking for preparation for the DMV driver's license test, this is the ideal DMV driver's license test practice app for you. This application is a handbook manual that may be used to practice and prepare for the Commercial Driver's License (CDL) as well as the DMV Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is developed with the learning requirements of a user who is applying for a driving license and the requirements of the driver's license test, as well as the most effective learning strategies discovered by researchers. The process of studying for the permit test is made to be more engaging and enjoyable as a result. When utilizing this application, users report that it is quite simple to provide accurate responses to the questions that appear on the actual DMV permit driver's license test. 
Following is a brief overview of the features provided by the app.
- Practice tests designed especially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- You can keep track of your progress and check the history of each practice test. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Sample tests for obtaining a driver's license for a motorcycle, a car, and a commercial driver's license (CDL). 
- A very extensive bank of sample questions that covers all areas of the written examination for the driver's license. 
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

Cielo provides smart climate control solutions for both ducted and ductless HVAC systems. With AI-backed thermostats and intelligent integrated climate control, Cielo is set to revolutionize the HVACR industry by prioritizing ener
bluejetty:00156782:ios.description:
About Us:
Cielo provides smart climate control solutions for both ducted and ductless HVAC systems. With AI-backed thermostats and intelligent integrated climate control, Cielo is set to revolutionize the HVACR industry by prioritizing energy savings without compromising comfort.
Cielo is a customer-centric company. Our prime focus is to maximize comfort and ensure better energy savings for homes and businesses. This has been a major factor in our success, propelling the company to win several accolades, including Inc. 5000, Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500, AHR Expo Innovation Award, and being ranked among America’s Best Home and Garden brands by Newsweek and Statista.
At Cielo, we are deeply committed to preserving and conserving our planet for future generations. All our efforts are geared towards achieving this singular objective. Consequently, we have made it our mission to provide energy-saving products that contribute to these efforts. Our range of smart climate control products is designed to do just that – helping create a mindful and better home climate.
Cielo Home App:
‘Cielo Home’ is FREE, and there are NO monthly subscriptions. Our app is loaded with a huge array of next-gen smart features, carefully designed to add convenience to your life while saving energy. Here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:
- Global Control: Control your cooling or heating from anywhere in the world.
- 7-Day Scheduling: Set daily or weekly schedules to run your air conditioning based on your routine.
- Energy Savings: Keep an eye on your usage patterns and find opportunities to save energy.
- Eco-Friendly HVAC (Integrated Controls): Reduce reliance on fossil fuel-based heating systems by auto-switching between your residential HVAC systems using Cielo Linked. 
- Smart Home Compatibility: Experience a truly connected smart home by integrating your Cielo smart products with Google Assistant, Amazon Alexa, Samsung SmartThings, IFTTT, and Siri Shortcuts.
- Maximize Comfort: Enjoy the ease of Presets & intelligent triggers to regulate your home temperature.
- Zone Control: Group multiple Cielo smart thermostats into a zone for personalized temperature control and manage all of them with a simple tap. 
- Geofencing: Set location-based actions and controls to maximize savings and comfort.
- Compatibility: Cielo ductless smart products are compatible with any ductless air conditioner or heat pump that has an IR remote controller. Our ducted controls include smart thermostats, which support central HVAC systems, providing a comprehensive solution for all your climate control needs.
At Cielo, we are committed to enhancing your home comfort and energy efficiency. Join our many satisfied customers who enjoy the convenience and savings brought by Cielo’s smart climate control solutions.

bluejetty:00166777:ios.description:
Excellent scientific calculator with step-by-step solutions, symbolic algebra, graphing, equations, integrals and derivatives.
The calculator has globally more than 50 million downloads and 250 000 five-star ratings.
You can write expressions in a natural way and watch your calculations. The result is displayed as a number, simplified expression etc.
An expression can also be entered from a photo. Take a picture of a handwritten or printed expression, and the calculator recognizes it and inserts it into the display, ready to be edited or evaluated. (premium)
A step-by-step solution shows how an expression is solved, one step at a time, from the entered expression to the final result. Every step is explained, so you can see not only the result, but also the way to it. (more detailed steps are premium)
Calculation details give you extended information about the result - alternative forms of the result, all complex roots, the unit circle, properties of a function and more.
The calculator has several layouts suitable for various screen sizes:
- "pocket" for small devices
- "compact" for smartphones (in portrait and landscape orientation)
- "expanded" for tablets
Users can choose from several high-quality themes.
The calculator has many functions, such as:
- up to 100 digits of significand and 9 digits of exponent
- basic arithmetic operations including percentage, modulo and negation
- fractions and mixed numbers
- periodic numbers and their conversion to fractions
- unlimited number of braces
- operator priority
- repeated operations
- selecting a part of an expression and applying context operations to the selection
- equations (with one or more variables, systems of equations)
- variables and symbolic computation
- derivatives and integrals
- graphs of functions, equations, integral area and limits; 3D graphs
- matrices and vectors
- statistics
- regression analysis
- complex numbers
- conversion between rectangular and polar coordinates
- sums and products of series
- limits
- advanced number operations such as random numbers, combinations, permutations, common greatest divisor, etc.
- trigonometric and hyperbolic functions
- powers, roots, logarithms, etc.
- degrees, minutes and seconds conversion
- fixed point, scientific and engineering display format
- display exponent as SI units prefix
- memory operations with unlimited extended memories
- clipboard operations with various clipboard formats
- result history
- multiline display on tablets showing the complete history of calculations and access to the previous results
- binary, octal and hexadecimal numeral systems
- logical operations
- bitwise shifts and rotations
- more than 120 physical and mathematical constants
- conversion among 250 units
- Reverse Polish notation.
The calculator has many settings to manage the calculation precision, decimal and thousand separators, etc.
All features are described with a built-in help.
Privacy Policy: https://hiperlabs.eu/privacy-policy/iOS.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00035754:ios.description:
Orb Master is a real-time PVP game that battles between players.

Message from the developer:
It’s a pleasure to introduce Orb Master here.
Let's talk about who we are first.
We are a very young game development team like a baby in this industry. We hope that Orb Master and us can grow into capable adults together.
We strive to be creative and unique. We always try to make a unique game. That’s how Orb Master is made.
We have designed 44 Orbs with different special skills. By forming different lineups, you can have different strategies. 
-We hope that players will feel relaxed when playing this game after working and studying. So we make it easy to get the Orbs. Even the newbie can easily obtain Legendary Orbs by playing Co-op with experienced players.
-We think that traditional tower defense game is boring because there is no PVP mode
You can defeat the other players in a game within 3 minutes. Also, you can defeat the monsters with friends in Co-op mode.
-We want to have flexible strategies in different modes
There are PVP mode, Co-op mode, Grand Prix, and Infinite Firepower, etc. Different strategies and lineups for different modes.
We still have many ideas to be developed for this game. Stay tuned.
What’s more, we think your feedback is important too. The player and developer can make a better game together. We are looking forward to your contribution.
Every Orb is weak alone, but when they stand together, they are invincible.
Have fun!

bluejetty:00184971:ios.name: Podomatic Podcast Player
bluejetty:00184971:ios.summary: Tune in to the world's largest community of podcasters and DJs with the Podomatic podcast player! Discover the best in talk radio and house music mixes - or find your new favorite podcast with our categories feature! From christian to tech
bluejetty:00184971:ios.description:
Tune in to the world's largest community of podcasters and DJs with the Podomatic podcast player! Discover the best in talk radio and house music mixes - or find your new favorite podcast with our categories feature! From christian to tech podcasts, club music to soundtracks, Podomatic has the whole spectrum covered - every podcast niche at your fingertips.
With over 5 million podcast episodes and mixes published, The Podomatic Podcast Player makes it easy to tap into any one of those episodes quickly so that you have the best in podcast entertainment whenever, wherever.
The Trending section will keep you up-to-date on what's hot on the Podomatic network. Sort by city to find local podcasters in your area.
Create playlists to group your favorite podcasts & music mixes.
The best in podcasts, all for free!
Key Features: 
- Offline Mode - Take your favorite podcasts and mixes offline wherever you go! If you’re on a podcast or any list containing episodes, swipe the episode item from right to left, and tap on the download “cloud” icon to begin the syncing process. You can find the progress of your download in the swiped episode view, or in the Player view if you’ve downloaded the episode from within the Player. 
To access podcasts that you’ve downloaded, just go to Following, and tap on the top right folder icon. Your downloaded episodes will be listed for you in alphabetical order.
- Feed - A dynamic social feed that gives you updates on followed podcasts and Facebook Friends. See new episodes from podcasts you follow and what podcasts your Facebook Friends follow and like. You’ll even get notified when the podcasters you love release new content.
- Circular Player - Easily scrobble through an episode and enjoy instant feedback with the all new new circular player. Comment, like, share, or add an episode to a playlist. Download the episode, scrobble forward and backward, change the episode speed, add a sleep timer, or download the episode to save and listen to on your commute, or when you’re on the go.
- Mini Player - Play an episode, then minimize the player to keep the episode playing in the background with the all new Mini Player. You can pause and play the episode from here while you navigate through the app. 
- Episode Swipe - swipe an episode in a list to preview, download, or get more info on an episode.
- Preview Player - On a list view, tap on the top right ‘Preview All’ button to initiate the 90 second Preview Player for all episodes in a list. 
- Discover - Get real time insights into what podcasts are trending in the Podomatic social sphere. Re-discover your favorite categories and talk show topics, or find your new favorite show or series. An intuitive discovery platform along with full search capabilities make it easy to find the podcast or playlist you’re looking for.
- Friend Profile - See an aggregated view of podcasts your friend follows, their playlists, and episodes they’ve liked. If they have a podcast, that will show up here too. 
- Notifications - Get notified when a podcaster publishes a new episode, or when a new Facebook Friend joins Podomatic.

bluejetty:00135402:ios.name: Daily Supplications
bluejetty:00135402:ios.summary:
Daily Supplications enables you to read and listen to more than 300 different islamic duaas everyday. It also features prayer times, Hijri date, qibla and custom reminders to give you the right supplication at the right time.
Main feature
bluejetty:00135402:ios.description:
Daily Supplications enables you to read and listen to more than 300 different islamic duaas everyday. It also features prayer times, Hijri date, qibla and custom reminders to give you the right supplication at the right time.
Main features:
• Duaas and Hadiths to read everyday with counters to help you keep track of what you've read (click on the counter each time you read a supplication. The app will save the number of times you've read a supplication and reset the counters at midnight).
• Supplications to read on special occasions.
• Salat times with auto calculation depending on your location (you can choose your city manually or by GPS).
• Step by step Prayer tutorial.
• Quran.
• Qibla.
• Tasbih.
• 99 Names of Allah.
• Tracker.
• Reminder for fasting supplications when Maghrib prayer in Ramadhan.
• The app can help you read and finish the Quran during Ramadhan.
• Supplications' audio. The audio can be downloaded and cached for offline playback (read a supplication the first time with internet, so that it is cached for offline playback later).
• Translation, Transliteration & References for all the supplications.
• Translation & Transliteration for the Quran (can be enabled from the settings).
• Widget for daily supplications.
• The possibility to mark supplications as favorite so you can find them easily.
• A search functionality to easily find the right supplication in no time.
• Alarms to remind you of your daily supplications (these alarms can be deactivated from the settings).
• Custom reminders to help you do your important tasks (read sourat AlKahf every Friday or fast on Mondays and Thursdays for example) or to remind you of a certain supplication at a certain time.
• Notifications at Salat times with the possibility to choose from different athans.
• Islamic Calendar (Hijri Date) with the different Islamic events.
The App, the Quran, the adhkars and duaas are entirely translated to English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish, Indonesian, Turkish, Italian and Arabic.
Follow us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/dailyislamicduaas

bluejetty:00015411:ios.name: Little Kitten: Pet Cat School
bluejetty:00015411:ios.summary:
Created with Primary School Teachers to be Fun & Educational!
5/5: Educational App Store
92/100: A primary school teacher that uses the app with her class said "The animation and gameplay are wonderful and our users (pupils) fell in love wi
bluejetty:00015411:ios.description:
Created with Primary School Teachers to be Fun & Educational!
5/5: Educational App Store
92/100: A primary school teacher that uses the app with her class said "The animation and gameplay are wonderful and our users (pupils) fell in love with Little Kitten!" 
"It’s great fun! Our users benefited from the vast array of games and loved that the hallway could be explored. Each time our users played the game they found something else."
"Little Kitten is a great way for children to interact with a series of fun and educational games. Once the application has been used regularly parents can leave their children unsupported." 
"This certainly could be used in schools" 
App Description:
Yay, Little Kitten is back and so excited about going to primary school! Our app „Little Kitten“ helps preparing children aged between 4 and 7 for their school start. Training perception, coordination and cognitive abilities - with Little Kitten this is a lot of fun!
In 8 educational games, children learn social and motor skills. The teacher Ms. Fox lovingly guides the children through their first lessons. Confident children and parents without worries - we'll get you ready for school!
Little Kitten Preschool Learning Games:
8 adorable mini games where you and Little Kitten solve puzzles and tasks together.
1.Animal Shadow Game:
Bat, crocodile or elephant? Do you recognize animals only by their shape? This game helps to enhance cognitive abilities and grows in difficulty as the game progresses.
2.Paint Game:
Color in the animal shapes but don't go over the edge! This game is about creativity and fine motor skills - the various forms increase with difficulty and require hand-eye coordination to stay within the shape, this control helps to improve children’s writing skills. 
3.Trampoline Game:
What trick is Little Kitten thinking of? Be quick to recognize the trick and tell the others so they can pull it off together! A game for improving visual perception and reaction speed.
4.Bubble Game:
Match the pictures to the themes! What can you eat and what shouldn't you? This game is about logic and pattern recognition.
5.Recycling Game:
Learn to sort and recycle various types of rubbish and develop a sense of responsibility. Kids love the funny monster bins!
6.Hop Scotch Game:
Help Little Kitten hop in the right order! Do you remember it? This game enhances concentration, sound and visual memory. There are Easy, Medium & Hard modes to provide the right amount of challenge for every child.
7.Count & Sums Game:
How many arms does an octopus have? How many is it missing? Learn to count from 1 to 10 and to perceive amounts visually - which pile looks bigger? Children start to develop mathematical skills, an important part of their cognitive ability.
8.AR Game (only for AR compatible devices):
Find the crackers in Little Kitten’s Box! Spatial awareness and coordination will be improved.
Other Features:
•Feeding Game: Each mini game has a unique cracker reward, play all the learning games to collect them and feed them to Kitten to watch Kitten's special reaction to each!
•Voice Acted in 14 Languages!: Touch the world map and choose from any of 14 supported languages, now Miss Fox's voice will talk you through every mini-game in your chosen language, you can even give her a tap to hear a tip any time. Once your child knows all the mini-games in their native language this is a great way for them to pick up words in a new language!

App Description:
Yay, Little Kitten is back and so excited about going to primary school! Our app „Little Kitten“ helps preparing children aged between 4 and 7 for their school start. Training perception, coordination and cognitive abilities - with Little Kitten this is a lot of fun!
 
In 8 educational games, children learn social and motor skills. The teacher Ms. Fox lovingly guides the children through their first lessons. Confident children and parents without worries - we'll get you ready for school!

Little Kitten Preschool Learning Games:
8 adorable mini games where you and Little Kitten solve puzzles and tasks together.
 
1.Animal Shadow Game:
Bat, crocodile or elephant? Do you recognize animals only by their shape? This game helps to enhance cognitive abilities and grows in difficulty as the game progresses.
 
2.Paint Game:
Color in the animal shapes but don't go over the edge! This game is about creativity and fine motor skills - the various forms increase with difficulty and require hand-eye coordination to stay within the shape, this control helps to improve children’s writing skills. 

3.Trampoline Game:
What trick is Little Kitten thinking of? Be quick to recognize the trick and tell the others so they can pull it off together!  A game for improving visual perception and reaction speed.
 
4.Bubble Game:
Match the pictures to the themes! What can you eat and what shouldn't you? This game is about logic and pattern recognition.
 
5.Recycling Game:
Learn to sort and recycle various types of rubbish and develop a sense of responsibility. Kids love the funny monster bins!
 
6.Hop Scotch Game:
Help Little Kitten hop in the right order! Do you remember it? This game enhances concentration, sound and visual memory. There are Easy, Medium & Hard modes to provide the right amount of challenge for every child.
 
7.Count & Sums Game:
How many arms does an octopus have? How many is it missing? Learn to count from 1 to 10 and to perceive amounts visually - which pile looks bigger? Children start to develop mathematical skills, an important part of their cognitive ability.
 
8.AR Game (only for AR compatible devices):
Find the crackers in Little Kitten’s Box! Spatial awareness and coordination will be improved.

Why is ConfirmTkt the best app for IRCTC train ticket booking?
IRCTC Bookings with Easy IRCTC Login
● Get Confirmed Train Tickets with Waitlist Prediction and the Same Train Alternates feature.
● You can easily use your existing IRCTC login credentials for train ticket booking on the ConfirmTkt train app.
● Full refund on IRCTC ticket cancellation.
● Alternates feature that combines train and train, bus and train to give you a confirmed ticket to travel.
● Recover forgotten IRCTC or register a new IRCTC user id easily. Reset the IRCTC password in the app.
● Supports General Quota, Ladies, Tatkal, Lower Berth/Sr. Citizen quotas.
● IRCTC Vikalp Option available to help you get Confirm Train Ticket.
● 24x7 customer support; for any IRCTC train booking & enquiry related queries, call 08068243910.
PNR Status & Waitlist Predictions of Train Tickets
You can check the PNR Status of your IRCTC train ticket on the ConfirmTkt app. In addition, you can get instant notifications of any changes in PNR status and your train timings or route. If your ticket is on the waitlist, you can also see the prediction of getting your train ticket confirmed. Also, you can check for any hidden confirm tickets through ConfirmTkt same train alternates.
Train Booking Recommendation: We highly recommend you prepare for alternatives if the ConfirmTkt prediction of your train ticket is a low chance and you cannot find any confirmed ticket through ConfirmTkt's same train alternate feature.
You can also book flights and buses on ConfirmTkt & get great deals. You can also book hotels from a wide range of options available on the app.
IRCTC Live Train Running Status
After booking IRCTC train tickets on the ConfirmTkt app, you can quickly check your train running status and get live updates of your train. So you can plan a smooth train journey with the ConfirmTkt train app.
Some of the frequently asked queries that we get from our train ticket booking users:
1. How ConfirmTkt increases your chance of getting a confirmed train ticket?
With ConfirmTkt same train alternates, you can find hidden confirm train tickets by changing your boarding/dropping point. With ConfirmTkt's accurate prediction, even if the ticket is on the waitlist, your ticket will get confirmed if the ConfirmTkt forecast is green, so go ahead and book your train ticket with assurance.
2. Does ConfirmTkt Guarantee Confirm Train Ticket?
No, ConfirmTkt does not guarantee you a confirmed train ticket. But instead, it increases your chance of getting a confirmed train ticket powered by the same train alternates and prediction.
3. How many days in advance can a train ticket be booked for any route?
Train tickets can be booked 60 days in advance on the ConfirmTkt app.
We are the official train ticketing partner of the Royal Challengers Bengaluru. Also, we are a principal service provider for IRCTC, and IRCTC has its app as IRCTC Rail Connect. Indian Railways has also launched its SuperApp named ‘RailOne’ recently.
Note: IRCTC is often misspelt as irtc, itctc, or irtct. IRCTC : Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation
For queries/feedback on IRCTC train ticket booking: support@confirmtkt.com

• Reading: Read the Holy Quran from the Madinah Mushaf (Hafs 1st, 2nd, and 3rd editions), Warsh, Qaloon, Doori, Shoba, Indonesian Mushaf, Indopak Mushaf (13 & 15 lines Nastaliq), Shamarly, Jamahiri, Libya, Algeria, and more.

bluejetty:00187781:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00187781:ios.description:
Send a fax from your iPhone or iPad in minutes. No fax machine, no landline, no trip to a print shop.
Scan paper with your camera, sign it, add pages from Files or your cloud storage, and fax it as one clean document. Follow the delivery status of every fax in History.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add pages: scan paper documents with the built-in scanner, pick photos, or import PDF, Word, Pages and other files.
2. Prepare: crop, adjust brightness and contrast, add your signature or remove pages.
3. Send: enter the fax number and tap Send. The country is detected from the number, and the delivery status appears in History.
WHEN YOU STILL NEED A FAX
• Doctor's offices, pharmacies and insurance claims
• Banks, tax forms and government agencies
• Signed contracts, leases and HR paperwork
• Schools, courts and real estate offers
FEATURES
• Document scanner with automatic edge detection
• Draw your signature and place it on any page
• Import from Files, iCloud Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive
• Supports PDF, Word, Pages, Numbers, PowerPoint (.pptx), text files and photos (JPEG, PNG, HEIC and more), up to 50 pages per file
• Combine scans, photos and files into a single fax
• Fax to the US, Canada and other countries
• Fax history with delivery status
• Resend any previous fax from History
• No ads
SUBSCRIPTION
Smart Fax is free to download. Sending faxes requires a Smart Fax Premium subscription. Choose a weekly, monthly or yearly plan; each includes a page allowance of up to 50 pages per week, 200 pages per month or 2,500 pages per year. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe and may vary by country.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it at any time in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.
Privacy Policy: https://smart-mobile-apps.com/smart-fax/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://smart-mobile-apps.com/smart-fax/terms.html
Support: https://smart-mobile-apps.com/smart-fax/support.html

bluejetty:00143896:ios.summary:

◆You will enjoy your mate
bluejetty:00143896:ios.description:
◆You will receive daily information about your pregnancy and baby based on the number of days of your pregnancy.
◆During pregnancy, you can feel the growth of the baby in your belly with messages and illustrations.
◆You will enjoy your maternity life with peace of mind and resolve questions and concerns about pregnancy.
For your partner, we recommend the app "Papa ninaru," which is specially designed for dads.
It helps dads understand pregnancy, childbirth and unborn babies. 
"Ninaru" and "Papa ninaru" will make your pregnant life fun and exciting! 
All functions of the apps are free of charge!
【FEATURES】
◆Counter for the number of days and weeks of pregnancy 
When you open the app, you can see how many days until your due date at a glance. You can set the counter from 0 weeks and 0 days, which is your last menstrual period.
◆Daily Messages
You will receive a message about your pregnancy and baby every day. All messages are supervised by obstetricians and gynecologists.
◆New Articles according to the number of days of pregnancy
Morning sickness, weight control, fetal movement, prenatal care, naming, labor, childbirth, and more... You'll find articles in the "New Articles" section that answer all your questions and concerns about pregnancy.
◆Baby Kick Counter and Contraction Counter
When you start to feel a fetal movement, use a "Baby Kick Counter." Also, when you start having contractions, you can measure the interval between contractions by using a "Contraction Counter." You'll be able to see your contraction history.
◆Maternal Supplies List
There are a lot of things to prepare for during pregnancy and childbirth. You can check the "Maternal Supplies List" and know what you need to buy and when.
◆Pregnancy Schedule
The "Pregnancy Schedule" lets you see what you need to do and when, during pregnancy.
◆Cute illustrations of babies
The baby illustrations change every day, so you can see and feel the growth of your unborn baby! 
◆Stories of other pregnant women's experiences
You can read the experiences of others according to the number of weeks. There is a lot of information on morning sickness, fetal movement, recommended pregnancy and childcare goods, etc.
◆Search function
You can search for information about pregnancy, childbirth and babies from over 3,500 articles.
◆All for free!
【REVIEWS】
・"When I had bad morning sickness, the daily messages of the app cheered me up!"
・"I used to watch ninaru with my husband every day, and it seemed to make him feel like a father from the time I was pregnant."
・"It is very easy to read and use, and I look forward to opening it every day!"
・"This was my first pregnancy, and I was worried about everything, but there was a wealth of information that was easy to understand, and I was able to face the birth with peace of mind."
【FROM THE STAFF】
Pregnancy and childbirth are very precious experiences for most of us.
We hope that you enjoy this special period of pregnancy with your newborn baby.
Especially for those who are experiencing pregnancy and childbirth for the first time, 
there are so many things you don't know.
"Can't we support pregnant women with more accurate and appropriate information?"
With this in mind, we created "ninaru" and "Papa ninaru."
We will provide you with the information and articles every day during your pregnancy.
We hope that this app will be useful to you in your pregnant life.
 【CONTACT INFORMATION】
If you are unable to start up the app, please contact us at the following email address: ninaru@eversense.co.jp
If you are able to start up the app, please contact us through the Settings in the app.
"Ninaru" was ranked number one in the AppStore Medical Ranking on August 13, 2018!
One in two mothers who gave birth for the first time in 2017 used "ninaru."
(Calculated from the results of the ninaru user survey and the "Demographic Statistics" released by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare (as of July 2018))

- Пополнение счетов и карт
- Круглосуточный доступ к выпискам и истории операций
- Анализ финансов для планирования расходов
- Настройка лимитов внутри MBANK и по каждой карте отдельно с учетом ваших потребностей
- Временная блокировка карты в один клик
- Выгодные условия по карточным продуктам
- Открытие физических карт MBANK Gold от Visa и Mastercard в национальной и иностранных валютах
- Выпуск карт в картоматах
- Заказ карт Premium Visa, Visa Infinite, World Elite Mastercard в национальной и иностранных валютах
- Доставка карты в удобное для вас место
- Открытие виртуальных карт для безопасных онлайн-покупок
- Сервис управления подписками
- Просмотр CVV-кода прямо в приложении
Сервисы MBANK
- Покупка и продажа драгоценных металлов
- Бронирование онлайн-очереди для посещения офисов
- Контроль и оплата коммунальных услуг в «Мой Дом»
- Звонок в контакт-центр в приложении
- Сервис «Убери авто» для отправки уведомления владельцам автомобилей
- Обновление паспортных данных без посещения офиса
Кредиты и депозиты
- Получение онлайн-кредитов до 500 000 сом и открытие онлайн-депозитов в приложении за несколько секунд с выгодными процентными ставками
- Цифровая ипотека
- Автокредитование
- Просмотр кредитного рейтинга
- Уведомление о наличии просроченной задолженности
- Товары и услуги в рассрочку без переплат с М+
- Кредитная линия с возможностью оформления нескольких покупок в рассрочку
- Товары и услуги у партнёров сервиса без переплат
Госуслуги
- Электронная запись в школы
- Онлайн-бронирование очередей в ЦОН и поликлиники
- Регистрация юридического лица онлайн: ИП и ОсОО
- Страхование автомобиля (ОСАГО, КАСКО), проверка штрафов, оформление тонировки, сервис CarCheck

- Электронная цифровая подпись (ЭЦП)
- Доступ к информационной системе «Базар»
- Проверка наличия запрета на въезд в РФ
MJunior — мобильный банкинг для детей
- Открытие банковской карты с дизайном для ребенка
- Контроль финансов с возможностью настройки индивидуальных лимитов ребенка
- Создание заданий от родителей для своего ребенка
- Открытие копилки для формирования финансовой грамотности и навыков управления деньгами

Adasat application offers the largest selection of colored contact lenses and prescription transparent contact lenses from well-known brands to become a pioneer in the contact lenses’ field and the first in the Middle East.

• The application is in two languages English and Arabic.
• It is the easiest application of Arabic origin of its kind specialized in selling colored and prescription contact lenses and everything that is related to the beauty of the eye, where it provides all types of colored and prescription contact lenses displayed in a unique and distinctive way.
• Browsing pictures of contact lenses’ brands with the best quality and clarity.
• Famous contact lenses brands favored by many celebrities worldwide.
• The ability to browse all products by the brand, color, replacement periods or by the best-selling, or by the prices; from lowest to highest and vice versa, or according to the newest product.
• Full description of the products’ characteristics and the ability to enlarge the photos. 
• You can add the product to the wish list and purchase it later.
• The ability to modify your account’s settings.
• Awareness videos about contact lenses.
• You can share the product you like with your friends through (Whatsapp, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and e-mail).
• Choose your payment methods (KNET, Visa, MasterCard, Cash on Delivery).
• The Customer Service team is available to respond to your inquiries and questions.
• Do not forget to register your information and set up an account for you to get our offers and to check what is new in the colored and prescription contact lenses fashion.
• We are ready to know your opinions and suggestions by contacting us through our application available in the * Contact Us section.
• We guarantee our products are 100% original.

bluejetty:00026554:ios.description:
Congratulations! You’ve been elected Mayor of Disaster Town! 
Your task is to construct the city of your dreams on the most accident-prone stretch of land on the planet! The whole place is a magnet for trouble, but the rent is cheap and the view is just spectacular!
Your loyal legion of minions are ready to fly into action. The more you can mitigate the disaster damage, the more people will flock to your town, bringing their votes and money with them!
So manage your investments wisely as you grow the city, collect taxes, earn (and lose) votes, and brace for the worst. After all, you are not going to let a few major disasters ruin your popularity during election year, are you?
Get ready for disaster!
Running the world’s unluckiest city is not easy! It’s up to you to keep investing in infrastructure, disaster prevention and services to keep your citizens happy (and alive).
Compete and collaborate with other Mayors!
Join limited time events and compete with other players to top the leaderboards and earn exclusive rewards to satisfy your civilians!
A city so good it almost runs itself!
The city never sleeps, but you do! So feel free to take a break and let your staff run things while you are away. You can always take credit for it when you get back!
Grow a run-down city into a thriving metropolis!
It’s going to take more than a couple natural (and unnatural) disasters to stop you from turning your hometown into the city of your dreams!
