bluejetty:00129155:ios.description:
The Learner's Test App offers the most advanced test system to your device offering practice +370 up to-date questions.
With this application you will make progress more quickly than with any other traditional method, as you can take the tests wherever and whenever you want, without the need to be connected: at the bus stop, in a bar, in the classroom, at work or at the dentist’s waiting room!
The application is divided into the following sections:
* Driver Knowledge Test - DKT:
Perform a simulation under the same conditions as the official RTA test. To pass the exam learner are required to answer at least 12 DKT questions correctly among the 15 general knowledge questions and at least 29 correctly among the 30 road safety question.
* Practice by Topics:
Test your knowledge by practicing by categories. The bank of questions from the RTA is divided into 10 categories, these are:
- General Knowledge section
- Alcohol and Drugs
- Fatigue and Defensive Driving
- Intersections
- Traffic Lights and Lanes
- Negligent Driving
- Pedestrians
- Seat Belts and Restraints
- Speed Limits
- Traffic Signs
You can select one or more categories to practice. You can also perform rapid tests for 10, 20 or 30 questions.
* Progress Monitor:
The application saves the result of each question answered and a history of failures and successes to offer the most advanced system of all the statistics.
*** Application Features ***
- Intelligent learning system: The questions are selected using an algorithm taking into account your latest scores and the questions that you need to practice more.
- Modern and easy to use interface with features including:-
~ Test simulator
~ Practice by category
~ Statistics module to track and monitor your progress

bluejetty:00131304:ios.description:
With the belief in free speech and individual liberty for all, we are on a mission to protect a free and open internet, starting with TUSK, a secure web browser with an anti-censorship search engine, built-in news feed and now, the marketplaces’ first Conservative AI chatbot called Gippr.
Free Speech Web Browser with Anti-Censorship Search Engine and News Feed
** Now including the first Conservative chatbot called Gippr; an artificial intelligence (AI) chat that provides the TRUTH, without liberal bias! Ask questions or discuss various topics without having to worry about the woke agenda. Try out the Gippr today! ** 
What is TUSK? Built from the ground up to ensure people can access the information and stories that matter, free of liberal bias, TUSK features the first and only free speech search engine and anti-censorship news feed to show you all the real stories, even the ones that get buried.
How it works: 
With TUSK’s built-in Search Engine and News Feed, you can easily access all the articles from popular media organizations that you trust, such as, Fox News, New York Post, Newsmax, OANN, The Daily Wire, Breitbart, and many others. No more buried stories or media censorship! TUSK Search features easy-to-use RIGHT, LEFT and CENTER buttons so you can filter the organic search results easily. Missing your favorite news source? Easily customize the relevant news publishers you want to see in the TUSK News Feed and on your homepage, this way you have 100% control. No other news feed has built-in predictive AI to show you the articles that everyone is engaged with right now, as well as the breaking stories that will matter most in the hours and minutes ahead. TUSK remains committed to giving you the clarity and insight that no other search and news source can. 
TUSK Search is also great for schools, education and research with search result transparency that lets you see all sides easily. 
TUSK is also available on desktop and laptop computers running macOS or Windows.

Wild Minds: Manifestation, Meditation & Moon Rituals 
Find your rhythm. Follow the moon. Manifest your dreams. 
Wild Minds is your sacred space for daily spiritual connection—designed to help you come home to yourself, one practice at a time. Whether you’re setting intentions with the new moon, tuning into your breath, or pulling an oracle card for guidance, this is the app for dreamers, seekers, and soulful creators.

Created by Molly Williams—host of the top 2% global podcast Molly’s Mornings—Wild Minds has supported thousands on their journey of alignment, healing, and abundance. With 200+ 5-star reviews and a heart-centered global community, this is more than an app. It’s a sacred practice. 
Note: all features of Wild Minds requires a purchased subscription to be available to use.

bluejetty:00086657:ios.description:
• Єдині офіційні державні тести з ПДР для підготовки до теоретичного іспиту в Україні.
• Найновіші тестові питання та ілюстрації, які на 100% відповідають питанням на іспиті в Сервісному центрі МВС.
• Щоденне оновлення бази питань з офіційного реєстру питань МВС (НАІС). Щойно з'являються оновлення в державній базі, вони відразу відображаються в нашому додатку.
• Зміни у питаннях з 19.01.2023.
• Всі останні зміни прийнятi постановою КМУ № 1091 від 29.09.2021.
• Більше 2000 питань з коментарями від викладачів автошкіл.
• Можливість задати будь-яке запитання, що Вас цікавить, та отримати оперативну відповідь від кваліфікованих фахівців.
Ми нарешті запустили модуль дистанційного навчання. Вже щосили почали з'являтися курси з різних тем ПДР від викладачів автошкіл.
Дорогі друзі!
У базі тестових питань відбулося оновлення. Виправлені старі недоліки, а також додано незначну частину нових питань. Хоч оновлення і носять виключно "косметичний" хараткер, але ми не могли Вас не проінформувати!
Деякі інші додатки, які заявляють, що їхні тестові завдання є офіційними, заводять Вас в оману. У них видозмінені ілюстрації та розміщений неактуальний текст. Готуючись за такими додатками, на офіційному іспиті Ви можете збентежитися і просто не скласти його.
Абсолютно кожна людина уявляла себе за кермом автомобіля. Для здійснення цієї мрії треба не так вже й багато: достатньо піти на курси в автошколу, вивчити Правила дорожнього руху України (ПДР), навчитися водити автомобіль на практиці та зрештою, склавши іспити, отримати водійське посвідчення. Зважаючи на кількість аварій на дорогах країни, а також на їхні причини, можна дійти висновку, що підготовка сучасних водіїв залишає бажати кращого. Ні для кого не секрет, як одержують «права» в автошколі. На жаль, викорінення корупції в Україні знаходиться лише на початковому етапі. Але позитивні тенденції у цьому напрямку є. Нині функція прийняття іспиту на право керування автомобілем покладена на Головний сервісний центр України (ГСЦ). Спеціалісти центру представили громадськості абсолютно нову та унікальну систему тестування водіїв-початківців. Ми, у свою чергу, дуже тісно співпрацювали з ними, намагалися допомогти їм якнайскоріше втілити напрацювання та, нарешті, прийняти на законодавчому рівні зовсім нову, вдосконалену і таку, що відповідає європейським стандартам, програму тестування.
Наш додаток «Офiцiйнi Тести ПДР» спрямований на якісну підготовку майбутніх українських автомобілістів. Над запитаннями тестів не один рік працювали фахівці та викладачі провідних автошкіл України. У цих запитаннях використовуються тільки фотореалістичні 3D-ілюстрації, що імітують реальні ситуації на дорозі. 
У 2026 року дороги України мають стати безпечнішими! Сподіваємося, що за допомогою цього додатку ми зможемо виховати не один мільйон дійсно висококласних водіїв!
Умови використання: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00031722:ios.summary: Alternating soothing & energetic music, you will access a sacred, meditative space where breathing, movement and flow harmoniously and gracefully come together. From sculpting to stretching, you will have access to more than 100 videos on d
bluejetty:00031722:ios.description:
Alternating soothing & energetic music, you will access a sacred, meditative space where breathing, movement and flow harmoniously and gracefully come together. From sculpting to stretching, you will have access to more than 100 videos on demand. These include 2/3 new workout video uploads every week in different lengths and difficulty plus bonus short workouts to do anytime and wellness/food talks to help you thrive.
Your thoughts, self-love, body image and lifestyle will be transformed. You will learn to move your body in your most caring, feminine and authentic way. Most importantly, you will fall in love with your lifestyle.
Swan by Carolina is committed to empower women to thrive and transform into the best version of themselves, to embrace every part of who they are, to discover and own their own unique, beautiful selves.
Carolina Lopez Tejero (aka gogloow) is a certified yoga and pilates instructor, as well as a psychologist and a wellness nutritional coach. She is a firm believer that a little goes a long way and what matters is that you stay consistent. Carolina shares with you her best tips to help you start in building a routine. Start without expectations, start because you want to develop a better version of you, and build from there. The rest will come to you. Wait and see the magic happen.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Swan by Carolina on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
All payments will be paid through your account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment.Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://app.swanbycarolina.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://app.swanbycarolina.com/privacy

bluejetty:00162033:ios.description:
► Hex-traordinary Fun
Looking for a simple yet difficult puzzle that will both help you relax AND train your brain? Color Slide is your one stop shop for all of that and more! Sort and color match hexagons across the playing field, merging colors and making room for more pieces to appear. As you do so your stress will just slip away!
► Hex-cellent Work 
What might seem simple at first gets progressively more difficult and challenging as you progress and more colors of hexagons appear, and the playing field changes shape to make maneuvers trickier. And yet, you’ll soon find yourself feeling cool as a cucumber and less stressed as you focus on the puzzle and not on life’s frustrations. So get ready for some color sorting fun and dive right into this delightfully colorful mindgame!
► Hex-ational Features
Progressive difficulty – With each level this color puzzle becomes more and more difficult. Multi colored blocks, new colors, funky shaped playing fields, and more will force you to really slow down and focus in order to properly organize all the hexagons by color and win the round. As soon as you master one skill you’ll be presented with a new one to keep things exciting!
Ageless entertainment – Whether you’re 5 or 95, you’ll be able to happily play this brain game. With no timer and no penalties you can try levels over and over again until you get them right if need be, or put the game down for a bit and come back later to keep trying.
Chill graphics – No bouncy shapes, excessive vibrations, or explosions of color – we created this game to help you relax and that means simple but enjoyable graphics so that your eyes and brain aren’t distracted. This also makes the game great for kids since they won’t get overstimulated by all the crazy images.
Relaxing gameplay – In keeping with the graphics, the game in general is built around the goal of helping you let go of stress. Stop and start at any moment, and don’t fret about points or goals. Just kick back and relax, and help your mind relax as you focus on the simple task of sorting colored hexagons.
► Hexagon-a be Great
Casual players and puzzle aficionados alike will adore this relaxing logic puzzle game. With no countdown clock or penalties, you can take your time carefully matching up the colored tiles to clear the board as you also clear your mind. Before you know if you’ll be a color master, whizzing through levels with ease even as they get progressively more challenging – download Color Slide today to get matching and relaxing!

bluejetty:00095916:ios.summary: Feeling lost at the gym? Tired of guessing how to use a machine or paying for a personal trainer who doesn't pay attention? Gymeo is the revolution in your exercise routine — the AI gym workout app that guides you every step of the way, fro
bluejetty:00095916:ios.description:
Feeling lost at the gym? Tired of guessing how to use a machine or paying for a personal trainer who doesn't pay attention? Gymeo is the revolution in your exercise routine — the AI gym workout app that guides you every step of the way, from day one. Forget the frustration and start training smarter.
Your AI Personal Trainer, Always in Your Pocket
Gymeo is more than just an exercise tracker; it's an AI-powered workout partner, designed for people who want to maximize their results without uncertainty. Our unique approach is the definitive solution for beginners and anyone looking to improve their technique, strength, nutrition, and consistency.
Key Features to Drive Your Goals:
NEW — Gymeo Coach, Your AI Personal Trainer: Meet the smartest coach in fitness. Gymeo Coach analyzes every set, tracks your progression, and delivers personalized, real-time guidance during your workouts. It learns how you train and adapts to your goals — whether you want to gain muscle, get stronger, or stay consistent. It's like having an elite strength coach in your pocket, 24/7.
NEW — Calorie & Macro Tracking: Know if what you eat is actually helping your goal. Snap a photo of your meal and Gymeo estimates its calories and macros for you. Don’t want to take a photo? Simply describe what you’re eating and Gymeo can log it for you.
NEW — Water & Supplement Tracking: Keep your nutrition routine in one place. Track how much water you drink throughout the day and keep track of the supplements you take alongside your meals and workouts.
NEW — Muscle Fatigue Tracking: Know exactly which muscles are recovered and which need rest. Plan smarter splits, avoid overtraining, and maximize every session with intelligent fatigue analysis after every workout.
NEW - Integrates with Apple Health: reads sleep and heart-rate data to adapt your workouts, and saves your completed workouts to Health.
AI Machine Identification: Just take a photo of any gym machine. Our AI will instantly recognize it and provide all the information you need to use it correctly. No more guesswork.
Perfect Technique, Every Time: Access detailed instructional videos that show you the correct form for each exercise. Get step-by-step guides, tips to avoid injuries, and lists of common mistakes so you can train safely and effectively.

bluejetty:00015618:ios.description:
(O PUCRS Mobile é o aplicativo oficial da PUCRS)
Para os alunos de Graduação e Stricto Sensu, este aplicativo permitirá que sejam visualizadas as notas do semestre atual e anteriores, enviando notificações para os alunos quando há publicação ou alteração de notas. Também permitirá que sejam consultados os horários e locais das disciplinas matriculadas. Para os professores, poderá ser realizada a chamada da turma através do aplicativo.
Está disponível, para os alunos de Graduação, Lato e Stricto Sensu, o acesso ao cartão acadêmico virtual, ele permite acessar os serviços da Universidade como o estacionamento. Para esses alunos, também é possível consultar o extrato financeiro com a instituição, permitindo gerar a segunda via do boleto pendente quando disponível.
Para os alunos, professores, técnicos ou colaboradores da PUCRS e funcionários do Tecnopuc, estão ainda disponíveis a consulta aos empréstimos da Biblioteca, a renovação de livros e verificação da disponibilidade de reservas, consultar a lotação atual dos estacionamentos da PUCRS, o saldo do seu cartão de estudante ou o crachá da PUCRS para uso no estacionamento e ainda manter-se atualizado sobre as novidades da PUCRS.

Write Flawlessly Anywhere. Your All-in-One AI Writing Assistant & Keyboard.
Ready to elevate your writing and communicate with absolute confidence? Grammar Check Corrector by AI is more than just a spell checker—it is a comprehensive writing companion integrated directly into your iOS keyboard. Whether you are drafting a high-stakes work email, writing an academic essay, or sending a quick message, our advanced AI ensures your words are impactful, professional, and error-free.
No need to copy and paste between apps. Simply enable the AI Keyboard and get real-time corrections and smart suggestions in any app you use!
CORE FEATURES & CAPABILITIES
• Smart AI Keyboard Integration
Type seamlessly in iMessage, WhatsApp, Mail, Notes, or any other app. Get instant grammar, spelling, and writing suggestions without leaving your current screen.

Instantly catch typos, grammar issues, punctuation mistakes, and unclear sentences. The app not only corrects your writing but also explains the errors, helping you understand what went wrong and improve over time.

• Guided AI Chat
Chat with AI and get helpful guidance across many topics, from writing, studying, work, travel, daily communication, and more. Ask questions, practice conversations, or get suggestions whenever you need support.
• Multilingual Translation
Break language barriers effortlessly. Translate text into multiple languages directly from the keyboard or inside the app. Whether you are chatting online, writing emails, or traveling abroad, translation is always quick and convenient.
WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
• Professionals: Craft persuasive emails, reports, and messages that leave a strong impression.

• Non-Native Speakers: Learn from real-time suggestions to improve your English proficiency day by day.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your writing is your business. We prioritize your privacy and ensure that your keystrokes and text data are processed securely.

Lucidchart is the easiest way to create and view venn diagrams, flowcharts, mind maps, concept maps, org charts, UML activity diagrams on your mobile device.
Lucidchart is a visual workspace that combines diagramming, data visualization, and collaboration to accelerate understanding and drive innovation. With this intuitive, cloud-based solution, everyone can work visually and collaborate in real-time.
The app requires a Lucidchart account. Diagrams save and sync instantly online to your Lucidchart account, so you never lose your work

* Start with pre-built templates
* Drag-and-drop functionality
* View recent documents in offline mode
* Real-time collaboration
* In-editor commenting

* Email documents to share with others
* Generate shareable links
Global compatibility:

* Import Visio and OmniGraffle files
* Runs on all major browsers and device operating systems
Shape libraries for every scenario:
* Flowcharts and process maps
* AWS, Azure, and GCP shapes
* Mockups and wireframes
* UML, ER, and network diagrams
* Mind maps and Venn diagrams

bluejetty:00015758:ios.summary: Ace your exams with Studocu, the AI study app trusted by millions of students worldwide. From recording lectures and generating AI quizzes, to using the Ask AI tutor and accessing 50M+ real student notes, it has everything you need to succe
bluejetty:00015758:ios.description:
Ace your exams with Studocu, the AI study app trusted by millions of students worldwide. From recording lectures and generating AI quizzes, to using the Ask AI tutor and accessing 50M+ real student notes, it has everything you need to succeed.
Key Features:
Lecture Recorder: Never miss anything in your lecture
- Record lectures, classes, seminars, and study groups directly in the app.
- Generate full transcripts for accurate note-taking and organize them by course
- Get instant AI summaries of recordings with key learning points, detailed topic notes, exam call-outs, and action items
- Turn recordings into quizzes with one tap to test your knowledge or revise before an exam
- Schedule reminders so you never miss recording an important lecture
AI Quiz: Test your knowledge and revise your study notes
- Turn any document you find on the app into an AI quiz instantly with one tap
- Get instant feedback and explanations for questions, or try again to keep practicing until you master the topics
- Generated practice quizzes organized in the practice tab to revisit them later easily
Ask AI: Snap a photo to ask or solve
- Get instant homework help when you are stuck on a difficult assignment or textbook question
- Ask any study-related question or use it as a math solver to receive clear, step-by-step explanations for tough subjects like math, science, and languages
- Get the best possible answers as Studocu combines advanced AI with millions of real student notes to deliver highly accurate, reliable guidance
- Ask follow-up questions to clarify confusing concepts and ensure you fully understand the material before exam day
Student Notes: Real notes uploaded by students
- Access a massive library of 50M+ study resources, including lecture notes, practice materials, detailed course summaries, essays, and tutorial work
- Find materials specific to your university and exact courses to ensure you are studying the most relevant content
- Learn from top students by reviewing their shared assignments and study guides to boost your own grades
- Share notes with friends to easily collaborate and study together
- Ask AI anything about the document or create a practice quiz from it instantly with just one tap
Why students love Studocu
- All-in-one education and study companion that combines a massive library of real student notes with powerful AI tools in a single app.
- Save hours of study time by letting the AI do the heavy lifting of transcribing lectures and creating quizzes while students focus on learning.
- Improve academic performance through instant AI quizzes and a built-in AI homework helper exactly when students need it.
- Study anywhere and anytime by syncing your notes, quizzes, and recordings across devices.
From instant homework help to advanced lecture recording, Studocu is the app for students who want to study smarter, not harder. Download now to record and transform your lectures into notes, summaries, and quizzes!

Privacy Policy: https://www.studocu.com/en/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00076703:ios.summary: KPRC 2 is proud to announce the updated KPRC 2 Weather app, equipped with cutting-edge features designed to keep you ahead of the storm. With its intuitive interface and comprehensive weather tools, this app is your new go-to daily weather
bluejetty:00076703:ios.description:
KPRC 2 is proud to announce the updated KPRC 2 Weather app, equipped with cutting-edge features designed to keep you ahead of the storm. With its intuitive interface and comprehensive weather tools, this app is your new go-to daily weather resource. 
This updated weather application has been rewritten from the ground up to focus on providing you with the best weather information possible. From livestreams from the best meteorologists in the area, to live notifications about what is happening at your location or just looking up what the weekend weather forecast is going to be, this application is the best app to keep you informed. 
The KPRC 2 Weather app offers a sleek and fluid map displaying real-time radar, temperature, and surface winds. Whether you're planning your week or just stepping out for the day, our app provides detailed 48-hour and 10-day forecasts tailored to your specific location, accessible by city, zip code or wherever you are. 
Key Features of the KPRC 2 Weather App: 
- Live From the KPRC 2 Weather Office: Livestreams of the best meteorologist team, for up-to-the-minute coverage of weather impacting the region and your backyard. 
- Interactive Weather Maps: Better, more dynamic weather radar that is more interactive and easier to read. 
- Updates from the KPRC Weather Team: Get real-time insight, video forecasts and up-to-date analysis from our dedicated meteorologists 
- More Detailed Forecasts: Now including windspeed and direction! Get 3- and 10-day forecasts in both quick view and detailed formats, ensuring you're fully prepared no matter the weather. 
- Live Weather Alerts: Experience integrated weather alerts including tornado likelihood rankings from 1 to 10 for upcoming storm cells. 
- Customizable Notifications: Choose from KPRC 2 weather alerts and National Weather Service warnings for comprehensive alerting including tornadoes, severe thunderstorms and flash floods, directly on your map. 
- Click2Pins: Share and view photos and videos from your community and where events are taking place. Nothing is more powerful than the sights and sounds shared by our viewers, far beyond the forecasts and maps. 
- Dark Mode: A new visual option for easier nighttime viewing. Dark mode is enabled based on your device's settings. 
Beyond just forecasts, the KPRC 2 Weather app offers fully automated, specific weather alerts with up to 15 minutes lead time before severe conditions hit. You can set up alerts for up to 16 locations, including your current mobile location, ensuring that you and your loved ones stay safe. 
Houston, don't just watch the weather. Stay a step ahead with the KPRC 2 Weather app. Download or update today, and take control of your weather experience. Your peace of mind is now at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00121871:ios.summary:
Create a comic worthy of the Sunday newspaper or your favorite pulp-fiction cover.
Pop Dot Comic is a fun way to create comic-book style illustrations from your snapshot or ones taken of your friends and family. Pop Dot Comic applies thick
bluejetty:00121871:ios.description:
Create a comic worthy of the Sunday newspaper or your favorite pulp-fiction cover.
Pop Dot Comic is a fun way to create comic-book style illustrations from your snapshot or ones taken of your friends and family. Pop Dot Comic applies thick outlines, bold colors, and plenty of benday dots to newsprint or pulp papers to give every creation the look of one that’s been printed or published.
In the past, halftones were tediously inked in by cartoon artists or created in darkrooms. With Pop Dot Comic you can easily and quickly convert your photo into a comic book drawing that’s worthy enough for the Sunday newspaper or your favorite pulp-fiction cover. With a library of included “Fun Stuff”, custom messages can be added to speech bubbles and sound effects will give your creation “POW”. When your finished creating a comic book photo save it to your library or post them to your friends and family for funny moments. 
  COMIC STYLES 
• Sunday Comics — Creates a Cartoon Photo  
• Halftone — Transforms a photo into a Halftone Newspaper Photo 
• Pop Comics — Converts photos into a bright Pop Art Lichtenstein-style Cartoon 
• Pulp Comics — Renders a Cartoon with Vintage Color on Aged Pulp Paper 
• Noir Comics — Creates a contrasted toned or blk/white Comic with selective color like those used in the Sin City series
Pop Dot Comics is a professional cartoon effect that can be done directly on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.
•Convert all your images and pictures into cartoon-style effect quickly
•Choose a preset for a quick start
•Use large photos for a high-end result! 
•Crop your photo to remove unwanted parts of an image
•Choose between 5 comic styles: Sunday Comics, Halftone, Noir Comics, Pop Comics, Pulp Comics
•Make adjustments to outlines, color, border width, border inset and pulp papers
•Choose between Dots, Lines and Halftones
•Edit and resize “Fun Stuff” and “Bubbles” with an easy one-finger gesture
•Share via Email, Facebook, Twitter and Tumblr
•Save to Camera Roll
Easy to Use
•Tap to edit type in speech & thought bubbles
•Long Press to delete fun stuff and bubbles
•Pull edges of fun stuff and speech bubbles to resize
•Touch and hold center to move
FEATURES 
Benday Dots — like those used in the traditional printing process. Benday Dots are two (or more) different small, colored dots combined to create a third color. Back in the day, pulp comic books used Benday Dots in primary colors to inexpensively create the secondary colors such as flesh tone.  
Fully adjustable control on all aspects of the process: Dot or Line size, Outline size, Color variation, Border: Width, Inset, Color & Corner Radius.
  INCLUDES 
Newsprint and Pulp Papers  
UNIVERSAL FEATURES
 All JixiPix Apps come with: Superior Customer Service, Support for High-Resolution Images & Output, Undo/Redo, Randomize Button, Quick Presets and the ability to create Custom Presets, Cropping with the ability to specify aspect ratio, Quick Preview, Email, Print, and the ability to post directly to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and Tumblr. We also have an online art gallery and invite our user’s to display their artistic creations on it: http://www.flickr.com/groups/jixipixcreations/  
***************  
“JixiPix turns any photo into a masterpiece. All that is required of you is the appreciation — we’ll take care of the rest!”
JixiPix.com “Creative Tools for Creative People"
Photography | Artistic | Graphic Apps

Newsprint and Pulp Papers

◉ Fun titles like Word Wars, Words of Wonders, Word Chums, Wordfeud, Word Connect, Word Cookies, Word Domination, Just Jumble, Zen Word or Words Story

bluejetty:00178037:ios.description:
Welcome to My Tidy Life!
Are you crazy about seeing things in order? Do you like to organize or sort everything? Do you love renovating your place? Then, you will enjoy and feel satisfied while playing this game. 
• Tidy Neighborhood 
Walk around the neighborhood and help each place with their messy rooms. There is an untidy room in each building, and they are waiting for you to organize their places. A kitchen, a hobby room, or a bedroom, all of them come with fun unboxing, satisfying cleaning and organizing experiences. Each room is a unique adventure, can you tidy the whole neighborhood?
• Renovate and Upgrade Furniture 
Tidying places is not the whole job. It is up to you to bring the light into these rooms. There are multiple beautifully designed furniture, so you can upgrade your rooms. Do you prefer modern or classical interior? Just decide your style and start designing your place as you wish. It is time for a new fridge, a sofa, or a bathtub. 
• Mini Games 
Light up the fireplace, fluff pillows, and organize your spices. Then, you deserve a bubble bath to relax but first, you have to prepare it for yourself. Numerous fun mini games are waiting for you! 
You won’t believe how messy these cabinets, drawers, and fridge are. 
Be the tidy hero and clean everything!

bluejetty:00086171:ios.description:
Onlinetours is a convenient and quick service to search, book, and buy tours, which helps you find the perfect match for your vacation.
Whether you choose to book early or buy a last-minute tour, the app will help you find exactly what you need.
What we have for you:
– Tours search by 130+ tour operators;
– Convenient filters for easy search;
– Newly updated prices from leading tour operators: BibilioGlobus, Anex Tour, Coral Travel, Sunmar, Tez Tour, Pegas Touristik, Fun&Sun, Intourist, and many others;
– Discounted tours and hot deals on various destinations up to 50% off;
– Photos, full descriptions, ratings, honest reviews from tourists.
Preparing for a vacation with us is sheer pleasure! Millions of tours to more than 50 countries in a convenient search system.
Advantages of our service:
– Best Price Guarantee - we do not apply any surcharge to the cost of the tour operator;
– Possibility of partial payment - first installment 10-50% of the price, the rest a couple of weeks before departure.
– Professional specialists’ support at all stages of buying, booking, and check-out;
– Support 24/7 in any way convenient for you;
– Choosing and purchasing tours by smartphone from any place you are.
It’s easy to find the right tour and pay in minutes. Our superservice will allows you not to worry about anything when you’re going on vacation.
How to find and buy the tour in the app:
1. Choose a country, city, or resort.
2. Select preferred departure date and duration of your trip.
3. Compare hotels, flights, and prices from different tour operators
4. Choose the most suitable option
5. Pay for all or part of your trip with your bank card
The tour package and price usually include accommodation, meals, flight, transfers, and medical insurance. We will be glad to offer extended services, such as visa support or non-departure insurance if desired.
Awesome travels, everyone!

bluejetty:00131751:ios.description:
Built by tattoo artists, for tattoo artists.
Tattooer-owned and operated since 2023.
Ghostline turns your artwork into clean, print-ready tattoo stencils in seconds. Cut out your subject, upscale and sharpen your references, generate fully customizable stencils, and print at any size with multi-page print-scale technology. Less time tracing means more time doing what you love: making tattoos you're proud of.
THE FUTURE OF TATTOOING IS HERE.
CUT OUT
- Lift your subject off its background in one tap
- The crop follows your subject, so there's nothing to clean up by hand
UPSCALE
- Enhance your artwork and turn photos into picture-perfect reference
- Upscale small, low-res images for sharper, cleaner reference
SHARPEN
- Sharpen your artwork for higher-quality stencils
- Sharpen your reference so you can create better tattoos
CLASSIC STENCIL
- Generate fully customizable stencils in seconds
- Dial in detail and intensity to your liking
- Create line-based stencils, 3D value-based stencils, and everything in between
PRO STENCIL
- The cleanest stencils yet, powered by Ghostline tech
- Adjust detail level, contours, and line weight
- Blend with Classic Stencil for even more detail options
- Tailor output for thermal (Thermofax) or inkjet printers
- Never hand-stencil again
EDIT
- Pen: add extra lines or thicken areas
- Eraser: remove anything you don't need
- Ruler: draw perfectly straight lines
- Blend: combine stencils or mix in your original artwork
REFERENCE
- View your stencil as an adjustable layer over your artwork while you tattoo
- Slide between your artwork and your stencil to find the perfect blend
- Choose stencil colors for a clearer visual guide
PRINT
- Multi-page printing: go as big as you want, from 1 sheet up to 16
- Multi-size: print several sizes of the same stencil on one sheet
- Pinch and zoom to size your stencil exactly, from micro tattoos to full back pieces
- Rotate or flip to fit your print
- Choose paper size and orientation
- Print with AirPrint, or save as PDF or images to print later or share to another app
EXPORT
- Export your stencil at any stage to Photos, Files, or any app
- All tools included. No credits, no pay-per-stencil
Ghostline saves you hours of tracing every week, so you can put your energy into tattoos that stand the test of time.
Ghostline is a subscription-based app.
Terms of Use: https://www.ghostline.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.ghostline.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00148715:ios.description:
Caller ID is your first choice to quickly identify unknown callers and get detailed information about any phone number. Whether you're getting a call from an unknown number or wondering about the identity of a missed call, this app will give you the tools you need to find and secure your phone calls.
It is a powerful and practical number query assistant that helps you easily obtain detailed information about the caller's number. Whether it is a call from a stranger or a fraudulent sales call, we will provide you with the information behind the number to make your calls more secure and convenient.
Features:
1.Powerful Database: 
Phone Number Lookup has a robust phone number database, allowing it to quickly and accurately obtain related data such as the number's attribution information, operator, line type, etc. This helps you understand the background of unfamiliar numbers in an instant.
2.Convenient Search:

bluejetty:00095555:ios.description:
Love sorting puzzle games and relaxing brain teasers?
Love the satisfying stretch and bounce of colorful springs? Spring Sort 3D turns that oddly satisfying motion into a relaxing yet strategic puzzle adventure!
Sort and stack colorful spring coils into matching tubes. Watch them stretch, slide, and spring into place as you solve fun sorting puzzles. Plan every move carefully, mix the wrong colors, and you will fail!
Spring Sort 3D perfectly combines satisfying physics mechanics, addictive sorting games gameplay, and top brain teasers challenges that keep your mind sharp and your mood calm.
MAIN HIGHLIGHTS:
Feel the Spring Effect:
Experience the realistic, bouncy motion of colorful spring coils as you stack and sort them. Each move feels soothing, satisfying, and fun.
Sort Colors & Stack Coils:
Match and organize vibrant spring coils into the correct tubes. It’s a relaxing brain teaser where logic meets creativity.
Train Your Brain with Strategic Gameplay:
Easy to learn but hard to master, think ahead like a pro puzzler, because one wrong move can cost you the game.
Daily Rewards:
Come back every day and open rewards that grow in value. Watch short videos to multiply your progress and climb faster through levels.
Collect Special Items:
Join limited-time events and collect rare items hidden inside levels to earn exciting prizes!
Spin the Wheel:
Every 10 wins, you’ll get a chance to spin the reward wheel for amazing bonuses! Want another try? Watch a short video to spin again. The wheel unlocks at level 35, perfect for advanced puzzlers looking for extra excitement and rewards.
Piggy Bank:
Save premium coins as you play. Once full, unlock your Piggy Bank at a special price and enjoy exclusive rewards, a fun way to boost your progress in Spring Sort 3D!
Season Pass:
Play through Free and VIP reward tracks, unlock exclusive bonuses, and challenge yourself to complete each season’s puzzles before time runs out.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE SPRING SORT 3D
• A fresh twist on sorting puzzle games with satisfying spring physics.
• Brain-teasing challenges that relax and engage your mind.
• Collect rewards, build voxel islands, and progress through creative levels.
• Spin the wheel, earn bonuses, and keep your progress rolling.
• Perfect for fans of sorting puzzle games.
Download Spring Sort 3D today and enjoy the ultimate mix of sorting puzzles, satisfying motion, and creative relaxation!

bluejetty:00021976:ios.name: Spring Classic
bluejetty:00021976:ios.summary:
Spring Classic is a Twitter client for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Features fast performance, truly native design and a highly customizable user interface.
Tab Bar
• Pin your frequently visit pages to the tab bar (for example, a Twitter List, se
bluejetty:00021976:ios.description:
Spring Classic is a Twitter client for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Features fast performance, truly native design and a highly customizable user interface.
Tab Bar
• Pin your frequently visit pages to the tab bar (for example, a Twitter List, search result list or user profile)
• Drag tabs into the order you prefer
• Rename your tabs
• Change your tab icons (more than a thousand of icons for you to choose)
• Show/hide tab names and button shapes
Tweet Actions
• More than 20 actions, including Reply, Retweet, Like, Add Bookmark, and Translate
• Drag actions into the order you prefer
• Configure actions as swipe options: swipe a tweet horizontally to perform an action
• Option to hide some or all action buttons from tweet cards, while keeping them accessible via context menu, swipe options, keyboard shortcuts, and VoiceOver rotor
• Turn on Like Confirmation to avoid accidentally like a tweet
Accent Color
• Configure different Accent Colors for Light and Dark mode
• More than 10 built-in colors for you to choose
• Design and set custom colors
Theme Editor
• Customize the app’s color scheme
• Design and set custom themes for Spring
• Advanced color settings allow you to fine-tune colors for different level of views
• Export and share your themes
Font Customization
• Configure different fonts for body text and headings
• Select from a variety of build-in fonts
• Supports custom fonts installed by third-party apps
User Notes
• Privately set aliases, notes and username colors for other Twitter users
• User Notes list: browse, organize and edit all your notes in one place
Game Controller (require iOS 14, iPadOS 14, macOS 11 or a newer system)
• Control the app and browse tweets with a compatible game controller, such as a Playstation DualSense/DualShock, Nintendo Switch, Xbox or MFi controller
• Customize button functions via in-app settings
• Set extra functions for Adaptive Triggers on the Playstation DualSense controller
Privacy
• Spring does not collect any personal information
• Your account tokens are protected by on-device Keychain
• Your network connection to Twitter is protected by HTTPS
• Links you opened are not shared with Twitter
• GIFs you selected are not shared with Giphy, the GIF content provider
Other features:
• Universal Purchase: purchase once, and install on your iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Column View takes full advantage of the big screen on iPad and Mac, shows multiple views at once and allows you to navigate between views fluently and efficiently
• Full Screen mode on iPhone let your timeline content fill the entire screen once you start scrolling
• Mute List filters out unwanted tweets and users
• Check recent tweets on your home screen or notification center with widgets
• Search tweets on the Timeline
• Adjustable text spacing
• Adjustable and adaptive text sizes
• Option to display tweet source on timeline (e.g. Twitter Web App)
• Share a tweet as picture
• Option to load websites in background: open in-app Safari view only after website is completely loaded in background, so you can browse other tweets while website loads (iPhone and iPad); open browser app and load website in background (Mac)
• Open multiple windows on iPad and Mac
• Customizable Link Preview experience
• Customizable text translation experience
• Automatic video and GIF playback on the Timeline
• Supports changing app icon on iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Turn on/off content scaling on Mac for extra screen estate or sharper text
• Open in Spring: open Twitter links via Spring. Available as Share Sheet action and Safari extension
• Autocomplete for Tweet Composer
Customer support:
• Twitter: @theSpringApp
• Email: theSpringApp@gmail.com

bluejetty:00147401:ios.description:
In minutes, you can start investing in real estate for as little as $1.
Quality real estate deals are usually out of reach for the average Canadian. We believe everyone should have the opportunity to own property through access to real estate investing at any amount, regardless of income, age, gender or background by investing with addy.
Absolute Accessibility
We offer everyone a chance at owning real estate. When anyone can invest in a property for any dollar amount, everyone has a chance to get into the market.
Hands-off Ownership
We remove the unexpected headaches that come with ownership. From contracts to closing, from being a landlord to juggling maintenance—we handle all the details, so owners can just pick an address and go.
Expert Co-owners
We’re in this together, both as investors and expert partners. Not only do we share the risk by investing alongside you, but we will also offer a robust selection of properties that have been pre-vetted by experts with decades of experience.
Tangible Investing
By investing in real estate and land, you are investing in something real that you can drive by, point to, and follow updates to see how it’s doing. This is an investment you’ll be proud to own!
Invest In Your Community
Invest in properties in your neighbourhood, with your friends & family, and in cities you love.
Flex Your Ownership
Collect properties that you are proud of and can show off to your squad. Good vibes all around!
Learn as you go
Our goal is to teach you about investing in real estate to help you get one step closer to building your financial future.
No Hidden Fees
We’re different! We do not charge ANY hidden fees or commissions. In fact, we’ve removed the word “fee” from our vocab. This means 100% of your investment goes into real estate.
The fastest way to cop a prop!
Choose which properties you want to be notified of so that you never miss out on an investment opportunity.
Featured in the Press
• Vancouver-based startup addy is part of the emerging “fintech” and “proptech” sectors, which is using technology to disrupt the financial and real estate industries. - CBC
• addy begins by identifying investment opportunities and putting them through a due diligence process including a line-by-line look at financial statements and approval from an investment committee to ensure each property has sound economics. - The Globe & Mail
• Investing in real estate can be hard: 1) it’s risky 2) it’s expensive. With addy, those barriers are eliminated. - Bay Street Bull
• addy, a Vancouver-based tech company, is looking to shake up the country’s real estate investment landscape by giving Canadians tools and access to opportunities, with options to invest as little as $1. - Livabl by Buzz Buzz Home
• While addy can’t change the high cost of the housing market, it can make it easier for people to get into the game for the first time. - Daily Hive

# Bring Dinosaurs to Life in Your Photos with Dino Camera!
Transform your photos into prehistoric adventures with Dino Camera! Whether you're looking to surprise your friends or add a touch of the ancient world to your images, Dino Camera
bluejetty:00121170:ios.description:
# Bring Dinosaurs to Life in Your Photos with Dino Camera!
Transform your photos into prehistoric adventures with Dino Camera! Whether you're looking to surprise your friends or add a touch of the ancient world to your images, Dino Camera is the perfect app for you. With over 60 dinosaur stickers at your fingertips, you can create super-realistic scenes in just a few taps.
A Jurassic Selection of Dinosaurs
Dino Camera offers a wide variety of meticulously designed dinosaur stickers that seamlessly blend into any photo background. From the mighty Tyrannosaurus to the soaring Pteranodon, and from the armored Ankylosaurus to the horned Triceratops, our app includes an impressive array of dinosaur species to choose from. Some of the featured dinosaurs include:
- Tyrannosaurus
- Pteranodon
- Stegosaurus
- Parasaurolophus
- Ceratosaurus
- Einiosaurus
- Camarasaurus
- Spinosaurus
- Utahraptor
- Corythosaurus
- Archaeopteryx
- Ankylosaurus
- Styracosaurus
- Dicraeosaurus
And many more!
Easy and Intuitive to Use
Dino Camera is designed with simplicity and ease of use in mind. Follow these simple steps to create your dinosaur-themed photos:
1. Capture or Import a Photo: Use the app to take a new photo or import an existing one from your photo library.
2. Choose a Dinosaur: Browse through our extensive collection of dinosaur stickers and select your favorite.
3. Rotate and Resize: Adjust the size and orientation of the dinosaur sticker to fit perfectly into your photo.
4. Save and Share: Save your creation to your photo library and share it with friends and family.
Key Features
- Easy-to-use Single Tap Operation: Effortlessly add dinosaurs to your photos with just a single tap.
- Professionally Designed Dinosaurs: Each sticker is crafted with attention to detail to ensure a realistic appearance.
- Rotate and Resize: Customize the position and size of each dinosaur to achieve the perfect look.
- Extensive Collection: With over 60 dinosaurs to choose from, you'll never run out of options.
- Use Existing Photos or Take New Ones: Flexibility to work with your favorite photos or capture new moments directly within the app.
- Save to Photo Library: Easily save your edited photos for later use or sharing.
Unleash Your Creativity
With Dino Camera, the only limit is your imagination. Create stunning, prehistoric scenes and amaze your friends with your creativity. Whether you're a dinosaur enthusiast, a photography lover, or just looking for a fun way to spice up your photos, Dino Camera offers endless possibilities.
Get Ready for a Roaring Good Time!
Dino Camera is the ultimate app for adding a prehistoric twist to your photos. With its user-friendly interface and extensive collection of dinosaur stickers, you'll be creating jaw-dropping images in no time. Download now and let the adventure begin!
Download Dino Camera Today!
Don't wait to embark on your Jurassic journey. Download Dino Camera now and start bringing dinosaurs to life in your photos. It's easy, fun, and incredibly realistic. Make every photo a roaring success with Dino Camera!
Experience the wonder of dinosaurs in your photos today. Download Dino Camera and start creating your own Jurassic world with ease. Your friends and family will be amazed at the lifelike dinosaurs that blend seamlessly into your photos. Get Dino Camera now and let your creativity run wild!

1. With the Zoho Assist - Customer app, you can let technicians look at your iPhone remotely. The first thing you need to do is to requ
bluejetty:00014911:ios.description:
The Zoho Assist - Customer app enables you to receive remote support directly from a trusted technician.
1. With the Zoho Assist - Customer app, you can let technicians look at your iPhone remotely. The first thing you need to do is to request your technician for a remote session.
2. The technician will then send you a nine-digit session key. This is to ensure that each session is safe and secure. Open the Zoho Assist - Customer app and enter the session key.
3. You can then share your screens with the technician at the other end.
4. After going through the screens and getting an idea of the problem, the technician can communicate with you through the in-app chat. This will be ideal when the technician wants to send you instructions or ask you for quick clarifications.
5. Although you'll be sharing your screen directly with the technician, you're always in control as you can choose to stop/resume screen sharing at any time.
6. Additionally, you can configure your iOS device for unattended access by the trusted technician at any time.
7. During an ongoing remote support or unattended access session, technicians and customers can send or receive files of up to 2 GB using the File Transfer option.
Download the Zoho Assist - Customer app and get contextual remote support on your iOS device.

bluejetty:00095345:ios.description:
GOODWILL MATCH 3D – MATCH, RESCUE, REBUILD!
Match 3D objects, rescue lives, and bring hope to families in need! Whether you're a fan of triple match puzzles or relaxing brain games, this is the match 3D adventure that delivers purpose with every tap.
HOW TO PLAY:
• Match 3D objects — Find and connect three identical items to clear the board.
• Rescue and Save — Help people by solving puzzles and restoring their homes.
• Train your brain — Improve memory and focus with each challenge.
• Unlock rewards — Discover bonus levels, power-ups, and in-game prizes.
• Triple match events — Join limited-time puzzles and test your speed.
• Prove you're the match master — Beat high scores and rise through the ranks!
WHY YOU’LL LOVE GOODWILL MATCH 3D:
• Heartfelt gameplay — Match objects and help those in need.
• Zen meets challenge — Relax or compete with puzzle modes for every mood.
• Light tile master inspiration — A fresh twist on traditional tile games in full 3D.
• Puzzle variety — From daily challenges to hidden three-match levels.
• Meaningful progress — Each match helps characters rebuild and recover.
• Daily motivation — Keep your brain sharp and your heart full.
FEATURES & GAME MODES:
Explore a puzzle game where matching three objects isn’t just fun — it’s a mission. This isn't your average tile puzzle. It’s a 3D match experience that draws inspiration from tile master and connect puzzle games, blended with a rescue story that makes every level meaningful.
Whether you prefer laid-back play or want to test your skills in triple match challenges, Goodwill Match 3D gives you the flexibility to play your way. It’s engaging, emotional, and endlessly rewarding.
START MATCHING WITH PURPOSE!
Join the mission today — help, save, and bring joy through every match. Download Goodwill Match 3D now and discover what it means to be a true match master.

bluejetty:00200072:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00200072:ios.description:
CalCs (short for "Calendar Complications") is a watchOS-only app that provides various complications related to the calendar.
--Important Notes--
The features built into the main body of this app are limited to listing events/reminders & displaying a monthly calendar.
All other features are provided through complications & the Smart Stack.
●If you download CalCs from the iPhone App Store, due to synchronization issues between the iPhone & Apple Watch, CalCs may not appear on the Apple Watch.
According to Apple's specifications, watchOS-only apps cannot be re-downloaded from the App Store app on the iPhone.
Therefore, please use the App Store app "on your Apple Watch" & follow the steps below to re-download it.
・Scroll to the bottom→"Account"→"Purchased"→"CalCs"→re-download
-------------------
Key Features
●Supports a variety of complications such as date display, events/reminders display, & monthly calendar display
・Date Display
Displays the current date in various formats.
・Event/Reminder Display
Displays events/reminders synced with your iPhone.
You can choose whether or not to include all-day events.
・Monthly Calendar Display
Displays the monthly calendar in various formats.
You can choose to start the week on Monday.
Supports holidays in some areas.
*Holiday data depends on external APIs & may be incomplete.
Only Modular Duo supporting models (Series 7+, not SE series) can show a month calendar using 2 large rectangles. Other models can show it in 1, with smaller font.
●In the main app, events/reminders, & the monthly calendar are displayed
Tapping the complication opens the app, where you can view the list of events/reminders synced with your iPhone, as well as the monthly calendar.
*Only incomplete reminders are displayed.
*The app currently does not have functionality to add, edit, or delete events/reminders, nor to mark reminders as complete.
●Minimal Setting Options
To avoid complicating settings on the small Apple Watch screen, the settings only allow you to select which calendar/reminder lists to display.
*Notes
・The corner complications, circular complications, & large rectangular complications are supported only on Apple Watch Series 4 & later, so CalCs is not guaranteed to work on Series 3 or earlier models.
・Due to the limitations of watchOS complication display updates, complications may not immediately reflect changes when the date changes or after events or reminders are added or edited on the iPhone.
・After placing a complication for the 1st time, it may take some time for it to actually appear.
・If the complication is not updating, try tapping the complication to open CalCs, as this may refresh the data.
・If the complication is not updated even after launching CalCs, the issue may be resolved by 1 of the following methods. Please try them.
1.Restart both your iPhone & Apple Watch.
2.Force restart CalCs
①With CalCs open, press & hold the side button.
②When the screen for emergency call & power off appears, press & hold the Digital Crown.
3.Reinstall CalCs
①Press the Digital Crown to display the app list.
②Press & hold CalCs, then tap the × button to delete it when it appears.
③Launch the App Store app on your Apple Watch.
④Scroll to the bottom→"Account"→"Purchased"→"CalCs"→Re-download.
・If the complication does not update after force quitting & restarting CalCs, try restarting both your iPhone & Apple Watch, as it may resolve the issue.
・If event information is not displayed on the app's main event/reminder list screen or in complications, it may be because full access to the calendar has not been granted.
The issue may be resolved by following the steps below to re-enable full access permission to the calendar. Please give it a try.
①Open the "Privacy & Security" section in the iPhone Settings app & tap "Calendars".
②Change CalCs' calendar access to "None", then select "Add Events Only".
③When you open CalCs, you will be prompted to grant full access, so tap "Allow Full Access".

bluejetty:00145895:ios.description:
TRANSFORM YOUR LIFE IN 75 DAYS
Ready to create lasting change? 75 Soft is your roadmap to becoming a stronger, more disciplined version of yourself.
I originally built this app for myself, as a fitness enthusiast looking to rebuild healthy habits. After experiencing its positive impact, I refined it to help others achieve the same transformation. In just 75 days, you’ll build better habits, push your limits, and develop the resilience to tackle any goal.
WHY THE 75 SOFT?
- Achieve Lasting Change: Transform your daily routine and watch how small, consistent actions lead to big, lasting results.
- Stay Motivated Every Day: It’s not just about crossing off tasks; it’s about creating momentum. With each day, you’ll feel more motivated to keep going.
- Create Healthier Habits: From fitness to mental wellness, you’ll develop routines that set you up for long-term success—without overwhelming yourself.
- Visualize Your Progress: Seeing how far you’ve come will inspire you to keep pushing forward, even on tough days.
- Share Your Wins: turn any completed day into a beautiful sticker, add your own photo, and post your progress straight to your story.
- Life Happens? Forgiving Mode keeps your challenge alive even when a day isn't perfect — progress over perfection.
- Smart Daily Reminders: one gentle nudge at the time you choose. It skips days you've already completed and stops when your challenge ends.
- Home Screen Widgets (Premium): Track and update your challenge directly from your Home Screen with interactive widgets.
- Customize Your Challenge (Premium): Edit challenge rules and add up to 4 custom rules to tailor the challenge to your goals and make it uniquely yours.
- Start on Your Day: Begin today, or pick a future start date like next Monday and get a reminder on Day 1. You can still adjust it later if needed.
- Ready for Round Two: Finished your 75 days? Set up your next round in a few taps, with your rules already saved.
If you’ve heard of the 75 Hard, you know how intense and demanding it can be. The 75 Soft offers a more balanced approach to self-improvement, focusing on consistency and sustainable habits without the extreme pressure. It’s perfect for those who want to challenge themselves but also value flexibility and long-term success.
WHAT’S POSSIBLE?
- A healthier, more focused you—both physically and mentally.
- The confidence that comes with discipline and consistency.
- The ability to stick to your goals, even when life gets in the way.
- A sense of accomplishment that fuels your next big challenge.
TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR JOURNEY
Whether you're looking to improve your fitness, sharpen your mindset, or simply stay committed to personal growth, the 75 Soft helps you create the life you want—one day at a time.
Your journey starts here. Download now and become the best version of yourself.

bluejetty:00137880:ios.summary:

Whether you want to capture golden hour landscapes, dramatic city
bluejetty:00137880:ios.description:
Photo Expert is your Personal Photography Mentor & Planner
Helps you discover what to shoot, when to shoot, where to plan, and how to capture better photos with confidence.
Whether you want to capture golden hour landscapes, dramatic city silhouettes, blue hour reflections, Milky Way skies, moonrise scenes, indoor macro details, lightning, or long exposure shots, Photo Expert helps you move from idea to image.
WHAT CAN I SHOOT TODAY?
Photo Expert looks at your location, weather, light, Sun, Moon, Milky Way, light pollution, and upcoming events to suggest timely photography opportunities.
● Today’s Best Opportunity: See the best photo idea for your current conditions.
● More Opportunities: Explore additional ideas for landscapes, cityscapes, night skies, macro, weather, and more.
● Upcoming Events: Track super moons, meteor showers, eclipses, Milky Way visibility, rocket launches, and lightning opportunities.
● Mentor Guidance: Understand why a shot is worth trying without getting lost in technical data.
SIMPLE SHOOTING RECIPES
Tap any opportunity to see a clear recipe for the shot.
Each recipe can include:
● When to shoot
● Where to look
● How to capture it
● Recommended gear
● Camera settings
● Practical shooting tips
● Personalized guidance based on your camera and lens
No long tutorials. No confusing charts. Just clear steps to help you take action.
YOUR SHOT PLAN
Turn a photo idea into a practical plan before you go out.
Photo Expert helps you prepare with:
● Readiness guidance: See if the shot is worth trying today.
● Needed Equipment: Know what to bring before you leave.
● Before You Go checklists: Prepare your camera, lens, tripod, battery, and accessories.
● Field Tips: Avoid common mistakes in the field.
● Save Plan: Save shot ideas, checklists, location context, and reminders.
● Set Reminder: Get notified before the best shooting window.
SMART PLANNER MAP
For outdoor and celestial photography, open your plan on the map to understand direction, light, and alignment.
● See Sun and Moon directions on the map.
● View golden hour, blue hour, sunrise, sunset, moonrise, and moonset timing.
● Understand the best direction to face for your shot.
● Set a subject on the map to check Sun or Moon alignment.
● Plan skyline, landscape, moonrise, sunset, and Milky Way compositions.
SMART CAMERA ASSISTANT
Add your camera and lenses to get more personalized guidance.
Photo Expert can help you understand how to apply a recipe with your own gear.
● Camera-specific setup suggestions
● Personalized recipe cards
● Step-by-step camera setup guidance
● Simple explanations for why settings work
● Common mistakes to avoid
● Practical variations to try in the field
Photo Expert does not just tell you “ISO 100” or “f/8.” It helps you understand why those settings matter and how they help create the final image.
POWERFUL PHOTO TOOLS
Access expert planning tools whenever you need deeper details.
● Sun Tracker: Sunrise, sunset, golden hour, blue hour, and Sun direction.
● Moon Tracker: Moonrise, moonset, moon phase, moon age, and lunar direction.
● Milky Way Planner: Find when and where the Milky Way will be visible.
● AR Viewer: Visualize Sun, Moon, and Milky Way positions in the real world.
● Light Pollution: Check dark sky conditions for night photography.
● Lightning Map: Track real-time lightning activity.
● Photography Calculators: Star trails, depth of field, ND filters, timelapse, 500 rule, long exposure tools.
PREMIUM FEATURES
Premium features may include personalized photo opportunities, camera-specific recipes, Smart Camera Assistant, advanced shot planning, saved plans and reminders, Sun, Moon, Milky Way and AR planning tools, Lightning Map, and photography calculators.
Download Photo Expert today and turn every photo idea into a clear, confident shooting plan.

Privacy Policy: https://www.miopsteknoloji.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00124353:ios.description:
The Microsoft Copilot app is the AI built for work. Copilot helps you keep your work moving, from early ideas to finished documents, presentations, and more. Whether you're creating content, managing projects, organizing your day, or finding information, Copilot helps you get more done from one place.
Copilot connects to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and more, bringing the files and information you use into one place. Create polished documents, presentations, and spreadsheets, summarize articles and files, draft emails, brainstorm ideas, analyze information, and get answers grounded in the work you're doing.
Need help tackling a bigger task? With Cowork, Copilot can take on multi-step work and help deliver finished files and completed to-dos, so you spend less time piecing work together and more time making progress.
Choose between leading AI models, selecting the one that's best suited to the task at hand. Whether you're writing, researching, planning, or analyzing, Copilot gives you the flexibility to work your way.
Copilot also remembers what matters, connects to the files and information you use most, and helps you pick up where you left off. Upload Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images or PDF files directly from your phone to ask questions, generate summaries, and find the information you need.
For organizations with a Microsoft 365 Copilot subscription, Work IQ gives Copilot a deep 
understanding of your organization's work, people, and relationships, delivering more intelligent, relevant, personalized and trusted assistance.
Copilot is built on the same enterprise-grade security foundation as Microsoft 365 — your permissions, encryption, and compliance commitments already in place. Data processing and protection commitments differ by subscription; see the full security documentation for details.
Availability of Microsoft Copilot features may vary. Some capabilities require specific licenses or may be disabled by your organization's administrator. See this webpage for more information on feature availability by license:
https://support.microsoft.com/topic/understanding-the-different-microsoft-copilot-experiences-cfff4791-694a-4d90-9c9c-1eb3fb28e842
Please refer to Microsoft’s EULA for Terms of Service for Microsoft 365. By installing the app, you agree to these terms and conditions:
https://learn.microsoft.com/legal/microsoft-365/microsoft-365-copilot-mobile-license-terms

Internationally renowned psychic medium John Holland has been lecturing, teaching, demonstrating, and reading for private clients for more than 18 years. bluejetty:00177668:ios.description:
TILE CONNECT is a connection-based PAIR MATCHING GAME with 1000+ challenging levels. Tile Connect is a popular and addictive pair matching puzzle game. You can download Tile Connect for free on your iPhone and iPad. The game has tons of challenging well-designed levels to train your brain, exercise your logical thinking and memory. It is the best time killer for you! Become a tile master level by level! Play faster and faster to train your brain and exercise the link technology! 
KEY FEATURES
- EASY to learn line connect game
- Plenty of amazing THEMES. Help you change the whole category of tiles!
- Many music for Stress Relief
- Exciting PAIR MATCHING ADVENTURE for everyone to enjoy!
- HINT and SHUFFLE amazing boosters
- Fun PUZZLES to train your brain
- STUNNING graphics and beautiful levels
- FREE to play Onnect MEMORY GAME
- Play ONLINE or OFFLINE: you don’t need to worry about a Wi-Fi or internet connection
- Levels with timed bomb cards
- Revive after fail
- AUTOSAVE, continue playing where you left off.
- Classic "Onnect connect" game mechanics
HOW TO PLAY?
* Match and connect pairs of the same kind images
* Link two identical images and tap to draw a line between them
* Match farther images to gain more stars: longer lines=more points!
* Use the HINT to reveal a possible connection
* Use the SHUFFLE to rearrange all the images randomly
* Use the SCISSORS to remove bomb
* Use the SWAP to change theme image
* Match Bomb tile before it explodes
* Crush all the tiles within the limited time!
* Pass levels one by one to become a tile master!
TILE CONNECT - Onnect 3D Classicis seriously fun and addictive.

bluejetty:00114753:ios.name: Jigtile Sort Puzzle
bluejetty:00114753:ios.summary:
Lightly swipe with your fingertips and piece every retro image back together.
 Welcome to a puzzle world filled with nostalgic charm, where a level-based adventure of observation, logic, and strategic thinking awaits.
In the game, you’ll sl
bluejetty:00114753:ios.description:
Lightly swipe with your fingertips and piece every retro image back together.
 Welcome to a puzzle world filled with nostalgic charm, where a level-based adventure of observation, logic, and strategic thinking awaits.
In the game, you’ll slide and adjust neighboring cards to rebuild scattered picture fragments step by step. As you progress through the levels, you’ll unlock a collection of distinctive retro-themed images and enjoy the satisfaction of turning disorder into a complete picture in gameplay that is easy to pick up yet full of challenge.
【Game Features】
Retro-style images with a unique visual appeal
 Carefully crafted retro-themed pictures bring warm nostalgic colors and delicate details. Every completed level is a pleasing visual experience.
Plenty of levels with growing challenges
 From easy stages to more advanced ones, a wide range of levels is waiting for you. As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging and continue to test your observation and thinking skills.
Simple swipe controls that are easy to learn
 Just tap and swipe to move cards and adjust their positions. The controls are intuitive and smooth, making it easy for anyone to jump in.
A satisfying blend of puzzles and strategy
 Completing each image takes more than sharp eyes. You’ll also need to plan your move order and make smart use of space to enjoy a deeper strategic challenge.
Relax and enjoy the puzzle-solving process
 Amid retro visuals and a gentle pace, enjoy the satisfaction of watching each puzzle come together and let every level become a calm, rewarding moment.
【How to Play】
Slide cards and restore the picture step by step
 Press and drag cards to move them, adjust fragment positions, and slowly rebuild the full image.
Matched parts connect automatically
 When the correct parts of the picture touch, they automatically connect together. Connected groups can then be moved as one, making play more intuitive and smooth.
Keep clearing levels and unlock more retro pictures
 Complete one stage to move on to the next and experience even more retro-themed images as you continue your puzzle journey.
Search for clues in each retro scene and complete the picture with every swipe. Whether you enjoy relaxing puzzle gameplay or the sense of accomplishment that comes from progressing through levels, you’ll find your own fun here.
Download now and begin your retro puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00175324:ios.description:
Stack Team App is a FREE and secure platform enabling any sports team or club to create their own customisable smartphone app. It also includes a free website that updates dynamically with your app. 
If your Team has created an app then download Stack Team App, sign-up and join your team. To create your own Stack Team App visit www.teamapp.com, or create your team directly via the app.
Stack Team App is one of the world’s premier smartphone apps for sports club communication used by millions of people in over 150 countries!
QUICK SUMMARY
Stack Team App is suitable for anyone from small social teams to large clubs with thousands of members. Engage with members, coaches and players with your choice of features:
APP FEATURES
• Send news, events, photos and videos instantly to your members' smartphone via push notifications.
• Promote events, send reminders, manage RSVP’s and track attendances.
• Instantly create and receive in-app payments from members using the Team Payments feature.
• Create separate access groups such as players, parents and coaches to streamline communication.
• Sell mobile tickets, merchandise & memberships directly via the Store in your app or website.
• Engage in instant private messaging or group chats.
• Create surveys or in-app voting to gather information from your members.
• Send newsletters & documents.
• Link your app to ladders, schedules, results & live scores for multiple teams.
• Sync your team’s events with your smartphone calendar.
• Easily invite members via the app, or bulk upload your database via your team’s website dashboard.
• Secure and private platform so you decide who receives your content.
NEW REVENUE CHANNEL
• Buy your own ad banners to support sponsors and make a profit for your club.
• Sell mobile tickets, memberships and merchandise via the Store in your app or website.
• Utilise Team Payments to request instant in-app payments from members.
• Promote events to maximise attendances to generate greater revenue.
PROFESSIONALISM
Stack Team App’s features and commercial opportunities will bring an entirely new level of professionalism to any club, no matter how small or large. 
AUTO-RENEWABLE 12-MONTH SUBSCRIPTION TO REMOVE ADS
Stack Team App's innovation and development is funded by mobile advertising, ensuring you and your team can enjoy Stack Team App for free. We take care not to upset or interrupt the user experience. 
However, if you want to remove the ads from Stack Team App, you can "Remove Ads" via an in-app purchase through the settings of your Stack Team App. It is a 12-month subscription and will auto-renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period - auto-renewal is managed via your iTunes account settings after your purchase. Pricing is USD $2.99 / AUD $4.49 per year, and will be charged to your iTunes Account. 
PRIVACY POLICY
https://teamapp.com/privacy
TERMS OF SERVICE
https://teamapp.com/terms
Bring your club into the mobile age with Stack Team App.
Your Team. Your App.

bluejetty:00119547:ios.description:
With the extended edition of the SAP Cloud for Customer mobile app for iPhone and iPad, you can gain real-time insights into your company’s ever-changing customer data anywhere and anytime. This app accesses the SAP Cloud for Customer solution and allows sales people to collaborate with their team, communicate better with their business network, and make informed decisions right from their device. This app also enables service technicians with full field service execution capabilities both online and offline, including assignments, work orders, parts, time sheets, and analytics.
Key features of SAP Cloud for Customer for iPhone and iPad
• Find and follow people in your sales organization
• View feed updates of the people and records you follow and add comments and private messages
• Maintain account, contact, lead, opportunity, competitor, appointment, and task information
• Convert a lead to an opportunity and request enterprise resource planning (ERP) pricing
• Access real-time analytics
• Get offline support
Note: To use SAP Cloud for Customer with your business data, you must be a user of the SAP Cloud for Customer solution with a valid license and login credentials, as well as mobile services enabled by your IT department. The data and business processes available on the app depend on your role in the back-end system. Contact your administrator for more information.

BuzzRx: Your Rx Savings Prescription Care Partner! Save on prescriptions with BuzzRx, the ultimate savings app for local Rx discounts. Need to save on prescription meds, at Walgreens, Walmart, CVS, Safeway, and Kroger? Or perhaps you need a prescription refill? BuzzRx has you covered! Navigate our Rx coupons to get unbeatable pharmacy discounts right in your neighborhood!
Why BuzzRx?
Save on prescriptions: Find prescription discounts at Walgreens, Walmart, CVS, Kroger, and over 60,000 pharmacies nationwide.
Local Rx Discounts: Easily access local pharmacy discounts with our free coupons for meds.
Rx Coupons for Pets: Care for your furry friends with unbeatable Rx savings on their meds.
Prescription Refill: Stay on top of your prescriptions with our built-in medication reminder.
Get BuzzRx now for incredible Rx savings and enjoy great discounts on all your prescriptions at your local pharmacy!
BuzzRx Features
Prescription Discount Finder
Use our savings app to find the best Rx prices:
Enter your prescription Rx details and zip code.
Compare discounted Rx prices at pharmacies near you.
Redeem free Rx coupons by showing your BuzzRx card or coupon at checkout – no insurance required, and save up to 80% on prescriptions!
Prescription Refill Reminder
Never miss a dose! BuzzRx helps you stay organized with a personalized medication tracker and Rx medication reminder.
Free Coupons for All Rx Medications
Whether you have insurance or not, BuzzRx offers prescription discounts for every member of your family. Save on pet prescriptions, too!
Accepted at 60,000+ Pharmacies
BuzzRx partners with major pharmacy chains like:
- CVS Pharmacy
- Walmart Pharmacy
- Walgreens Pharmacy
- Target Pharmacy
- Safeway Pharmacy
- Albertsons Pharmacy
- Publix Pharmacy
- Vons Pharmacy
- Kroger Pharmacy
- HEB Pharmacy
- & much more!
How It Works
Download BuzzRx and search for Rx savings on your prescription meds.
Use our pharmacy discount My Card or unlock Rx coupons for specific medications.
Redeem your savings and enjoy affordable prescriptions at any participating local Rx pharmacy.
More Than Just Savings
By using BuzzRx, you support charities like Make-A-Wish®, helping to create a positive impact while you save on prescriptions.
Medication Tracker & Free Prescription Refill Reminder
Never miss a prescription refill again with BuzzRx's handy reminder feature. Set a personalized Rx medication reminder to ensure you always have your medications on time, eliminating the stress of running out. We'll also keep you updated on the best Rx coupons and discounts available for your saved prescriptions.
Redeem it at Your Local Pharmacy
BuzzRx collaborates with over 60,000 pharmacies across the nation, including well-known names like CVS, Walgreens, Kroger Pharmacy, Safeway Pharmacy, Walmart, and many more. Wherever you are, BuzzRx is there to help you save on prescriptions and enjoy affordable family care at your trusted pharmacy!
BuzzRx: Your Prescription Discount Solution
BuzzRx isn’t just about saving on prescriptions—it’s a comprehensive tool for managing your family’s healthcare. With features like personalized Rx refill reminders and pharmacy price comparison, BuzzRx ensures you stay on top of your care. Whether it’s finding the best local Rx pharmacy discount, saving on prescriptions for pets, or using free coupons to cut costs, BuzzRx is the ultimate Rx saver for all your healthcare needs. Take control of your well-being while saving money effortlessly.
Affordable Rx care, local Rx savings, and more—all in one app. Save on prescriptions now!
