bluejetty:00145093:ios.name: To-do list, tasks planner
bluejetty:00145093:ios.summary: To-do list, tasks planner is a multi-use app that combines features of a tasks planner, to-do lists and shopping lists, healthy habits tracker, simple notepad and a convenient calendar with smart reminders. With this app you will no longer
bluejetty:00145093:ios.description:
To-do list, tasks planner is a multi-use app that combines features of a tasks planner, to-do lists and shopping lists, healthy habits tracker, simple notepad and a convenient calendar with smart reminders. With this app you will no longer need to switch between various applications and spend your previous time on it. Because from now on everything will be properly stored in one place. Planning has never been faster and easier!
With To-do list, tasks planner app you will:
- Enjoy ease of use
Neat and intuitive interface will make the use of the app as convenient and pleasant as possible: all that matters (tasks, lists, schedule, habits) will now always be at your fingertips on one screen. And adding or editing new tasks or notes will be quick and easy.
- Easily plan and manage your tasks
Create your own schedule and routine by adding tasks - type them or use voice input, add subtasks with checkboxes, tags, attachments, notes, reminders and importance. Mark items as completed with just one tap and track your progress and productivity!
- Distribute workload effectively
All tasks for the next few days will be shown on the main screen whilst tasks for next weeks and months will be displayed in the calendar - so that taking a look at your schedule will be illustrative and convenient and you will be more and more efficient.
- Make lists
Add lists of subtasks and shopping lists, to-do lists and check-lists, interchange items and mark completed or purchased items to make sure your lists are always up-to-date.
- Form habits, stay motivated
Form and track healthy habits with our habits tracker. Drink water, exercise, meditate and so much more! With convenient regular reminders from the app doing it will be easy, and compliments upon achieving your goals and fulfilling plans will become extra motivation and driving force for you!
- Save time
Add tasks and notes using voice input, the app will automatically recognize text using OCR and you will be sure that you captured important information on the run. Don’t waste your time on searching for useful data - search by words, themes or dates - extremely quickly and efficiently! 
- Never forget anything
Use a convenient system of smart reminders to make sure you will never forget anything important! Set single or regular notifications and the app will remind you of all your tasks on time.
- Share what matters
Share tasks and lists with your colleagues, friends and family directly from the app - you will no longer need to switch between screens and copy necessary information from one window to another.
- Capture ideas
And to make sure you don’t ever lose brilliant ideas not related to tasks, routine and dates, save movies and music lists, interesting recipes and much more we added a separate hidden section Ideas to the app where you can store literally any information you want.
To-do list, tasks planner will increase your productivity, save you lots of time and will make planning easy and pleasant!
Term of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://todoplannerapp.com/docs/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00098718:ios.description:
Step into the shadows and become the ultimate predator.
In Night Panther: Silent Predator, you are not just another wild beast — you are the legend of the jungle, a stealth hunter born to rule both wilderness and city streets. Prowl through darkness, strike without warning, and reclaim your territory in this realistic 3D animal survival game.
The night belongs to you. Hunt silently, move swiftly, and unleash your beast instincts to conquer every prey that crosses your path.
Every mission challenges your stealth, reflexes, and strategy as you stalk through dense jungles, neon-lit cities, and mysterious forests filled with danger.
 Game Features
 Become the Silent Predator
Rule the night as a powerful panther — fast, fierce, and unstoppable. Use stealth and precision to take down enemies before they even notice you.
 Explore Open-World Environments
From deep jungle forests to modern city streets — explore diverse, detailed worlds filled with wild animals, hunters, and hidden dangers.
 Hunt, Survive, and Dominate
Hunt your prey, fight for survival, and rise as the true king of the wild. Unlock powerful abilities and grow stronger with every hunt.
 Realistic 3D Action Gameplay
Experience smooth controls, dynamic camera movement, and immersive 3D graphics that bring your wildest hunting fantasies to life.
 Dynamic Missions & Challenges
Complete stealth missions, predator attacks, and survival challenges to earn rewards and upgrade your panther’s strength and skills.
 Customize Your Panther
Unlock unique skins, power-ups, and special abilities to make your panther faster, deadlier, and more legendary.
 Why Players Love It
Realistic jungle and city environments
Cinematic lighting and detailed animations
Exciting stealth-action gameplay
Offline play supported
Free to play with optional upgrades
Can You Survive the Night?
Hunt or be hunted — the wild has only one rule: the strongest survives.
Become the Silent Predator and prove you are the true King of the Night Jungle.

bluejetty:00135548:ios.description:
* Classic game without ads and microtransactions!
Timeflow is an educational training sim, that will teach you the basics of investing, time management and financial literacy. 
You can build a career, invest in real estate, freelance, develop a business, trade stocks, get additional education, and network. Your goal is to fulfill your dream, create passive income and accumulate enough savings.

bluejetty:00016485:ios.description:
GREEN THE PLANETS, GREEN YOUR LIFE
Since being featured in the New Cosmos Times, 'Green Style' has become a lifestyle that is on many people's radar.
What is Green Style, you may ask?
It is greening one planet after another by traveling through the universe and changing it to be a comfortable place to live.
Therefore, you will feel more relaxed, refreshed, and satisfied with your accomplishments: your green planets.
"Well, it's interesting, but, isn’t it too much to handle?”
Just join us and find out!
GROW* provides with you all the support you need, and you will be amazed how easy it is to start enjoying your 'Green Style.' 
*GROW: Greening and Reviving Of the Whole Universe 
-------------------------
[Why do I choose GROW?]
- A Variety of Comet Decomposers
You will have a variety of Comet Decomposer choices, including the new Spread Shot, Reflection Shot and Charger type, as well as the standard Cannon, Missile and Laser. 
You will be amazed by the fun and excitement of decomposing comets!
- Quick'N Easy Greenifizers
The items from decomposing comets are converted into the energy, which then can be injected directly into the planet through Greenifizers.
So, just sit back, relax, and watch how the planet becomes green.
- Advanced Tech Facilities in the Spaceship
The latest artificial intelligence is implemented in the computer of the spaceship, and we will make sure you receive the best on-site support in the industry.
The library is also available in the spaceship to review the items you obtain.
In response to many requests, the new monitoring system has been installed so that you can check the current status of the planets that you have completed greening.
-------------------------
[Voices from the ’Green Style' community]
"I was tired of working long hours day after day, so I decided to go 'Green Style.' Now, I live a happy life! It is a joy to see a flower finally bloom after I complete greening a planet."
(Mepopoica from Planet Logoooda, 158 yrs old)
"Wow, that Reflection Shot! So awesome! Can't wait to do greening again on my next day off."
(Ga Nmochera Lu from Planet Nmzee, 17 yrs old)
"I am soooo busy taking care of 86 kids, but now I don't have to worry about gathering falling stars because Auto Collectors are working for me while I'm not on the planet currently greening. That's why I can continue and enjoy my 'Green Style.'"
(Moiko Mozoda from Planet Moyak, 37 yrs old)
-------------------------
So, call us now and start greening the planets and enriching your life!
GROW guarantees you will enjoy your 'Green Style.'
*Free trial available at a galaxy near you.

bluejetty:00070839:ios.name: ASVAB Practice Test Prep 2026
bluejetty:00070839:ios.summary:
ASVAB Practice Test Prep 2026 is a test preparation app that will help you pass the Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery (ASVAB) Test with a high score and get your ticket to a military career in the United States.
ASVAB Practice Tes
bluejetty:00070839:ios.description:
ASVAB Practice Test Prep 2026 is a test preparation app that will help you pass the Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery (ASVAB) Test with a high score and get your ticket to a military career in the United States.
ASVAB Practice Test Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into the concepts associated with ASVAB preparation, but also helps you gain the confidence to pass the exam on your first attempt by practicing thousands of exam-like questions.
### Passing the test on the first attempt ###
In ASVAB Practice Test Prep 2026 there are a large number of questions prepared by test experts that cover the range of standardized test requirements. Depending on the exam requirements, you will need to master nine subjects, each containing multiple subdivided content areas. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- General Science
- Arithmetic Reasoning
- Word Knowledge
- Paragraph Comprehension
- Mathematics Knowledge
- Electronics Information
- Auto and Shop Information
- Mechanical Comprehension
- Assembling Objects
### Key features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance on the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the ASVAB exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the test. You will find that each time you practice on ASVAB Practice Test Prep 2026 your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the ASVAB exam, but any other exam you take later!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://asvab.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://asvab.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00162682:ios.description:
Винлаб — супермаркет напитков, продуктов питания и товаров на любой вкус по хорошим ценам, представленный в регионах по всей России. 
В нашем алкомаркете представлен широкий выбор вина любых марок и других видов спиртного разной крепости. Помимо этого, у нас можно найти эксклюзивные алкогольные напитки, которые оценят даже истинные сомелье.
Мобильное приложение Винлаб предоставляет пользователям широкий список услуг
- Удобный онлайн-заказ с проверкой наличия товаров в магазине.
- Резервирование спиртных и безалкогольных напитков круглосуточно.
- Экспресс-заказ в магазин: доступен к выдаче в течение 1 часа.
- Исключительные преимущества карты лояльности WinClub.
Акции, скидки и персональные предложения
В нашем супермаркете регулярно проводятся различные акции и скидки в супермаркетах на алкогольные напитки разной крепости и другие категории напитков. Мы предоставляем постоянные и сезонные скидки, о которых можно узнавать первыми, включив push-уведомления в настройках приложения. Также у нас есть персональные предложения, доступные в личном кабинете в разделе «Акции для меня».
Программа лояльности WinClub
Мы разработали программу лояльности WinClub, которая предоставляет нашим постоянным покупателям привилегии:
Уникальная система скидок, позволяющая копить баллы и оплачивать ими до 100% стоимости покупки.
Возможность каждый месяц выбирать любимые бренды и получать двойные баллы за покупки, чтобы получить максимальное удовольствие от своих любимых напитков!
Карта лояльности — всегда под рукой. Совершайте покупки в наших магазинах и предъявляйте штрихкод на кассе для получения скидки.
Огромный выбор спиртного и других товаров
В нашем супермаркете представлен широкий ассортимент алкогольных и безалкогольных напитков, а также другой продукции, вкусной и полезной для стола. В каталоге можно выделить различные марки вина, шампанское, виски, коньяк, пиво, водку, а также эксклюзивные предложения. 
Для любителей безалкогольной продукции у нас есть достойное предложение соков, питьевой воды, газированных, энергетических и чайных напитков. 
Удобство оформления заказов по интернету
Мы стремимся сделать наше приложение максимально удобным для пользователей, поэтому объединили в нем самые необходимые услуги — включая онлайн-заказ напитков. А с помощью удобных фильтров внутри приложения легко выбрать подходящие товары для любого случая — будь то торжественная церемония, вечеринка на веранде или встреча с друзьями.
Приложение позволяет проверить наличие товаров в выбранном магазине и зарезервировать спиртные или безалкогольные напитки круглосуточно
- Экспресс-заказ: Возможен к выдаче в супермаркете в течение 1 часа после оформления.
- Заказ со склада: Опция для случаев, когда товар отсутствует в выбранном магазине, осуществляется без ограничений по количеству и сумме заказа, ближайшая дата доставки будет указана в личном кабинете.
Оформленный заказ можно оплатить в супермаркете, выбранном для самовывоза, предъявив QR-код на кассе. Ближайший супермаркет легко найти на интерактивной карте с автоматическим построением маршрута.
Все в одном месте!
Главное преимущество приложения — доступность всех опций в одном месте. Помимо доступа к акциям, широкому выбору продукции и возможности онлайн-заказа, в приложении можно проверить историю заказов и добавить любимые товары в избранное. Пользователи могут делиться впечатлениями, оценивая продукцию и совершая правильный выбор благодаря рейтингу и карточкам товаров.
Разделите удовольствие с Винлаб — супермаркет напитков!
Предназначено для лиц старше 18 лет. Данный материал носит исключительно информационный характер и не является рекламой спиртных напитков. Мобильное приложение не предусматривает возможности онлайн-покупки и доставки товаров на дом. Продажа алкогольной продукции осуществляется исключительно в магазине.

bluejetty:00168963:ios.description:
Explore the exciting world of Bimi Boo, a magical play area designed for toddlers to have fun and let their imagination soar.
This game is perfect for kids aged 2-6, offering a mix of entertainment and educational content. It's like a storybook that comes to life, where children can create their own adventures, design their very own hero avatars, and shape the destiny of the lovable Bimi Boo characters.
The game is easy to play and helps toddlers develop their thinking skills and creativity. They can place objects, mix characters with different items, and even invent new things to enhance their stories. There are also hidden mini-games to discover within each scene, adding more fun and excitement.
"Bimi Boo World" includes educational mini-games that are seamlessly integrated into the gameplay. These games provide valuable lessons while keeping the learning experience enjoyable. Completing these mini-games unlocks special animations that celebrate your child's progress and achievements.
Safety is a top priority in "Bimi Boo World." The game provides a secure environment for kids to play and explore, giving parents peace of mind. It sets high standards for content and ensures a safe digital space for children to nurture their creativity and satisfy their curiosity.

bluejetty:00095458:ios.description:
The ultimate sports app for breaking sports news, the best memes, video highlights, live scores, stats, and schedules. The stories that actually hit and all your sports are in one app.
This is where you get all the best College Football stories, breaking NFL news, the stats you need for the group chat, and your daily sports highlights, all in one app!
Key Features
● Curated “Stories”
Our curated stories are the sports news you care about, the stories you’ve always wanted – from the draft to the latest games to the biggest NIL deals and the most ridiculously awesome memes. It's all here, in one app. Watch your favorite teams' top stories, breaking news, game highlights, and more.
● The “Watch” Tab
The best video feed in sports. Stacked videos of all the highlights, memes, talking-head commentary, and breaking news that matter to you. It’s fast. It’s easy. And it’s super fun.
● The “Games” Center
The easiest way to check out all your game schedules and live scores. And every game’s got its own curated clip stack, so you can immediately watch what matters.
● Sports Stats & Box Scores
Recapp is all about the video, but while you watch, we made sure you can check box scores, game stats, standings, and lineups right next to the highlights. So now all your sports stats are exactly where they should be.
● Real-Time Scores
Get the game score right in the game story. As you watch the game’s highlights, recap, or breaking news, you get a better-than-tv live-score and post-game score layout. This is all your sports scores, right next to all your sports video stories.
● Follow Your Favorites
Follow your favorite leagues, fighters, and teams so you never miss the moments that you don’t want to miss.
NFL Highlights
Get real-time NFL scores, breaking NFL news, the full NFL schedule, and the top NFL highlights in one easy-to-find place.
College Football Highlights
Watch all the highlights, stories, pregame madness, and memes you can handle. With teams in the ACC, Big 12, Big Ten, and SEC fully followable, you can check out stats and standings all season long while watching game recaps.
NBA Highlights
Watch all the highlights from your NBA teams through every stage of the season. Easily check box scores, standings, lineups, injury reports, game stats, and more - right next to the highlights that matter.
College Basketball Highlights
Follow teams from the ACC, Big 12, Big East, Big Ten, and SEC. Watch game highlights all season long, including the biggest conference rivalries and the unforgettable Cinderella stories in the making.
MLB Highlights
From spring training to the World Series, catch every home run, spectacular catch, strikeout, and clutch hit from your favorite MLB teams. Must-see stories and highlights from the All-Star Game, Home Run Derby, and all those intense playoff moments that define October baseball.
UFC Highlights
Follow all the action from the Octagon. Get full video coverage of UFC fights, upcoming UFC events, fighter news, and the biggest fight night moments.
WNBA Highlights
Watch the clutch three-pointers, dominating blocks, and buzzer-beaters from regular season games, playoffs, and WNBA Finals. All the must-see stories from the draft night drama to the finals.
NHL Highlights
Follow your favorite hockey teams and watch every goal, game-winning assist, clutch save, and overtime thriller from your favorite NHL teams. From preseason news through the Stanley Cup Finals highlights, it’s all here.
MLS Highlights
Video stories covering every game of the season, including Rivalry Week classics, Decision Day drama, and the excitement of the MLS Cup playoffs and finals. Catching up on your favorite soccer teams has never been this fun.
Complete Coverage & Analytics
Access box scores, standings, lineups, and injury reports whenever you need them. Our world-class video player lets you take control of replays so you can rewind and review exactly what happened on those game-changing plays.

bluejetty:00091817:ios.summary:
Bring Your Ideas to Life
With Image Playground, you can create high-quality images in pretty much any style. Whether you’re making a photorealistic nature scene, a fun image of your friends, or a stylized version of a familiar photo, you ca
bluejetty:00091817:ios.description:
Bring Your Ideas to Life
With Image Playground, you can create high-quality images in pretty much any style. Whether you’re making a photorealistic nature scene, a fun image of your friends, or a stylized version of a familiar photo, you can get started using simple text descriptions, photos, and people from your Photos library. Then choose the style you want, or select ‘Any Style’ to describe how you want it to look. And Image Playground is designed with your privacy in mind, with models that run on Private Cloud Compute, so your photos are never stored or shared, even with Apple.
Modify Images with Ease
You can easily iterate on your images, so you can make just the image you want. Simply describe the changes you want to make to update the scene and characters—like transforming the background, changing the style, or adding something entirely new. You can also refine specific parts of your image by tapping or circling an object to move it, resize it, or swap it out. Every version of your image is saved, so you don’t need to worry about losing something along the way.
Integrated Across Your Apps
Image Playground is integrated seamlessly across the apps you use every day. In Messages, you can make a fun image to send to a friend or create a custom background for your conversation. You can craft the perfect contact poster for your friends and family, or generate completely original Lock Screen wallpapers directly in Settings. Bring your presentations, mood boards, and documents to life with images in apps like Keynote, Freeform, and Pages, or design invitation backgrounds in the Invites app. And with the ability to choose your aspect ratio, you can use images wherever you need them—like a landscape image for your small business’s website or a portrait image for your flyer.
Image Playground is available in the following languages: Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese.

bluejetty:00160353:ios.description:
Love nature and find in nature your well-being. The app for your healthy lifestyle.
Toothache, insomnia, acne as well as nausea are just some of the illnesses that can be treated with natural methods without the overuse of medicines.
Natural remedies such as tea, herbal tea, mother tinctures and glycerin macerate act slowly, require patience but if they are the right remedies can be very helpful and do not have the collateral effects related to medicines.
This app, easy and fast, is a handbook of the natural remedies for the most common diseases.
The app is structured as follows:
- Remedies: a list of plants, fruits and essential oils with explanations about uses and benefits.
- Problems and diseases: list of the most common illnesses (allergy, poor digestion, acne, joint pain, nausea, anxiety and much more) with the related natural remedies.
- Healthy recipe: Every week one healthy recipe to keep you fit with taste
- Yoga exercises for the flexibility of the body and the calm of mind
- Last news from science world: the most recent scientific studies about lifestyle, nutrition and health are reported. 
- Small tips and tricks for every day: short video tutorials that show you how to prepare at home simple natural remedies. Lip gloss for cracked lips, golden milk, remedy for swollen legs
- Chromotherapy: this section is based on the color-method to induce relax before bed. 
- Step counter: walking is good for body and mind, keep fit with the app Natural remedies that becomes fitness app with the free step counter pedometer. In this way you’ll be able to know how many steps did you do, the burned calories, the kilometers and the time. 
Some topics that you can find on the app Natural Remedies are: Aloe Vera, Golden Milk, green tee Matcha, turmeric, yoga exercises for beginners, yoga exercises for the back, essential oils against anxiety or depression, cake without butter
Disclaimer
This app is not a substitute for professional medical or health advice, examination, diagnosis, or treatment. This app disclaims any liability for the decisions you make based on this information.

– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00030803:ios.description:
The Credit Union of Georgia app empowers you with the tools you need to manage your finances, and is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view.
Here’s what else you can do with the Credit Union of Georgia app:
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
To use the Credit Union of Georgia app, you must be enrolled as a Credit Union of Georgia Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.
This App allows users to opt into features that use the device’s location, including location-based card control, to prevent potential fraudulent transactions.

Whether it's your child's first walk to school, a late bus home, grandparents living independently, or simply knowing everyone arrived safely, Spacetalk helps families stay connected every day.
Spacetalk combines real-time location sharing, safe family communication, smart alerts and powerful safety features into one easy-to-use app that gives your family more freedom—with confidence.
Designed for modern families, Spacetalk keeps everyone connected while helping you protect what matters most.
Why families choose Spacetalk
- Know where your family is with real-time GPS tracking
- Stay connected with secure family messaging and calling
- Receive alerts when loved ones arrive or leave important places
- Track regular journeys and know when plans change
- Send an SOS alert with location when help is needed
- Share only what you choose, with the people you trust
- Built with privacy and family safety at its core
Whether you're managing young children, teenagers, grandparents or the whole family, Spacetalk helps everyone stay connected in one trusted place.
Features
Family Spaces
Create secure Spaces for your family, invite the people you trust and keep everyone connected through private messaging, calling and shared safety features.
Live GPS Location
See where family members are in real time, helping you stay informed without constant calls or messages.
Places
Create geofenced saved places like home, school, work or sport and receive automatic notifications when someone arrives or leaves.
Routes
Monitor regular journeys and receive alerts if someone deviates from their expected route, giving you peace of mind during everyday travel.
SOS
When every second matters, send an SOS alert with your live location so trusted family members can respond quickly.
Feelings Check-ins
Share how you're feeling with quick emoji check-ins and help your family stay emotionally connected throughout the day.
Smartwatch Management
Pair and manage compatible Spacetalk smartwatches directly from the app, making it easy to stay connected wherever your child goes.
Privacy First
Your family's information belongs to you.
Spacetalk never sells your personal data or fills the app with advertising. You decide what you share, who can see it and when.
More than location
Spacetalk is designed to grow with your family.
From location sharing and family communication today to expanding online safety and digital wellbeing features, Spacetalk is continually evolving to help families stay safer, more connected and better protected in an increasingly digital world.
Perfect for
- Parents
- Children
- Teenagers
- Grandparents
- Carers
- Blended families
- Busy households
Download Spacetalk today
Join thousands of families using Spacetalk every day to stay connected, protect loved ones and enjoy greater peace of mind wherever life takes them.
Online Safety (Coming Soon): A new optional parental control feature, that uses secure, on-device VPN technology to enable you to block, manage and filter harmful or inappropriate content on your child's device, giving you an extra layer of protection as they explore online.

bluejetty:00089154:ios.description:
Business calling, simplified
Zoho Voice, Zoho’s cloud telephony solution, is specifically built to simplify your business communication. With AI-powered insights and smart communication channels, you can set up a flexible, hybrid contact center to connect with customers and teams, handle calls more efficiently, and keep conversations organized as you grow.
Trusted by over 25,000 businesses, Zoho Voice powers 7 million+ calls every month across the globe, with phone numbers available in 180+ countries. It offers a reliable way to manage calls, track team performance, and stay connected with customers.
ZDialer by Zoho Voice is a reliable mobile app that lets you make and receive business calls directly from your phone. With a secure internet connection, simply log in using your Zoho Voice credentials and start calling. Stay on top of follow-ups with ease: add notes, update call outcomes, and transcribe recordings, so you can manage customer conversation anytime, anywhere. 
Features
• Clean, intuitive interface with quick access to dialpad, call logs, and notifications.
• Access your mobile contacts to place calls directly from ZDialer.
• Make and receive calls, record conversations, add notes, and update call outcomes (disposition) in just a few taps.
• Send and schedule messages using custom texts or templates, and manage conversations across instant messaging platforms (WhatsApp and Telegram).
• View call logs, access recordings, and listen to voicemails without switching to the web console.
• Transcribe call recordings and voicemails into clear, readable text.
• Use tap-to-call for faster outbound communication.

bluejetty:00150576:ios.name: Devote: Bible Study
bluejetty:00150576:ios.summary: Devote is a study Bible that personalizes to your season of life. Ask anything and get answers rooted in Scripture, get devotionals written for exactly what you are facing, and listen to a narrated audio Bible, guided prayers and meditation
bluejetty:00150576:ios.description:
Devote is a study Bible that personalizes to your season of life. Ask anything and get answers rooted in Scripture, get devotionals written for exactly what you are facing, and listen to a narrated audio Bible, guided prayers and meditations. See how it learns what your working through in life or studying and watch how it adapts to help you apply scripture deeply to everything in your life. Free to use.
"Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path." Psalm 119:105
No gimmicky features, Devote removes the noise so you can apply scripture to whatever your going through. 
ASK ANYTHING
Struggling with forgiveness? Confused by a passage? Wrestling with doubt? Ask in your own words and get a clear, biblical answer with every verse cited and one tap away. Devote's AI is grounded in Scripture alone and never pulls from outside sources. Choose your favorite pastors and teachers to shape how it responds, like a wise friend who is always ready to study with you.
DEVOTIONALS MADE FOR YOU
Tell Devote what you are going through and it writes a devotional plan for it, on any topic, for as many days as you need. Each day brings Scripture, a reflection, a prayer and a place to ask questions. Read it, or listen with soft music underneath. Invite a friend and walk through it together. Every two weeks Devote also crafts a fresh set of plans just for you.
A DAILY RHYTHM
Start each morning with a short devotional: a quote, a passage, a reflection and a prayer, short enough for a busy morning. Build the habit with streaks and milestones, get a gentle reminder each day, or take a Journey through the whole Bible, every book, start to finish.
NARRATED AUDIO BIBLE
Any chapter, beautifully read, with each verse highlighted as you listen. Available in NIV, ESV and NKJV, each with its own narrator. Choose a music bed like Piano & Cello or Acoustic Guitar, set the speed, and drift off with the sleep timer.
MEDITATIONS AND GUIDED PRAYERS
A library of 200+ professionally narrated audio experiences for anxiety, loneliness, rest, healing, gratitude and more. Scripture meditations, guided prayers, Bible stories and daily Scripture, all crafted to help you slow down and hear from God.
GO DEEPER ON ANY VERSE
Tap a verse to interpret it: what it means, the original Hebrew and Greek, the historical context, and artwork that brings it to life. Highlight, take notes and save favorites. Every interpretation you read is kept in your library.
EVERY MAJOR TRANSLATION
NIV, ESV, KJV, NKJV, NLT, NASB, CSB, AMP, The Message and more.
WHY BELIEVERS USE DEVOTE
• Bible study with clear answers drawn from Scripture alone
• Personalized daily devotionals and reading plans built for you
• Audio Bible, Christian meditation and guided prayer
• Verse insights with original language and context
• Highlights, notes, streaks and daily reminders
WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
"I now use Devote every day for my quiet time and devotionals. It has replaced all my other apps." John
"I love how personalized the devos are, without compromising Biblical integrity." Chelsea
"So helpful to learn the Bible in context. I love the visuals to help me understand each verse better." Alaina B.
OUR MISSION
Devote is free to use. Devote Plus, our optional subscription, unlocks unlimited chat, devotionals and audio, and every Plus subscription helps keep Devote free for believers in Turkey, Iraq, Egypt, Jordan, Israel and across the Middle East, where Bible study resources are scarce.
Devote Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription with a free trial.
• Plans renew weekly, monthly or yearly at the price shown in the app
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
• Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off before the end of the current period
• Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings
Terms & Conditions: https://www.joindevote.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://joindevote.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00038120:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00038120:ios.description:
Umo: Your travel companion. 
Umo is your travel companion, an all-in-one transit app that lets riders at agencies that utilize Umo buy transit passes, get directions, use map navigation, find your bus schedules, and move seamlessly wherever life takes you. Umo gets you where you need to go, displaying transportation closest to you so that you can easily explore, pay and go.
Download Umo and get started today!
* Simplified Home Screen – The App’s main screen (now accessible from the new ‘Home’ tab) simplifies rider navigation for quick, effortless access to all application features. 
* Easier agency Location – We have replaced “metro areas” with a new agency selection experience to make it easier for riders to locate an agency near them that uses Umo. Agencies are now clearly listed and sorted by nearness to the rider, ensuring that riders select the correct, intended transit agency when they create an account and purchase fare products. Please note that not all transit agencies use Umo and only those that are available for selection in the App are supported at this time.
* Improved Payment Flexibility – Easily buy transit passes or add money to your wallet in the app. Enjoy the unified wallet, convenient payment methods and easy viewing of fare details across agencies. Riders can also now delete their payment method at any time under ‘View My Account’. 
* Contactless Boarding – The updated version of the App now has quick access to the dynamic QR code used to board from the ‘Code’ tab as well as via ‘Show Code’ links strategically placed throughout the application for faster fare payment.
* Real-Time Information – Umo uses real-time data that provides timely and highly accurate bus tracker or trip planning for those transit agencies that support this functionality.
* Trip Planning – Intuitive navigation for easy journey planning in the App. 
* Enhanced Ride History – Riders now have access to more ride-history details, including month-by-month or an abbreviated history directly from the main menu for easy tracking and management.
* Accessibility – The updated Umo App is fully integrated with VoiceOver, providing an accessible and seamless navigation experience for
visually impaired riders.
* Favorites and Next Stop Alerts – Select your favorite station or stop and opt in to next-stop alerts—so you’re always on-time. 
* Localization – Umo supports English, Spanish and French languages. Simply adjust your Settings to your preferred language.

bluejetty:00147317:ios.description:
Find a trusted dog sitter, cat sitter or dog walker near you, for a walk, a day or a whole vacation.
Every pet sitter and dog walker on Petme has a real social profile: their posts, their home, their own pets, the way they care for animals every day. By the time you book, you already know who's opening the door for your pet.
Every booking includes
- Access to the Petme Protection Plan: up to $20,000 in vet support
- 24/7 support from real humans, never bots
- No platform fees: you pay the sitter's rate, nothing on top
- Cashback after every completed booking
- Photo and video updates while you're away
Care for every pet
- Dog walking, dog boarding, pet sitting and house sitting, doggy daycare, drop-in visits, professional grooming, and professional pet photography
- Cat sitting too: drop-in visits are made for cats and independent pets
- Every sitter is ID-verified and background-checked
- Message sitters first, follow their feeds, and read reviews from pet parents like you
How it works
1. Sign up free in 30 seconds, no card required
2. Browse dog sitters, cat sitters and dog walkers near you
3. Message them and follow their day-to-day on their feed
4. Book and pay securely, then earn cashback after every completed stay
5. Follow your pet's day through updates on your sitter's feed
Why pet parents stay
Trust starts before the booking: you see the person, not just a rating. The price you see is the price you pay. And every time you book, Petme gives some of it back.
For pet sitters
Offer walking, boarding, house sitting, daycare, drop-in visits, grooming, or pet photography. Your profile feed shows pet parents who you really are. Post actively and get discovered locally. Keep up to 90% of what you earn.
Questions? contact@petme.social
Terms of Service: petme.social/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: petme.social/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00061483:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00061483:ios.description:
OK $:
OK Dollar lets you do fast money transfers, get deals and payments on the go. Use wallet to recharge mobiles & DTH, buy movie tickets, share bills with friend, buy flowers, order pizza, shop online and do much more. You even do top up to all operators in Myanmar. We have come out with brand new features which is user friendly to mobile users in Myanmar.
Make Payment:
You can make a fast and easy payment to shopkeepers or merchants using Make Payment option. Enter a registered OK$ number, Enter amount to be paid, remarks click on Submit and make a easy payment. You can use Scan QR Code to simply scan the shop or merchant QR Code and make a payment.
Pay Bill For:
You can make use of these options to make payment to Toll, Entrance, Parking, Fuel, Restaurant, Hotel, Shop, Supermarket, Ferry, Train, Bus, Intercity Bus, Flight etc. You can enter the respective merchant number, amount, remarks if any and click Submit and can make a simple payment.
Send Money To Bank:
You can make use of this option to Send your OK $ money to your bank account. Select your bank, bank address, branch, enter account number, beneficiary number click Send and your OK $ money will get transferred to the bank account.
Request Money:
If you have very low balance and you need to make a very urgent payment, you can make use of request money option to request money from your friend. Simply click on request money option and enter your friend registered OK$ mobile number, enter amount, add attachments if any click on submit and send a request. We have request scheduler to schedule daily request.
Promotions:
If you want to know any promotion informations near by you or in other location you can make use of this option. Simply click Promotion, you will get displayed with a list of merchants who have promotions, select it and you can avail the promotion.
Merchant Location:
Using this option you can easily search the merchants in current location as well in other locations around Myanmar. Simply click Merchant Location, you will get displayed with a list of merchants select it and you can make a easy payment.
Pay bill:
This option made easy for people who go to EB office or Telephone or DTH office to pay bills by standing in queue. You can make use of this option to pay your bills online in simple one click.
Add Money To Your OK $ Wallet:
If you have low OK $ balance in your account, you can transfer real time money from your bank account to OK $ using this option. You can transfer money to OK $ wallet from your debit card, credit card, online banking, bank counter, OK $ agent.
Top Up:
You can top to your friends instantly using OK $ top up feature. We do top ups for Ooredoo, MPT, Telenor, Mectel both GSM and CDMA. You can also do data pack recharge and special offers to your friends. And to your own account number.
Resale:
This feature is introduced for the people who like to sell their main balance to OK $. You can simply enter the selling amount what you need to sell from your main balance. We will validate the amount and give you a best offer price to buy your main balance.
Bill Splitter:
You can make use of this option to share your bills with friends. Select number of persons to share bill, enter amount, add attachment, enter contact number and click Send.
Notification:
We notify user if any payment is done, payment is received, or the request received like bill splitter and request money. You can switch between the tabs and can respond to the request came for bill splitter or request money.
Electricity Bill:
You can make you Electricity Bill payments Online using OK $ App. Enter your Account Number, Meter Number, Amount and pay your monthly electricity bills easily.

bluejetty:00178442:ios.name: Sudoku Color - Classic Puzzle!
bluejetty:00178442:ios.summary: Sudoku by MobilityWare is a vibrant and timeless rendition of the classic puzzle game – a game that blends iconic puzzle-solving that you know and love with a burst of color! Whether you're a seasoned Sudoku enthusiast or just beginning you
bluejetty:00178442:ios.description:
Sudoku by MobilityWare is a vibrant and timeless rendition of the classic puzzle game – a game that blends iconic puzzle-solving that you know and love with a burst of color! Whether you're a seasoned Sudoku enthusiast or just beginning your journey, our colorful Sudoku game offers an engaging approach to mastering the art of Sudoku solving.
Designed with approachability in mind, this Sudoku adventure infuses the traditional challenge with a colorful twist. Delve into the world of logic and strategy as you immerse yourself in this delightful puzzle experience. And guess what? If you're feeling nostalgic for the simplicity of the classic black and white gameplay, you can still customize your gameplay to fit the Black & White classic look and experience. Unravel the mysteries of the grid with ease and embark on a colorful journey to become a Sudoku master!
Just start easy! Truly train your brain to understand new sudoku puzzle logic without complication or the strain of looking at black and white grids. Start training by playing smaller sudoku puzzles and harness the power of color and your brain will make more logical decisions! And as you become a sudoku puzzle solving master, adjust your difficulty to hard for a break from the now too-easy sudoku puzzles from your sudoku infancy!
-Color Helps Your Eyes and Brain
Black and white sudoku puzzle grids can be stark and hurt those eyes. Our gentler color grid puzzles are easy on the eyes, and help your brain strategize faster!
-Smaller Puzzles Give You a Big Boost
A largely blank 9x9 classic sudoku grid can be a scary thing. We start you out on smaller puzzles until you get the hang of logic and can start to formulate strategy!
-Difficulty Levels Keep You Training
Your brain will soon become a sudoku color master and while you can continue to enjoy solving sampler sudoku puzzles, you can always check Settings for Hard mode! We believe in you, but we like to play to just relax too ;)
-Weekly Events Bring Unique Challenges
Complete unique holiday puzzles, travel to 53 unique destinations in our new Travel Events, and complete puzzles to earn watering cans and water your Garden—all while discovering new ways to play Sudoku! 
-Sudoku Veterans Welcome
If you don’t want your hand held or you prefer a classic black and white sudoku grid, you can always access good old fashioned original sudoku from the play menu.
If we don’t make Sudoku the easiest game to learn or better understand, color us confused :P

bluejetty:00148870:ios.description:
Discover the Language of History with Aramaic App
Step into the past and unlock the beauty of Aramaic, one of the world's oldest and most captivating languages. The Aramaic App is your gateway to mastering this ancient tongue with modern, effective learning methods.
Aramaic App Works!
• In just 10 minutes a day, begin your journey to learn the language of history.
• Learn at your pace with expert-crafted lessons tailored to your level.
• Join passionate learners reconnecting with the roots of Aramaic culture.
Features:
• Interactive Learning Tools: Practice vocabulary, grammar, and sentence-building with fun, engaging exercises designed to reinforce your knowledge.
• Personalized Learning Experience: Enjoy interactive lessons tailored to your unique progress and needs, ensuring that you learn effectively and at your own pace.
• Engaging Video Lessons: Learn directly from native Aramaic speakers with high-quality videos that immerse you in authentic pronunciation and usage.
• Clear Grammar Explanations: Master Aramaic grammar through concise and practical examples, making complex concepts simple and easy to understand.
• Practical Vocabulary: Build your vocabulary with words and phrases you can use in everyday conversations, cultural studies, or religious exploration.
• Dialogue Practice: Sharpen your conversational skills with interactive dialogue simulations that mimic real-life scenarios, helping you gain confidence in speaking.
• Audio from Native Speakers: Sharpen your listening and speaking skills with crystal-clear audio by native Aramaic speakers.
• Track Your Progress: Stay motivated with progress tracking and streak features, helping you build consistency and confidence.
• Fun Mini-Games: Reinforce your learning with mini-games that make vocabulary and grammar practice enjoyable and exciting.
• Offline Learning: Download lessons and learn anytime, anywhere – no internet required.
Download the Aramaic App now and become part of a groundbreaking community of learners bringing this ancient language to life. Your journey to fluency starts today!
Subscriptions:
You will need a subscription to access the full learning materials. Subscriptions are set to auto-renew by default. You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal at any time by accessing your Apple Account settings. Changes must be made at least 24 hours before the renewal date to avoid being charged for the next billing period. If a subscription is canceled, access to the app’s courses and features will expire at the end of the current payment term.
Contact Us:
Have questions or feedback about learning with Aramaic App? We’d love to hear from you!
Email us at: shlama@aramaic.app
Privacy Policy: https://aramaic.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://aramaic.app/terms-of-use.html

Your Daily Memories

You can count towards what's coming up, keep track of time since important moments, and set reminders that work around your events. Everything stays clear and easy to manag
bluejetty:00178337:ios.description:
DayCount helps you stay aware of time and the moments that matter.
You can count towards what's coming up, keep track of time since important moments, and set reminders that work around your events. Everything stays clear and easy to manage, whatever you're using it for.
---
Key Features
Event Counters
- Countdown using event counters that track time before and after your date
- Group events using custom categories
- Apply images from your device or search Unsplash
- Arrange events alphabetically or by date
- Repeat events daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly, yearly, or at custom intervals
- Write notes in dedicated spaces for each event
- Decimal counting for precise measurements
Streaks and Habits
- Build positive habits by tracking daily streaks
- Work towards your longest run of productive days
- View streaks alongside your events
Widgets
- Create widgets using different filters, fonts, textures, and borders
- Add widgets to your Home Screen or Lock Screen
Reminders
- Set alerts minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, or years before or after events
- Daily summary notifications showing your top 5 events or streaks
Appearance and Accessibility
- Event size options from regular to huge
- Higher contrast options for improved text readability
- Support for Dynamic Type
- Light and Dark modes
- Alternate app icons
Sharing and Integrations
- Share full-resolution screenshots of your events
- Import events directly from your calendar
- Save a location to an event and open directions in Apple Maps or Google Maps
Privacy and Security
- Backup and sync events and streaks across iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, and Mac
- Lock the app using Face ID or Touch ID
- Manual time zone control
---
Subscription Information
DayCount offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription with a free 7-day trial.
After the free trial ends, payment will be charged to your iTunes account. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period at the same price.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Account Settings.
DayCount Premium is available as an annual subscription or a lifetime purchase.
---

What started as your home for the CrossFit Games now brings the full CrossFit experience to your fingertips: the Workout of the Day (WOD), the latest content from the CrossFit education team, and everything you need to watch and participate in the CrossFit Games season. Log your Open scores, follow the leaderboard, and watch the Games livestream. The CrossFit app is where the global CrossFit community comes together—all year round.
Ready for the 2026 CrossFit Games?
So are we. But this year, there’s something to come back for every day—whether you’re chasing the podium or just starting out.
Inside the App:
Newsfeed – Fuel your journey with fresh tips, athlete stories, coaching insights, and training content straight from CrossFit HQ.
Workouts – Access the daily WOD from CrossFit.com, complete with scaling options for every fitness level. Follow it as your main program or save your favorite workouts for future inspiration.
Competition – Join the CrossFit Games season from anywhere. View the schedule, complete the workouts, submit Open scores, track your rank on the leaderboard, stream events, and follow athlete profiles—all in one hub.
Progress – Log your results on benchmark workouts and key lifts to see your progress and stay on track.

bluejetty:00022148:ios.description:
Big Tap Display Stopwatch makes it effortless to start and stop the stopwatch by tapping any part of the screen. 
With both Landscape and Portrait displays it is easy to see the Time easily in large clear font.
Fully customizable display with 6 Background Colors, 6 Text Colors and 4 available Fonts.
App Features
- Large Landscape and Portrait Displays
- Saves Previous Times
- 4 Different Fonts
- 6 Background Colors
- 6 Text Colors
- Just Tap the Screen to Start/Stop the Stopwatch
- Prevent the Screen from Locking while App is Open
- Can Force App to Stay in Landscape Mode (except on iPad)
This App was developed as an easy way to Start and Stop a stopwatch without having to look at the screen, because the buttons never move if in Portrait or Landscape. We also wanted to stop the device from being auto-locked, which would stop you from starting or stopping the clock.

bluejetty:00171138:ios.summary: Katapult is a lease-to-own option that helps you shop now and pay over time. No credit is required and easy, flexible payment options means that you don’t have to stress about making those important purchases. Shop great deals now with 100+
bluejetty:00171138:ios.description:
Katapult is a lease-to-own option that helps you shop now and pay over time. No credit is required and easy, flexible payment options means that you don’t have to stress about making those important purchases. Shop great deals now with 100+ retailers and apply for a Katapult lease today. 
How Katapult Works:
- Apply online or through our app 
- Shop supported retailers directly through the app
- Make purchases online using Katapult during checkout 
- Manage your leases and get help when you need it
- Get notified of upcoming payments 
- Make payments within the Katapult app 
Katapult allows you to lease-to-own the important items that you need now, without having to pay for them in full upfront.
With Katapult lease-to-own, you can take home up to $3,000 in must-have items such as furniture, electronics, home appliances, beds, mattresses, tires, and much more. Our lease-to-own option offers a fresh way to get the things you need. With Katapult, you have a lease purchase option that fits your life and there are no late fees … ever! 
Step 1: Visit the Katapult marketplace and choose where you want to shop from your favorite online retailers*.
Step 2: Take advantage of $300 to $3,000 in shopping strength.
Get pre-approved to know how much you can spend, or just begin adding qualifying products to your cart. You may then apply (if you haven't already), and if approved sign your agreement, and make your first payment.
Step 3: Use Katapult to check out. 
Select Katapult as the payment option in checkout. Start your lease-purchase application and once approved get the flexibility to pay over time, purchase early or even return your items. Katapult … a better way to pay. 
Katapult cannot be used for every transaction, only specified items are eligible. The browser extension for Katapult cannot be used to make in-store transactions.
The path to ownership will cost more than the merchant’s cash price. Not available in MN, NJ, WI, WY. Depending on your state, the stated transaction is a rental-purchase deal (rent-to-own agreement, consumer rental-purchase agreement, or lease/lease-purchase agreement) with Katapult. It is not necessary to be an owner. You will not own the goods until you have paid in full the whole amount required to obtain ownership or you exercise your early purchase option. Payment amounts and rental terms may be found in your lease agreement.
The phrase "No Credit Option" indicates that this is not a credit, loan, or financing transaction. It does not indicate or suggest that no check into credit history or creditworthiness will be undertaken. We examine your application using numerous data points and routinely accept clients with less-than-perfect credit.

bluejetty:00086861:ios.name: Sleep Worlds: Sounds & Stories
bluejetty:00086861:ios.summary:
SLEEP WORLDS: THE MOST BEAUTIFUL WAY TO FALL ASLEEP
Drift off to sleep with unique audio journeys that change every night
With acclaimed actress Hayley Atwell as creative director, who also conceived and voices two of our immersive worlds.
bluejetty:00086861:ios.description:
SLEEP WORLDS: THE MOST BEAUTIFUL WAY TO FALL ASLEEP
Drift off to sleep with unique audio journeys that change every night
With acclaimed actress Hayley Atwell as creative director, who also conceived and voices two of our immersive worlds.
A DIFFERENT KIND OF SLEEP EXPERIENCE
Sleep Worlds isn't meditation or guided relaxation. It's richly detailed storytelling designed specifically for sleep - sophisticated enough to engage your mind, soothing enough to let you drift away. Written by acclaimed novelists and poets, each world gives you something textured to settle into.
Think of it as a game you play by sleeping.
FULLY IMMERSIVE 3D AUDIO
Every world is built in stunning spatial audio. Rain moving around you at the Hotel de Luge. Ocean waves shifting perspective in the Archipelago. The isolated stillness of a mountain cabin at The Lookout. The gentle passing of a toy train through Tiny City. Combined with literary-quality narration, these aren't just soundscapes, they're comforting places you'll want to revisit again and again.
KEY FEATURES:
Star-Quality Narration: Worlds conceived and voiced by Hayley Atwell, plus acclaimed voice talent including Eve Lewis
Literary Quality: Stories crafted by renowned writers including Editor-in-Chief Emily Berry, Joe Dunthorne, and Katharine Kilalea
7 Unique Worlds: Each with its own atmosphere, characters, and stories
Content That Evolves: Every night brings subtle variations - familiar yet always fresh
Multiple Narrators: Choose your favorite voice from up to three narrators per world
Customizable Duration: Set narration from 5 minutes to continuous all-night play
Beautiful Visuals: Subtly changing environments each time you visit
DISCOVER YOUR WORLD
The fog-shrouded villages of the Archipelago (with fog whales). The rain-soaked Hotel de Luge. The mountain solitude of The Lookout. The infinite Archive-of-All-in-All. The global community of Radio Anywhere's CB enthusiasts. The miniature charm of Tiny City. Find your perfect sleep destination.
BEAUTIFULLY SIMPLE
We've stripped away unnecessary features like sleep tracking to create an elegantly simple experience. Just open the app, select your world, and drift away to immersive soundscapes including rain sounds, ocean waves, white noise, radio static, and thunderstorms.
Sleep Worlds is available with a 7-day free trial, currently offering 50% off our full subscription price.
Goodnight, Sleep Worlds.
Terms of Service: https://sleepworlds.app/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://sleepworlds.com/privacy-policy/

What is the Garden Grove School District app?
The Garden Grove School District app helps schools and families stay connected and informed—all in one easy place. Whether it’s a quick message from a teacher, an important alert from the district, or a reminder about tomorrow’s field trip, the Garden Grove School District app makes sure families never miss a thing.
Why families and teachers love the Garden Grove School District app:
• Simple, easy-to-use app and website
• Messages are automatically translated into 190+ languages
• Best-in-class safety and security practices
• One place for all school updates, alerts, and messages
With the Garden Grove School District app, families and staff save time and stay connected—so everyone can focus on helping students succeed.
Garden Grove School District for iOS
The Garden Grove School District app makes it easy for families to stay in the loop and engage with their child’s school community. With the app, parents and guardians can:
• See school news, classroom updates, and photos
• Receive important notices like attendance alerts and cafeteria balances
• Message teachers and staff directly
• Join group conversations
• Sign up for wishlist items, volunteering, and conferences
• Respond to absences or tardies*
• Pay school-related fees and invoices*
* If included with your school's implementation

bluejetty:00164055:ios.summary: GPS Speedometer is a comprehensive speed measurement application that integrates vehicle, bicycle, and running speed measurement. It aims to provide you with accurate real-time speed, distance, average speed, maximum speed and other key dat
bluejetty:00164055:ios.description:
GPS Speedometer is a comprehensive speed measurement application that integrates vehicle, bicycle, and running speed measurement. It aims to provide you with accurate real-time speed, distance, average speed, maximum speed and other key data. Whether you are commuting, long-distance travel, cycling adventure, or running exercise, GPS Speedometer can be your indispensable partner.
Why choose GPS Speedometer?
Real-time speed display: Through GPS positioning technology, the current speed is displayed in real time, so that you can always understand the driving or running status and ensure safety.
Trip tracking: Automatically record your driving or running track, including total distance, average speed, maximum speed, etc., so that you can easily review the detailed data of each trip or exercise.
Multiple sports modes: Support multiple sports modes such as vehicle, bicycle, running, etc. to meet the speed measurement needs of different users.
Smart Pedometer: Track your steps in real time, so that every exercise is clearly visible. The application provides detailed historical data statistics to witness your persistence and progress. Even when running in the background, it can accurately record steps in low power mode to provide you with a seamless experience.
Picture-in-Picture: With our new picture-in-picture feature, you can always check your current speed while using other applications. Whether you are on a call, in a meeting, or listening to music, the current speed will be displayed in a small floating window.
Speed limit alarm: Set a safe speed limit. When it exceeds the set value, the app will issue a warning to remind you to slow down or adjust the speed to ensure safety.
History: Save detailed data of each trip or exercise, so that you can compare the performance of different trips or exercises, analyze habits, and improve efficiency.
More power saving: Optimize battery use to ensure long-term operation without affecting daily use.
GPS speedometer can be used in the following scenarios:
Daily commuting, understand commuting time, and plan the best route.
Long-distance travel, record trip details, and share travel stories.
Cycling adventure, track cycling tracks, and improve cycling skills.
Running exercise, analyze running data, and improve running results.
Download GPS speedometer to make every trip or exercise a wonderful journey!
Note:
Features you can use for free: GPS speedometer, real-time speed display, smart pedometer, speed limit alarm, music player, compass, distance measurement, LED banner. And you can view a limited number of historical trip tracking records and a limited number of historical data details.
Features that require the purchase of a subscription service: view unlimited historical trip records, unlimited historical data details, head-up display function, picture-in-picture function, and switch dashboard skin.
If you subscribe through Apple, the fee will be deducted from the App Store account when the purchase is confirmed. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal at the rate of the selected plan within 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, you can go to the App Store account settings to manage subscriptions and auto-renewal.
Privacy Policy: https://speedometerapp.net/privacy
Terms: https://speedometerapp.net/terms

bluejetty:00128572:ios.name: World of Airports
bluejetty:00128572:ios.summary:
WORLD OF AIRPORTS
Build, manage, and grow your aviation empire in one of the most realistic airport management games on mobile.
World of Airports combines airport operations, airline management, fleet planning, and multiplayer strategy in
bluejetty:00128572:ios.description:
WORLD OF AIRPORTS
Build, manage, and grow your aviation empire in one of the most realistic airport management games on mobile.
World of Airports combines airport operations, airline management, fleet planning, and multiplayer strategy into a unique aviation experience. Take control of real-world inspired airports, coordinate aircraft movements, optimize ground handling operations, and build a global airline network connecting players from around the world.
Whether you dream of managing a busy international hub, expanding a regional airport, or creating a world-class airline, every decision matters.
MANAGE REALISTIC AIRPORT OPERATIONS
• Coordinate aircraft arrivals and departures
• Assign gates and optimize airport traffic flow
• Manage airport capacity and operational efficiency
• Expand airport infrastructure and unlock new opportunities
• Balance resources, schedules, and profitability
Every aircraft requires a carefully coordinated turnaround. Passengers board and deboard, baggage is loaded and unloaded, aircraft are refueled, and ground services must be completed before departure. Efficient planning is essential to keep flights on schedule and maximize airport performance.
BUILD YOUR AIRLINE
• Create and grow your own airline
• Collect and operate a diverse fleet of aircraft
• Customize liveries and showcase your brand
• Open new routes and expand your network
• Earn rewards through strategic fleet management
From regional aircraft to wide-body airliners, every aircraft plays a role in your airline’s growth. Build a fleet that reflects your strategy and establish your presence across the global aviation industry.
PLAY WITH REAL PLAYERS
World of Airports features a unique multiplayer system where aircraft operated by real players travel between airports managed by other players.
• Service aircraft from airlines around the world
• Send your own fleet to other players’ airports
• Participate in global events and challenges
• Compete in rankings and leaderboards
• Join one of the largest aviation gaming communities
Every airport becomes part of a living global aviation network where your decisions influence both your airport and your airline.
EXPERIENCE AUTHENTIC AVIATION
World of Airports is designed for players who appreciate the complexity and beauty of modern aviation.
• Airports inspired by real-world locations
• Realistic aircraft models and airline liveries
• Detailed aircraft turnaround operations
• Strategic airport and airline management
• Live weather based on real-world METAR reports
• Dynamic airport environments
• Constantly evolving content and new destinations
Weather conditions change throughout the day, affecting airport operations and creating new challenges. From clear skies to reduced visibility, every airport operates within a dynamic environment inspired by real aviation conditions.
PLAN, OPTIMIZE, EXPAND
Success depends on efficient resource management, careful planning, and strategic decision-making. Optimize aircraft turnaround times, maximize airport capacity, improve service efficiency, and expand your operations to handle increasing traffic.
As your airport grows, so do the challenges. Larger fleets, more passengers, and higher traffic volumes require smarter planning and better coordination.
FOR AVIATION ENTHUSIASTS
Whether you are fascinated by aircraft, airport logistics, airline operations, airport infrastructure, or aviation strategy, World of Airports offers a deeper level of realism than traditional airport tycoon games.
Experience the challenge of coordinating ground services, managing airport resources, expanding facilities, operating airline fleets, and maintaining smooth airport operations in a living multiplayer aviation world.
Join more than 40 million players worldwide and discover why World of Airports has become one of the world’s leading airport management games.
Build your airport.
Grow your airline.
Connect the world.

bluejetty:00088612:ios.description:
Zen Prep is the #1 app for passing your exam, WITHOUT stress and anxiety. You will experience better exam practice, lower stress, and less anxiety with our step-by-step training, exam simulators, motivation programs, exam resources, and tips and tricks. Zen Prep is recommended by top teachers and mental health experts.
ONE APP - ALL YOU NEED TO PASS YOUR EXAM
You will find all the information you need to pass the Accuplacer exam. All in one app. This study app directly aligns with the Accuplacer exam blueprint, giving you the preparation you need to achieve the highest score possible. 
"THE Accuplacer BIBLE"... ?!
You will see why this app is referred to as "The Accuplacer Bible" - It's so comprehensive! It will teach you everything you need to pass your exam.
WHAT WILL YOU MASTER?
• All the Accuplacer exam sections. 
• How to learn. 
• How to practice. 
• How to motivate yourself. 
• How to behave on the exam day.
PRACTICE QUESTIONS
Any test prep guide is only as good as its practice questions and answer explanations, and that's another area where Zen Prep stands out. The practice questions are similar to the actual exam. Each answer is explained in-depth to make the principles and reasoning behind it crystal clear.
PRACTICE TESTS
Choose to train in a particular subject or topic. You will get access to over a dozen practice tests.
REAL EXAM SIMULATOR
Practice in conditions similar to the real Accuplacer exam. Check your knowledge and get a sense of your predicted score.
FLASHCARDS
Swipe the cards to quickly review Accuplacer concepts without the need to go through the whole test, complete the right amount of questions for you, and get some quick studying in.
INCREASE MOTIVATION & REDUCE EXAM STRESS
Positive reminders are one of the simplest and most powerful tools for exam preparation. It's all about your mindset and keeping the right thoughts. You are a winner and you will ace the exam! The app will motivate you on those hard days when motivation is needed the most.
SCORE PREDICTION
Get your Accuplacer score prediction based on how you pass the real exam simulator, and study the topics you need to revisit to improve your score.
TIPS AND RECOMMENDATIONS
Get to know how to successfully get prepared and pass the exam, learn all the strategies, tips, and tricks useful to ace the Accuplacer exam.
Zen Prep will be your most valuable study resource – helping you prepare, stay motivated, and pass the exam with flying colors.

MyPlace is the answer to simple and affordable home control. MyPlace joins our leading systems, MyAir and MyLights in a user friendly app that allows control of your zoned ducted air conditioning, home lighting and for the first time, unlock the potential of full home control with additional “Keys.”

bluejetty:00061261:ios.description:
Stay connected with GlocalMe across more than 200 countries and regions! With GlocalMe, you can easily select personalized internet plans and connect instantly, whether at home or abroad, using mobile hotspots or eSIMs. Enjoy reliable and high-quality connectivity with no roaming charges!
※ Quick mobile hotspot highlights:
- Global reach. High-speed internet in 200+ locations, with 5G access in 90+ destinations and coverage from 390 carriers.
- Flexible plans. Choose from Fixed GB plans, Daily Passes, or Monthly Subscriptions tailored to you.
- Reliable connectivity. Our multi-carrier network connects you to the strongest signal.
- Hassle-free. No SIM cards, no roaming fees, and no hidden charges.
- Connect together. Share your connection with multiple devices for family and friends.
Using mobile hotspot is simple:
1. Install the GlocalMe app.
2. Create an account and link your mobile hotspot device.
3. Enjoy a free 1GB trial of global mobile data.
4. Purchase a data plan for your destination ahead of time.
5. Arrive and enjoy instant internet access.
※ eSIM for your smartphone:
GlocalMe offers a convenient solution for network connectivity, perfect for individual travelers looking to lighten their luggage during short trips. Our app features a range of eSIM packages, enjoy effortless connectivity with just a few taps on your smartphone!
What is an eSIM?
An eSIM, or digital SIM, is built directly into your smartphone, offering all the benefits of a traditional SIM card without any hassle. Get instant internet access in seconds—no need to visit stores, wait in lines, or deal with SIM trays. Just activate and go!
4 Easy steps to activate your eSIM:
1. Download the app and sign up.
2. Select your eSIM plan. Visit【Mall】→【eSIMs & Travel SIM】→【eSIM Standard】, pick your destination and plan.
3. Activate your eSIM. After purchase, 【Review order】→【eSIM Installation Instructions】. Scan the QR code or enter the activation code to install your eSIM in minutes.
4. Go global. Enable data roaming in your settings to connect to the internet and enjoy seamless global eSIM travel.

Please contact your wireless carrier for more information.
Federally insured by the NCUA.

bluejetty:00037786:ios.description:
Get exact prayer times and real-time information from your favorite mosques. Instantly geolocate the nearest Mosques around you.
• A non-profit project - A dedicated endowment (for the sake of Allah).
• 100% Free and without any Ads, no subscription needed.
• The #1 Mosque Network : Trusted by thousands of mosques across +100 countries.
• Serving millions of Muslims daily, since 2016.
• Open Source: Member of the OSI (Open Source Initiative).
• Community Driven.
Getting to the nearest mosque and connecting with your beloved mosques has never been easier!
Unlike other apps that provide you with approximations, we provide you with the precise timetables set by your Imam.
________________________
PRECISE TIMETABLES
• 100% Accurate: Salah and iqamah times as set by your Imam, based on your mosque's timetable (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha).
• Azan & Prayer Notifications: Choose from beautiful prayer calls with many muezzin voices and adhan.
• Imsak and Iftar: During the holy month of Ramadan, see the Fasting and Iftar times.
• Qibla direction: Qiblah compass to quickly find the direction to Mecca.
• Set Alarms: Pre-prayer notifications, suhoor, sunrise and iftar.
CALENDAR
• Calendar: See all the important dates, such as Ramadan, Eid-Ul-Fitr and Eid-Ul-Adha.
• Hijri calendar: Available at a glance, and downloadable (.pdf A4 format)
FIND MOSQUES
• Search for Mosques: in more than 47 countries worldwide.
• Mosques around you: Easily find mosques using geolocation, name, city, or address.
• Bookmark your Favorite Mosques: Get their precise prayer timetables updated in real-time.
DONATE, INSTANTLY
• Donate to your Masjid: Support your beloved mosques to keep them open and ready to serve our community.
• Donate to build the house of Allah & gain immense reward: help build permanent structures the entire community can share in the joy of worship.
STAY CONNECTED
• Events & News: Never miss an event happening in your mosques. 
• Important Messages: from your Imam or your Mosque managers.
USEFUL INFORMATION
• Facilities & Amenities: Ablution room, Women's dedicated space, Access for people with disabilities, etc.
• Services: Salat-Ul-Eid, Adults courses, Children courses, Iftar Ramadan, Suhoor, Salat-Ul-Janazah, Parking...etc.
• Contacts: Address, Phone, Email, Website, and Social Network pages.
AT A GLANCE
• Widget: See the prayer times, the following prayer, and the Hijri Date at a glance from your home screen.
• Smartwatch: Apple Watch compatible
• Home Assistant compatible.
THE HOLY QURAN
• Read and listen to the Quran wherever you are
LANGUAGES
• العربية, English, Français, Español, Deutsch, Italiano, Dutch, Português, Türkçe. More languages are coming incha’Allah.
Do you want to help us with the translations, contribute, or help us improve our Apps? 
BECOME A VOLUNTEER
We welcome any passionate and driven volunteers with a genuine interest in what we do. If you'd like to contribute to this blessed cause, please visit our website at: https://contribute.mawaqit.net
DONATE
Support us here https://donate.mawaqit.net
