bluejetty:00076344:ios.summary: HFG Entertainments has just released Moustache King, is another classic room escape game This game will put your searching skills to the test by requiring you to find all hidden objects and go from one door to the next. To get there, utiliz
bluejetty:00076344:ios.description:
HFG Entertainments has just released Moustache King, is another classic room escape game This game will put your searching skills to the test by requiring you to find all hidden objects and go from one door to the next. To get there, utilize all of your skills to unravel the mystery and complete each task on your own. Puzzle Quest will entice you to start on a long journey with a captivating story.
Put on your detective hat and glasses and start in search of the hidden objects so you may plot your escape. To resolve the multiple numbers and letter mazes, answer the riddles, unlock the locks, and examine the clues revealed.
Prepare yourself for risk and a lot of unexpected twists. To unlock the door, complete the tasks. Tackle tricky riddles to unlock more items and demonstrate your key-finding skills. There are several strange stages in the game, each with its own escape strategy. Enjoy an hour of mind-bending entertainment!
Pleasurable Puzzles you may put your mind to the test while having fun with this brain teaser of a game. Push out your brain and exercise your mind to solve the challenging puzzles.
There are several enigma puzzles to give you time. Try this game as a source of enjoyment to relieve stress, and you'll become addicted to our one-of-a-kind stories.
If you enjoy completing difficult riddles, don't miss out on this challenging puzzle-solving quest.
GAME STORY:
Once upon a time, there was a Moustache King with a long moustache who ruled a kingdom. Everything was fine and good in his Kingdom. But one fine day, a fortnight before his daughter Pearl’s wedding, she is abducted by a vile witch. The King sets a troupe and moves further in search of his daughter through woods and valleys.
Will he get any clue?
Where is the Witch?
To know more, let’s explore along with the King. Help him in finding his daughter Pearl. And return before the eve of the wedding.
Features:
- 100 Challenging levels.
- Enjoy uninterrupted ads free experience.
- Humane hints for perfect assistance.
- Daily gifts and rewards are available.
- Savable progress is enabled.
- Localized in Major Languages.
- Family Entertainer suitable for all ages.
- Challenging Tricky puzzles to solve.
- Concealed objects to explore the unique levels.
- Amazing graphics and gameplay.

bluejetty:00022327:ios.description:
Create stunning flyers, posters and invitations in minutes. No design skills needed.
Poster Maker is the easy flyer maker and poster creator for businesses, events, schools and social media. Start with 5000+ ready-made templates, customize every detail and share a professional design in just a few taps.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Design flyers, posters, invitations and business cards from templates or from scratch
• Edit text, fonts, colors, backgrounds, stickers and images
• Import your own photos or search stock images right in the app
• Remove photo backgrounds automatically with AI
• Create new images from a text prompt with the AI image generator
• Translate any template into another language instantly
• Animate your designs and export them as GIF or MP4 video
POPULAR CATEGORIES
Business, sales and promotions, parties, birthdays, weddings, graduations, school, gym and fitness, food and restaurants, holidays, Christmas, Black Friday, quotes, wanted posters, movie posters and many more.
KEY FEATURES
• 5000+ customizable flyer and poster templates
• Simple editor with crop and resize tools
• Change the background or canvas size in one tap
• Export as JPG, PNG, PDF, GIF or MP4
• Save drafts, save to your gallery or sync with iCloud
• Share directly to Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and more
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a template or start with a blank canvas
2. Customize text, colors, photos and stickers
3. Save in high quality and share anywhere
Promoting a sale, a restaurant menu, a school event or a social media campaign? Poster Maker helps you create eye-catching designs that get noticed, fast.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Use Poster Maker for free or unlock all premium templates and features with:
• Weekly subscription
• Monthly subscription with a 3-day free trial
• Yearly subscription
Prices may vary by country and are charged in your local currency. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the same price. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00132418:ios.description:
Stay connected and share with your close friends using Zapya Go. On top of being a convenient file sharing application, Zapya Go allows you to keep a low profile on its new completely private social platform. Zapya Go restricts strangers to send you friend requests and does not generate friend recommendations to you. Only those who you have shared files with before can add you as a friend on this new social platform.
Whether it is posting funny photos or a status update, you can safely share with your private circle of friends on the Moments section on Zapya Go without strangers seeing your precious moments. Now you can be social on the same app that you use to share files, manage phone contents, and play games!
Spotlight Features
l No Login Required
No personal information or other social media account is required to login and interact with your close friends on Zapya Go. You can stay anonymous and be in control of your data!
l Offline Sharing
You do not need to have an Internet connection in order to share files using Zapya Go.
l QR Code Sharing
Share and receive files easily with QR codes.
l Group Sharing
Join Group features allow you to easily share with multiple people.
Keywords: Transfer files, group sharing, social media, private apps, shareit, zapya, zapya go, zpya, zapay

bluejetty:00080332:ios.name: Tiny Warriors Rush - Idle TD
bluejetty:00080332:ios.summary:
►TOWER ABOVE THEM ALL
This tower defense game is like no other! With each battle you’ll need to choose which warriors and upgrades you’ll be using, and make adjustments each time as the level difficulty goes up. With its cool, casual style
bluejetty:00080332:ios.description:
►TOWER ABOVE THEM ALL
This tower defense game is like no other! With each battle you’ll need to choose which warriors and upgrades you’ll be using, and make adjustments each time as the level difficulty goes up. With its cool, casual style, this idle roguelike battle game is sure to please everyone, with no penalties for losing and tons of opportunities to try out different strategies to protect your kingdom and castle from the hordes of zombies.
►ADVANCE AND DEFEND
Each level consists of a battle between two towers – you’ll be both defending your own and attacking your enemies. Pick from a range of knights and other warriors, then as the battle advances, choose your bonuses and upgrades wisely to keep the advantage! Each win brings you gold and other goodies that you can use to expand your arsenal of fighters plus level them up, so get ready for the ultimate tower defense strategy game!
The best of the best:
• Ultimate upgradability – Basically everything in this tower defense masterpiece is upgradable – your castle, your heroes, your knights, their skills… the list goes on! That means that everything is ultra customizable. Enjoy leveling everything up to become the meanest knight around!
• Strategize to your heart’s content – In addition to all of the upgrades available, there’s also an element of chance to the game, meaning your planning will only get you so far. Enjoy more roguelike action thanks to randomized growth cards, while also having some control over how the battle goes by strategically choosing which warriors to send out when. If at first you don’t succeed, try, try again – this casual game doesn’t penalize you for losing. Plus, with endless waves of enemies, there’s always someone or something to try your new plan out on.
• Casual gameplay – To help get you in the mood for deep strategy, we’ve created the perfect environment: in addition to the lack of penalty for losing, sit back and enjoy the great graphics, accessible controls, idle-style gameplay, and short but sweet battles. No matter where you are you have time to squeeze in a game or two of tower defense!
►BATTLE IT OUT FOR TOP KINGDOM
Knights, prepare for battle: your castle is under attack by a wave of zombies! This idle roguelike tower defense game is a hit for young and old alike thanks to the simple mechanics and engaging gameplay. While the premise is simple (defend your tower while destroying the enemy’s castle), you’ll have endless options to upgrade your army and try out different strategies. Short bursts of battle are interrupted by chances to level up and improve, meaning there’s always something fun happening in Tiny Warriors Clash – come check it out today!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00129198:ios.description:
The first international app using astronomical Sharia-compliant criteria issued by a government institution (Islamic Affairs and Charitable Activities Department in Dubai, under the supervision of the International Astronomical Center).
The first app friendly to people of determination in this field.
Most accurate in calculating prayer times (for Muslims in all parts of the world). 
More than 50 thousand known cities and 190 countries.
Qibla by smart methods and augmented reality (360) degrees.
Contains widgets in various shapes and sizes.
The only app that allows users to calculate alternative prayer times when the Sharia signs disappear.
No annoying ads.
Takes into account the altitude when calculating prayer times.
Matches the official timings of many countries.
Flexibility in choosing the criteria for calculating prayer times (for specialists).
Determines users’ location through many options automatically, or through choosing one’s location from the world map, or choosing from a list of cities for each country.

bluejetty:00084197:ios.description:
Dive into the captivating world of "Mystery of Myths: Heart of Athens", where hidden object games meet gripping storytelling. Join Elijah Reed, an expert from the Ministry of Mysteries, as he teams up with the ancient god Pan to tackle a case that blurs the line between legend and reality. With detective games elements and immersive challenges, you’ll unravel mysteries, seek and find hidden objects, and explore iconic Greek landmarks. Can you stop the madness and save Athens from a mythical disaster?
Elijah Reed, a seasoned agent for the Ministry of Mysteries, finds himself embroiled in the most puzzling investigation of his career. This time, he heads to the heart of Greece - Athens - where ancient legends have become a sinister reality. His new partner in this quest is none other than the ancient Greek god Pan. Together they must understand what is driving the harpies mad, stop a new murderous cult, and prevent Medusa from turning everyone to stone. But the deeper they delve into the world of ancient myths, the more questions arise about where legend ends and truth begins.
Unravel Ancient Mysteries!
Dive into the heart of Athens in one of the most engaging hidden object games. Explore enchanting locations filled with secrets and seek and find hidden objects that hold the key to solving the mystery of harpy madness and uncovering the cult's dark plans!
Team Up with a God!
In this adventure game, team up with Pan, the Greek god of the wild, to outwit mythological creatures like harpies and Medusa. Use his unique abilities to uncover hidden truths and navigate a world where myths and reality collide!
Shape Your Story!
Every decision matters in this immersive story. Your choices determine the fate of Athens, its citizens, and even its legendary figures. Will you restore peace or let chaos reign?
Challenging Puzzles and Achievements!
Enjoy a mix of hidden object games and brain-teasing puzzles as you uncover clues, piece together ancient secrets, and unlock hidden achievements. The more you explore, the more surprises and rewards you’ll discover!
Uncover the truth behind the myths, navigate a world of danger and wonder, and save Athens before it’s too late in the free trial of "Mystery of Myths: Heart of Athens"!

bluejetty:00089142:ios.summary:

Unparalleled security is one of the cornerstones o
bluejetty:00089142:ios.description:
iStratus data manager handles all of your data; your calendar appointments, events, tasks, reminders and To-Do's, passwords and files easily maintained and encrypted in one convenient App.
Unparalleled security is one of the cornerstones of iStratus. Every item managed by iStratus is capable of being encrypted, and all encryption and decryption takes place on your device. This means you have the option to never transfer unprotected data to and from your device.
Additional Features:
 Calendar View
 Multiple calendars (Apple, Google, Outlook, etc. in one view)
 Recurring appointments with variable dates and times
 Repeating tasks and To-Do's
 Files, Photos, Notes
 Personalized your way
 Encrypted for your protection (before upload into the cloud)
 Tasking of any item
The iStratus "tasking" feature allows you to make any item an action item. Simply "task it" with an open or set due date. Once an item is "tasked," it is treated as a unique task allowing for organization, management, and completion tracking.
Organize all of your tasks by:
 Tagging
 Completion date
 Personalized themes
 Encryption, as needed
 Searchable
 Store them on your iPhone or iPad and in the cloud (Dropbox, Google drive, iCloud)
 Daily roll-up of all open tasks
Create, store and manage these:
 Create a document
 Create a checklist
 Take a few notes
 Take a photo
 Create a voice memo
 Use the included PDF maker to automatically create cropped document scans
 Open an email attachment with iStratus
 Open your existing documents (on device or stored in the cloud)
 Encrypt any item for security
 Track and manage of all of your passwords
The iStratus "Calendar View" is much more than just an appointment calendar. In addition to your appointments for the day, you will also see tasks, todo’s, and other items that need follow up.
Every day, whether it's a piece of mail, a business card, a new contact, or an e-mail, we have a constant stream of information we need to capture, store, organize, and follow up on later. iStratus is the only tool you need to manage all of the information in your life.
With iStratus managing your information, your daily tasks become easier. You capture info as it occurs, organize it however you would like, and "task it" when a follow-up is necessary. iStratus is there to make organizing your day as simple as possible.
Simply capture it, then "Task it" with iStratus!
Additional Features:
Password Vault – Store all your passwords on your device 
Encryption – Encrypt files and folders using AES-256 encryption
Encryption Manager – Manage your encrypted items with a master password
Advanced PDF maker – quickly capture and edit any document
Sign any item – add your signature
Daily Roll up – Open items roll up every day
iStratus Pro Terms of Service:
(also available at https://istratus.com/iOS/Features/Pro/terms_of_service.html)
iStratus Pro is a subscription service that offers enhanced features and user interfaces for creating, organizing, and interacting with data in iStratus.
• iStratus Pro includes Daily RollUp, File Encryption, and PDF Signing.
• As new features are added to iStratus Pro they are automatically unlocked for all current iStratus Pro subscribers.
• An active iStratus Pro subscription is not required to access or view content created using iStratus Pro features, including content shared by an iStratus Pro user or content created or modified during an iStratus Pro subscription that has lapsed. For example, Password Vault entries are still accessible if the iStratus Pro subscription is cancelled, but they can not be modified.
• iStratus Pro is automatically renewed at 99¢ monthly or $9.99 yearly depending on the subscription term chosen and is billed through the Apple Inc. App Store. Information about cancelling subscriptions can be found at support.apple.com.
• For more information please contact support@iStratus.com

bluejetty:00159960:ios.summary:

Using the perspective distortion functionality, now you can enter the wo
bluejetty:00159960:ios.description:
Tracing Buddy is a drawing grid and anamorphic images creation tool. 
Built for simplicity, Tracing Buddy allows you to easily transfer pictures to a drawing surface
Using the perspective distortion functionality, now you can enter the world of drawing illusions. First, apply the distortion to your images and then transfer them to a drawing surface with a grid
The app is optimized for both iPhone and iPad use, including Dark Mode support
Grid Features:
- Square divisions or choose the preferred aspect ratio
- Change color and transparency of grid lines
- Choose from four subdivision styles and change color and transparency as you wish
- Change the grid background color and the transparency of your image
- Change the scale and position of your image relative to the whole grid
- Save grid settings in projects
Image Features:
- Choose from a regular image, line art style, black & white values, or remove backgrounds with the person detection filter
-With the B&W and values filter you change your image to black & white, adjust shadows and highlights to you liking with the included tone curve and reduce the number of values in the picture to a more manageable amount. With the value selection tool you can inspect where values are placed in your image
- Use the person detection filter to remove the backgrounds of pictures with people in them, change to a transparent or solid color background instead
Anamorphic images:
- Add perspective distortion to your images choosing from two method: AR or using a picture
- In AR method let Tracing Buddy guide you through the whole process, you only need an iOS device equipped with AR capabilities
- If you need more control about the distortion, you can take a picture from your phone or with external camera and apply the distortion manually, for this method to be effective, you need to know the dimensions of the surface you want to transfer your picture to
Premium Features Add-on (either by subscription or lifetime purchase) required for:
- Ad removal
- Premium Image filters
- Multiple Project management
- PNG type export
Privacy Policy:
https://lafappbrica.com/tracing-buddy-privacy-policy
Terms of use
https://lafappbrica.com/tracing-buddy-terms/

bluejetty:00072967:ios.description:
Shark Attack: Hungry Fish takes you on a thrilling underwater adventure where only the strongest survive. Dive into the deep blue ocean and take control of a hungry fish whose only goal is to eat, grow, and dominate the sea. From shallow reefs to darker depths, the ocean is filled with life—and danger.
Begin your journey as a small shark and hunt tiny fish to satisfy your hunger. Each meal helps you grow bigger, faster, and more powerful. As you evolve, new areas open up, filled with larger prey and more aggressive predators. But be careful—one wrong move against a stronger enemy can end your run instantly. Survival requires quick reflexes, smart decision-making, and perfect timing.
The ocean is alive with colorful fish, hostile sharks, deadly sea creatures, and unexpected obstacles. Avoid mines, traps, and powerful bosses lurking beneath the waves. Use your speed and instincts to chase prey, escape danger, and become the ultimate predator. The deeper you swim, the tougher the challenges become.
With smooth and intuitive controls, vibrant underwater environments, and addictive arcade-style gameplay, Shark Attack: Hungry Fish offers endless fun and replayability. Compete for high scores, push your limits, and see how long you can survive in a world where everything is trying to eat you. Eat fast, grow stronger, and prove that you are the true king of the ocean.

bluejetty:00183687:ios.description:
Qonto makes day-to-day banking easier for SMEs and freelancers, thanks to an online business account combined with invoicing, bookkeeping and spend management tools. With an innovative product, highly responsive 24/7 customer service and clear pricing, Qonto has become the European leader in its category.
Master your daily finances with a powerful business account
 • Local IBANS
 • Payment cards: spend up to €200,000/month. No hidden costs. Pay online or in-store, at home and abroad: whatever the situation, our range of free and premium corporate cards included in your subscription has got you covered.
 • Transfers: flexible payment methods - from instant SEPA to speedy international transfers - so you can pay and get paid faster.
 • Get paid anywhere: accept payments in-store, on the move with Tap to Pay on iPhone, or online with Payment links. Enjoy faster access to funds with zero friction.
 • Transactions: unlimited history and real-time notifications.
 • Financing: simplified access to integrated financing options: apply in minutes for our partners financing deals or ease your supplier payments with our in-house financing offer, Pay later.
Unchain your growth with a suite of financial tools
 • Invoice management: centralize invoices & receipts in one place; get paid fast and pay your suppliers even faster.
 • Spend management: control team spending with budgets, automatic receipt collection & tailored access.
 • Bookkeeping: collaborate seamlessly with your accountant by connecting them to our suite of tools; get a full, real-time cash flow overview.
 • Cash flow management: track the journey of every euro, forecast cash gaps in the weeks ahead, and see VAT updates in real time; let your unified dashboard translate scattered financial data into an actionable business roadmap.
Follow Qonto for news and company updates.

bluejetty:00116279:ios.description:
Download the full game and try it for a limited time!
Burn rubber and shred metal in the ultimate driving playground!
Wreckfest is jam-packed with upgrade and customization options. Whether you are preparing for your next demolition derby with reinforced bumpers, roll cages, side protectors and much more, or setting your car up for a banger race with engine performance parts like air filters, camshafts, fuel systems, etc., Wreckfest is shaping up to be the best combative motorsport game out there. 
• Unique Racing Experience – Exhilarating no-rules racing action with defining, once-in-a-lifetime moments that can be achieved only with a true-to-life physics simulation. Witness insane neck-to-neck fighting on high-speed circuits, face total destruction madness on crazy courses with intersections and oncoming traffic, or go for demolition dominance in derby arenas.
• Awesome Cars – Our cars are old, banged up, patched together... They ooze style and character! From old American heavy-hitters to agile Europeans and fun Asians, you won’t find anything like this in other games. 
• Meaningful Customization – Change not only the look of your cars but also upgrade their body armor – Reinforce them with heavy iron that protects you from damage, but also adds weight, which impacts the car's handling. Modify your car to make a robust tank or a fragile but lightning-fast rocket, or anything in between!
• Multiplayer – Wreck your friends in local multiplayer and take racing to the limit while chasing demolition dominance!
• Challenge modes – Have hilarious fun with crop harvesters, lawn mowers, school buses, three-wheelers, and much more! 
• Career Mode – Battle for championships, earn experience, unlock new upgrades and cars, and become the all-time Wreckfest champion!
© www.handy-games.com GmbH

• Bill payments
• Mobile credit & data package purchases
• E-wallet top-ups
• QRIS payments
• Cardless cash withdrawals and deposits
3. Additional features

4. Control and security
Manage your cards and transaction limits, block or unblock your cards, and use biometric login for added security.
OCTO App is designed to provide a practical, secure, and flexible banking experience anytime and anywhere.

1. Use your personal mobile number for registration
2. Do not share your USER ID, PIN, or OTP with anyone
3. The app is free, SMS charges follow your mobile operator
For more information & assistance, please contact us via Ask OCTO in the OCTO App or WhatsApp +6281197814041.

listings.name: OCTO by CIMB Niaga
listings.description:
OCTO App is a digital banking application from CIMB Niaga that makes it easy for you to manage your finances in one place.
 
Main features of the OCTO App:
1. Product opening and management
• Open a new account
• Time deposits & savings
• Investments (mutual funds & bonds)
• Insurance
 
2. Comprehensive daily transactions
• Interbank & international transfers
• Bill payments
• Mobile credit & data package purchases
• E-wallet top-ups
• QRIS payments
• Cardless cash withdrawals and deposits
 
3. Additional features
Enjoy conveniences such as flight ticket purchases and various attractive promotions that are updated regularly.
 
4. Control and security
Manage your cards and transaction limits, block or unblock your cards, and use biometric login for added security.
 
OCTO App is designed to provide a practical, secure, and flexible banking experience anytime and anywhere.
 
Important notes:
1. Use your personal mobile number for registration
2. Do not share your USER ID, PIN, or OTP with anyone
3. The app is free, SMS charges follow your mobile operator
 
For more information & assistance, please contact us via Ask OCTO in the OCTO App or WhatsApp +6281197814041.

bluejetty:00081937:ios.description:
Indie Wrestler is a tap based mobile game; made by wrestling fans for wrestling fans. The idea behind it is pretty simple – we wanted to give you the opportunity to create a character and take them to the top of the wrestling world.
How do you do that? By getting yourself over. Have great matches, cut promos and win titles. You get to train your wrestler, work for different promotions, upgrade your gear and even react to online gossip, rumours and innuendo. And that’s just the tip of the iceberg. It’s truly a unique game that hasn’t been developed for the wrestling scene before.
The ultimate goal of the game is to make it to the biggest promotion in the game and become their world champion. And then test your long term drawing power out to see how long you can stay on top for.

Step into a colorful world of creativity with all your favorite MY LITTLE PONY™ characters! Color hundreds of images to gather enough memory stars to help rebuild and decorate the Museum of your dreams. It’s fun and easy to color all your favorite ponies and reminisce wonderful memories from MY LITTLE PONY: Friendship is Magic!
My Little Pony Color By Magic is the ponies’ most colorful adventure yet!
• COLOR – Create magical masterpieces featuring TWILIGHT SPARKLE, RAINBOW DASH, PINKIE PIE and many more. The best part: you get to relive your favorite moments from MY LITTLE PONY: Friendship is Magic!
• RESTORE – A Museum filled with memories! Complete colorful tasks to gather enough memory stars to restore the Museum of Friendship to its former glory!
• DECORATE – Use your design skills to turn all the rooms in the Museum from DRAB to FAB with choices YOU make. How fabulous!
• CREATE – Free your imagination and creativity in the Art Studio. Let the artist in you shine with all of the glitter and colors!
• RELAX – Simple and fun to use, suitable for fans of all ages!
Stay tuned for new images added regularly!
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- This app may offer monthly and yearly subscriptions
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period 
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but please note that you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription
- Users may be offered a free trial of the subscription
- One free trial per account, on new subscriptions only
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
PRIVACY & ADVERTISING
Budge Studios takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps are compliant with privacy laws. This application has received the “ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) Privacy Certified Kids’ Privacy Seal”. For more information, please visit our privacy policy at: https://budgestudios.com/en/legal/privacy-policy/, or email our Data Protection Officer at: privacy@budgestudios.ca
Before you download this app, please note that it is free to try, but some content may only be available via a paid subscription or in-app purchases. In-app purchases cost real money and are charged to your account. To disable or adjust the ability to make in-app purchases, change your device settings. This app contains contextual advertising for other Budge Studios apps and our partners’ apps. Budge Studios does not permit behavioral advertising or retargeting in this app. The app may also contain social media links that are only accessible behind a parental gate.

Budge Studios was founded in 2010 with the mission to entertain and educate children around the world, through innovation, creativity and fun. bluejetty:00145668:ios.description:
Pigu.lt mobilioji parduotuvė - tai populiariausios elektroninės parduotuvės Lietuvoje Pigu.lt mobilioji aplikacija. Internetinės prekybos programėlė yra prieinama jūsų mobiliajame
įrenginyje per kelias akimirkas.
Atsisiųskite Pigu.lt mobiliąją aplikaciją į savo išmanųjį telefoną ar planšetinį kompiuterį ir naršykite milijonus kasdienių prekių visur, kur turite interneto ryšį.
Internetinės prekybos platforma Pigu.lt yra tam puikus įrankis.
Naudokitės patogia paieška, filtruokite ir suraskite sau tinkamiausias prekes vos keletu piršto paspaudimų. Apsipirkimas internetu niekada anksčiau nebuvo toks lengvas.
Už pirkinius atsiskaitykite saugiai apmokėdami juos jums patogiausiu būdu: banko kortele, elektronine bankininkyste, pavedimu, lizingu ar grynaisiais pinigais atsiėmimo metu. Saugus apsipirkimas internetu yra sėkmingų pirkinių pagrindas.
Internetinio pardavimo platforma leidžia atsiimti prekes Pigu.lt atsiėmimo centruose Vilniuje, Kaune, Klaipėdoje, Šiauliuose ir Panevėžyje, Pigu terminaluose, Lietuvos pašto skyriuose, LP EXPRESS siuntų savitarnos terminaluose ar Omniva paštomatuose. Taip pat siūlome apsipirkti su pristatymu į namus.
_________________________________________________
Pigu.lt yra geriausias įrankis kasdieniams pirkiniams Lietuvoje.
1. Pirkite produktus internete, peržiūrint juos pagal kategorijas.
2. Ieškokite prekių naudodamiesi paieškos, filtravimo bei rūšiavimo funkcijomis.
3. Naršykite ir gaukite panašių prekių rekomendacijas.
4. Gaukite pranešimus ir pirmieji sužinosite apie vykstančias akcijas ir išpardavimus.
5. Pirkite internetu ir mokėkite saugiai per elektroninę bankininkystę, banko pavedimu, lizingu arba grynaisiais.
6. Sekite savo užsakymo būseną ir peržiūrėkite užsakymų istoriją.
7. Peržiūrėkite ir redaguokite savo profilio informaciją.
8. Pasitikrinkite PiguEurų likutį.
9. Peržiūrėkite Pigu VIP KLUBO pasiūlymus.
10. Susikurkite savo norų sąrašą.
11. Pirkiniai programoje Pigu.lt yra dar patogesni! Kompiuteryje, planšetėje ar telefone - savo Pigu.lt pirkinių krepšelį rasite visur. Jums tereikia prisijungti prie savo Pigu.lt paskyros.
__________________________________________________
Pigu.lt mobilioji parduotuvė - tai prekybos centras jūsų kišenėje. Apsipirkti dar niekada nebuvo taip patogu!
Pigu.lt yra internetinė elektronikos parduotuvė su daugeliu produktų kategorijų, įskaitant:
Kvepalai, kosmetika, kompiuterinė technika, buitinė technika ir elektronika, sportas, laisvalaikis, turizmas, santechnika, remontas, šildymas, baldai ir namų interjeras, mobilūs
telefonai, foto ir video, sodo prekės, gyvūnų prekės, kaip reklamoje matytos prekės, vaikams ir kūdikiams, virtuvės, buities, apyvokos prekės, apranga, avalynė, aksesuarai, auto prekės, dovanos, šventinė atributika.
Pirkite internetu geriausius prekės ženklus, įskaitant:
Samsung, Sony, Bosch, Whirpool, Calvin Klein, Chanel, Diesel, Hugo Boss, MSI, Dell, Apple, Asus, Lenovo, Easy Camp, Intex, Hammer, Karcher, Outwell, Adata, Huawei, HTC, Tomtom, Panasonic, Nokia, Hitachi, Stanley, Dunlop, Osram, Royal Canin, Brit, Josera, Friskies, Chicco, Avent, Pampers, Barbie, Fiskars, Keter, Al-ko, iPhone.
Turime daugiau nei 4000 partnerių, tiekiančių prekes Europoje, Azijoje ir Amerikoje. Tai užtikrina pigius aukštos kokybės pirkinius ir platų žinomų gaminių asortimentą.
__________________________________________________
Apsipirkti per programėlę Pigu.lt yra nepaprastai patogu!
Mes visada laukiame jūsų atsiliepimų. Jeigu turite pastebėjimų, nusiskundimų ar pasiūlymų, rašykite mums el. paštu kokybe@pigu.lt.
Linkime Jums gero apsipirkimo Pigu.lt mobiliojoje parduotuvėje!

bluejetty:00040642:ios.description:
Flouci is your super-app that does everything banking, transactions and payments. Open your free bank account in a few minutes on your phone and get the real digital banking experience - instant money transfers, quick payments in-store and online, easy integrations, and everything in between. 
GET A FREE BANK ACCOUNT
Open a free bank account in a few minutes. All you have to do is follow the instructions, upload the needed documents, and sign your contract. Your new account is directly linked to your Flouci wallet. You can use the account number to deposit your salary or receive payments directly to your account. 
SEND & RECEIVE MONEY
Send and receive money to and from anybody that has a Flouci wallet. It’s easy, cheap, and secure. And it’s pretty instant. All you have to do is enter their number or scan their personal QR code to connect to their profile. You enter the amount and confirm. You both then receive a confirmation, and you’re done!

Are you a merchant yourself? You can integrate Flouci and start accepting payments in-store and online too! 
No waiting lines, no more looking for change, or finding out you forgot your wallet at home. 
Sign up today and stop worrying about waiting lines and cash!

bluejetty:00073375:ios.description:
Kryss is a crossword game you can play solo or with friends. Take turns with the computer, a random player, or someone you know.
Every game brings a Scandinavian-style crossword, also known as an arrowword, that you haven't solved before, with clues and drawings to help you. Crossword puzzles and arrow words in 12 languages, free to play.
HOW TO PLAY
You get five letters each turn and one minute to place them in the shared crossword. Score bonus points for completing words, getting the key letters right, and using all five letters in one turn. Every letter you place stays on the board for the other player too, so sometimes it pays to save a letter for later.
PLAY YOUR WAY
- Solo: take turns with the computer
- Random: get matched with another player
- Friends: play with friends and family, and tease your best friend in the chat for being the slowest player in the universe
- Up to 20 games at the same time, with a notification when it's your turn
WHAT'S INSIDE
- A different crossword puzzle in every game, created by crossword authors around the world
- Daily Puzzles, events, and missions with prizes
- 12 languages: English, Spanish, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish, Dutch, and Russian
A WORD GAME FOR YOUR BRAIN
Kryss is yoga for the brain and vocabulary training in one game, easy to pick up for young and old.
Privacy Policy: https://kryss.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://kryss.app/terms-of-service.html

Sight & Sound TV is your front-row seat to exclusive live broadcasts, special events, and encore performances from the Sight & Sound stage. Take the experience further with a peek behind the curtain, meet the animal actors, and go inside the design studio to see what it takes to bring these timeless stories to life.
Sight & Sound is a ministry on a mission. What started over 40 years ago as a traveling multimedia show has become a destination for more than 25 million people, with two state-of-the-art theaters in Lancaster, PA, and Branson, MO. Now with Sight & Sound TV, there are more ways than ever to experience a Sight & Sound show. But beyond the spectacle of the production, we are even more passionate about the significance of these stories and creating opportunities for people to be inspired by Scripture in a brand-new way.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Sight & Sound TV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://www.sight-sound.tv/tos

bluejetty:00185132:ios.description:
Join a brilliant hexagonal twist on match-3, Hexa Blast! 
Bash enemies by matching monsters and mixing powerful bombs to save gingerbreads! Blast Hexagonal! 
Install this unique puzzle game & start the adventure today!
Get tons of rewards as you play daily and beat the stages. 3000+ stages and more on the way, plus Secret Quests and Weekly Championships! Install the best match 3 puzzle game to your mobile device & start the adventure today! 
Do you think you have what it takes to match the same colored monsters, and save the gingerbread cookie friends? Monster Busters: Hexa Blast is a brilliant match three puzzle game – a brand new yet classic match 3 style game with a hexagonal twist. If you love fun casual games and match three games, you are bound to love Hexa Blast.
***Join a Mind Blowing Adventure***
Play on a board composed of hexagons, beat the evil monsters and climb the monster tower. Save the gingerbread friends as you clear stages with various challenges climbing up the tower! Progress in the game by swapping monsters and matching colors in order to destroy them. Match 3 in a row or more and the tiles explode! 
***Train Your Brain & Sharpen up Your Senses***
Are fun brain puzzles your thing? If so, you have come to the right place! Monster Busters: Hexa Blast offers an intelligent, energetic and fun playing experience. Use your brain power as the puzzles become more challenging. Only the most determined players will be able to beat this match three game. 
***Play With Your Friends***
What better way is there to celebrate friendship than by destroying monsters together and giving each other gifts and lives? With Hexa Blast, you are never alone. Invite your friends to join the party or meet new ones from the official Facebook fan group – just search for Hexa Blast on Facebook and join the festivity. 
***Fun & Fresh Tile Matching Game***
Hexa Blast is not your average match 3 puzzle game. It offers unique gameplay experience with an engaging cartoon design, a wide variety of items, original sounds and a storyline that will keep you on your toes. So what are you waiting for? If you love awesome and addicting games, Hexa Blast is the one for you!
Here’s what the users have to say about Hexa Blast:
"Addictive, challenging, all the fun of the original Monster Busters but with a hexa twist to it." - T. Deacy
"My favorite color matching game since Zuma & Puyo Puyo" J. Rodgers
“Wildly entertaining and addictive. Graphics are superb. Diverse play. Challenging but not frustrating.” – C. Wimmer
Features:
- Over 3000 stages, each episode filled with different concept of challenge.
- Tons of coin rewards when you beat the boards, complete weekly challenges, and more.
- Breath taking cartoon style design with Arabian themed artwork.
- Wide variety of unique items & avatars.
- Challenging boss fights.
What’s there to hesitate?! Your crazy fun adventure is awaiting here!
* We are collecting advertising identifiers for marketing purposes.
If you don't want to collect, you can stop collecting in the way below.
- Device settings -> Privacy -> Tracking -> allow Apps to Request to Track

Access global markets from a single account. Whether you're new to trading or an experienced trader, YUBIT brings together powerful trading tools, deep liquidity, and a seamless trading experience across mobile and web.

Access a wide range of crypto and traditional financial markets, all on YUBIT.

- Crypto

- Stocks 
- Forex 
- Indices 
- Oil & Commodities

- User assets backed 1:1 with Proof of Reserves

Deposit supported cryptocurrencies directly to your YUBIT account using your deposit address or QR code. Manage your assets and transfers conveniently from within the app.
Trade Anytime, Anywhere
Access YUBIT across mobile and web and stay connected to the markets wherever you are.
Trade Crypto, Gold, Stocks, Forex and more — all from one platform.
24/7 Customer Support

For any inquiries, contact us at bd@yubit.com — we’re always here to help.
Download YUBIT and start exploring global markets today.

bluejetty:00141239:ios.description:
PoolMath makes swimming pool care, maintenance and management easy by tracking chlorine, pH, alkalinity and other levels to help calculate how much salt, bleach and other chemicals to add. Keep swimming in your TroubleFreePool with Pool Math.
Crystal clear algae free pool water is what Trouble Free Pool Math is committed to. Pool Math performs all the calculations you need to keep your chlorine, pH, calcium, alkalinity, and stabilizer levels balanced. 
Why choose Pool Math over the others?
Other apps claim to make testing easy by using test strips and your phone's camera. Unfortunately, this is simply too good to be true. Test strips are notoriously inaccurate and end up costing you much more money in both chemicals and the tests themselves in the long run. Trouble Free Pool believes using a proper test kit is much easier, effective, and economical in the long run.
By following these calculations the pool owner achieves and maintains crystal clear water without reliance on the often unproductive advice and unneeded expense from pool stores.
Pool Math's great features include:
 • Calculators for pH, Free Chlorine, Calcium Hardness, Salt, Total Alkalinity, Calcium Hardness, Borates, CSI
 • Track Maintenance: Backwashing, Vacuuming, Filter Cleaning, Filter Pressure, SWG Cell %, Flow Rate
 • Track Chemical Additions
 • Track Weather conditions with your logs
 • Calculate the Effects of Adding chemicals to your pool
 • Bleach Price Calculator - Find the best deals on bleach easily
 • Summary page to see an overview of test results and chemical additions
 • Data backup / Export
Premium Subscribers get access to these additional features:
 • Unlimited Test Log History Storage
 • Maintenance Reminders
 • Cloud Sync/Backup
 • Sync across multiple devices
 • Unlimited Pool / Spa Configurations
 • Test Log CSV Import / Export

PoolMath makes swimming pool care, maintenance and management easy by tracking chlorine, pH, alkalinity and other levels to help calculate how much salt, bleach and other chemicals to add.  Keep swimming in your TroubleFreePool with Pool Math.

Crystal clear algae free pool water is what Trouble Free Pool Math is committed to.  Pool Math performs all the calculations you need to keep your chlorine, pH, calcium, alkalinity, and stabilizer levels balanced.  

Why choose Pool Math over the others?

Other apps claim to make testing easy by using test strips and your phone's camera.  Unfortunately, this is simply too good to be true.  Test strips are notoriously inaccurate and end up costing you much more money in both chemicals and the tests themselves in the long run.  Trouble Free Pool believes using a proper test kit is much easier, effective, and economical in the long run.

By following these calculations the pool owner achieves and maintains crystal clear water without reliance on the often unproductive advice and unneeded expense from pool stores.

Pool Math's great features include:
  • Calculators for pH, Free Chlorine, Calcium Hardness, Salt, Total Alkalinity, Calcium Hardness, Borates, CSI
  • Track Maintenance: Backwashing, Vacuuming, Filter Cleaning, Filter Pressure, SWG Cell %, Flow Rate
  • Track Chemical Additions
  • Track Weather conditions with your logs
  • Calculate the Effects of Adding chemicals to your pool
  • Bleach Price Calculator - Find the best deals on bleach easily
  • Summary page to see an overview of test results and chemical additions
  • Data backup / Export

Premium Subscribers get access to these additional features:
  • Unlimited Test Log History Storage
  • Maintenance Reminders
  • Cloud Sync/Backup
  • Sync across multiple devices
  • Unlimited Pool / Spa Configurations
  • Test Log CSV Import / Export

Pool Math Premium Subscription details:
  • Auto-renewable subscription
  • 1 year for $7.99 USD
  • Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration of 1 year) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
  • Privacy Policy & Terms of Use: http://poolmathapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00034993:ios.summary: Take a satisfying break with Mini Fidget Antistress Games, a colorful collection of 45+ relaxing mini games, virtual fidget toys, ASMR games, drawing games, emoji puzzles, brain games, and quick challenges. Pop bubbles, spin a fidget spinne
bluejetty:00034993:ios.description:
Take a satisfying break with Mini Fidget Antistress Games, a colorful collection of 45+ relaxing mini games, virtual fidget toys, ASMR games, drawing games, emoji puzzles, brain games, and quick challenges. Pop bubbles, spin a fidget spinner, peel stickers, play with slime, crack virtual glass, draw missing parts, match emojis, and discover a new way to play whenever your mood changes.
ONE GAME, MANY WAYS TO PLAY
Move freely between antistress games, satisfying games, puzzle games, fidget games, drawing games, matching games, and light skill challenges. Every activity is easy to start, whether you want a peaceful break, playful sensory fun, a clever brain puzzle, or a quick test of timing and control.
FIDGET AND POP IT FUN
Explore interactive fidget toys including Pop It, Shape Pop It, Bubble Up, Fidget Spinner, Pendulum, Newton’s Cradle, and Music Speaker. Tap, spin, pop, press, plug and move each toy to discover responsive visual effects. Fans of pop it toys and virtual fidget games can quickly choose a favorite and start playing.
SATISFYING ASMR ACTIVITIES
Enjoy Sticker Peel, Slime, Glass Crack, Stamp It, Blackboard, and Light Bulb activities. These satisfying ASMR games focus on taps, peels, pops, smooth movement, and playful visual feedback. Try slime games, create patterns, peel stickers, and make cracks appear across a virtual glass screen.
DRAWING, EMOJI, AND BRAIN PUZZLES
Think, draw, match, and solve with creative drawing puzzle games:
 Draw One Part – Study each picture, understand what is missing, and draw the part needed to complete the scene.
• Draw to Crush – Draw a useful line or shape, use gravity and physics, and crush the target to complete the level.
• Emoji Match – Connect related emojis, discover clever associations, and solve colorful emoji puzzles.
Change the pace with Tile Puzzle Block, Flip Card, and Tic-Tac-Toe. These brain games and logic puzzles combine observation, memory, creativity, and simple problem-solving. Whether you enjoy drawing puzzles, physics puzzles, emoji games, matching games, or classic puzzles, there is always something different to try.
QUICK SKILL CHALLENGES
Test your timing, aim, and control in Knife Hit, Tap Tap Shots, Snooker, Gyroballs, Pong Ball, and Insect Swat. Choose a calm activity when you want to unwind, or try a quick challenge when you want more action.
WHY YOU’LL ENJOY IT
• 45+ relaxing mini games and interactive activities
• Fidget toys, satisfying games, drawing games, emoji games, and puzzles in one collection
• Draw One Part, Draw to Crush, Emoji Match, Pop It, slime, and more
• Simple tap, swipe, drag, draw, match, and tilt controls
• Colorful visuals with clear and responsive interactions
• Short activities that fit easily into your day
Whether you are searching for relaxing games, stress relief games, or anxiety relief activities, choose the type of casual play that suits your mood. Explore pop it toys, fidget play, satisfying ASMR activities, drawing puzzles, emoji matching, casual games, and quick challenges in one varied collection.
Pick an activity and start popping, spinning, peeling, drawing, matching, tapping, aiming, or solving.

- Personalized gym & home workout plan: see the body of your dreams in just 8 weeks

- Scientifically proven results for maximum weight loss and muscle gains

- Track your body weight and transformation after each workout

bluejetty:00044398:ios.description:
Ever wanted to become a VTuber but found custom models too expensive or confusing?
Avvy is here to help!
With Avvy, you can easily create and customize your own 2D anime-style avatar using just your smartphone—no complicated art commissions or expensive tools required. Once you’ve built your character, our high-quality face tracking technology brings it to life in real time. Plus, you can connect Avvy to streaming software like OBS for YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, and more, so you can kick off your VTuber journey at no cost.
=============================
Highly Customizable 2D Avatars】
・Mix and match hairstyles, outfits, and colors to craft your ideal anime avatar
・Enjoy the freedom to design a character that truly represents you—no art skills needed
【High-Quality Face Tracking】
・Move your avatar in real time with smooth, Live2D-like animations
・Your smartphone camera detects facial expressions, so lip-sync and eye movements sync flawlessly
【Stream Anywhere You Like】
・Seamlessly connect Avvy with OBS or other broadcast tools
・Stream on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok—whatever platform you prefer
=============================
What Avvy Solves
“I want to stream with a unique avatar, but custom illustrations or 3D modeling are too pricey…”
“I’m camera-shy but want to show expressions during live streams…”
“I’m not sure how to begin my VTuber or V-Liver adventure…”
Avvy has your back.
Just grab your smartphone, build a VTuber avatar, and use our face tracking to start streaming or creating content right away. It’s that simple!
Getting Started in 3 Easy Steps
1.Customize Your Avatar
・Pick your favorite hairstyle, outfit, and colors—create a 2D avatar that’s 100% you
2.Camera-Based Face Tracking
・Your phone’s front camera captures expressions in real time
・Mouth movements, eye tracking, and more instantly reflect on your avatar
3.Stream or Record
・Link Avvy to OBS for live broadcasts, or record to make MVs, singing videos, and more
・Monetize on platforms like YouTube, Twitch, TikTok—wherever your audience is waiting
Perfect For:
・Anyone looking to become a VTuber or V-Liver
・Creators who want to engage fans without showing their real face
・People eager to use anime-style 2D avatars for streaming or video production
・Those seeking low-cost but full-featured tools for creative projects
=============================
Stay Connected!
・Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/avvy.live/
・TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@avvy.live
・X (formerly Twitter): https://x.com/avvy_live
We regularly share the latest updates, tips, and behind-the-scenes info—so be sure to follow us and watch Avvy evolve!

bluejetty:00122517:ios.summary: Check your account balance, make payments, manage your cards, plan your budget and more: the BEKB app gives you mobile access to all your BEKB accounts, custody accounts and cards. Personalise the settings to suit your needs and take care o
bluejetty:00122517:ios.description:
Check your account balance, make payments, manage your cards, plan your budget and more: the BEKB app gives you mobile access to all your BEKB accounts, custody accounts and cards. Personalise the settings to suit your needs and take care of all your banking business, easily and securely.
Your app, your needs
Personalise your home screen, navigation and product views:
- Place the functions you use most often on the navigation bar.
- Decide what appears on your home screen and in what order. 
- Add accounts, cards and custody accounts to your favourites.
Wealth
Get a clear picture of your finances:
- Accounts: overview, balance history, transaction details
- Custody accounts: overview, order overview, details of securities
- Cards: overview with limit(s)
- Payments: overview incl. pending/executed payments
- Income, expenses and budget in the financial assistant.
Payments
Make payments simply, securely and quickly:
- Consult payments overview
- Create domestic and international payments
- Find creditors quickly thanks to automated suggestions
- Share or scan QR-Invoices
- Transfer money between accounts in real time
- Receive eBill invoices and approve them in the eBill portal
- View and approve eBill invoices directly
- Manage standing orders
Financing
Get a clear picture of all your financing:
- View mortgages and loans (including balance, interest rate and term)
- View business loans (including interest rate and limit)
Accounts and cards
Keep control of your accounts and cards:
- Consult account overview and transaction details
- View custody account overview and details of securities
- Show card overview with limit(s)
- Manage geoblocking
- Block lost cards
Securities
Track the status of your stock market orders:
- Create stock market orders (buy/sell)
- Consult order overview
- View details of securities held
Financial assistant
Use the services provided by the financial assistant:
- Analyse your income and expenses
- Categorise transactions
- Plan your budget
- Define savings goals
Other functions
Take advantage of additional functions:
- Display emergency/contact numbers
- Receive and send messages
- Set up TWINT
- Use the currency calculator
- Read BEKB Flash magazine
Requirements
You must have an e-banking contract in order to use the BEKB app. The device has to be registered in the BEKB client portal before you can start using the BEKB app. For security reasons, it is not possible to log in to both the BEKB client portal and the BEKB app at the same time. Use a device with an up-to-date operating system.
Security
The BEKB app offers the same level of security as the BEKB client portal. Authentication is based on state-of-the-art technological security procedures. Data is strongly encrypted prior to transmission. Moreover, additional approval is required for certain payments. You are automatically logged out whenever the BEKB app is closed.

Zangari

bluejetty:00045642:ios.description:
Zangari
Nossa história começa em 1974, um ano nada fácil para nosso país em termos de economia. Contrariando expectativas pessimistas, Stefano Zangari, contador e economista, fundou no bairro do Itaim Bibi na cidade de São Paulo a Organização Zangari, voltada a prestar serviços de contabilidade.
Nossa história nos fez uma das mais conceituadas administradoras de bens e de condomínios da maior cidade da América Latina, nos fazendo olhar para o passado com orgulho, e para o futuro com confiança.
Tanto pelo site da Zangari quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a Zangari, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para zangari@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00099106:ios.description:
Spirit Chat Box is a word-based spirit communication app for ghost hunters and paranormal investigators. Start a session, watch words appear one at a time, hear each one spoken aloud, and keep live sensor readings beside you as your investigation unfolds.
It brings spirit box, ghost detector, ghost radar, and ghost talker features together in one clean, easy-to-use app for iPhone and iPad.
Start a session
Words appear at a steady pace, and each one is read aloud. Choose a female or male spirit voice. Download your chosen language’s voice once, then use it offline.
Session history
Every word is saved with a timestamp and grouped by session. Look back over past sessions, share one, or share your whole log.
Live sensor dashboard
Follow EMF, compass, accelerometer, and gyroscope readings live, and arrange the cards to suit your setup. Sensor availability varies by device.
A word bank built for variety
In every app language, words are selected and weighted by our custom system to help keep sessions varied. Pair Spirit Chat Box with your existing spirit box or EVP recorder as part of your investigation.
Free and Pro
The free version includes about 1,200 words, a daily limit on spoken words, and ads. Pro removes ads, unlocks the full bank of nearly 6,000 words, and gives you unlimited text-to-speech.
Made for investigators
Spirit Chat Box grew from years of feedback on our ghost-hunting apps. We kept the tools investigators actually use and put them one tap away.
Spirit Chat Box is for entertainment. Spirit communication through technology is unproven; use your own judgment when interpreting session results.
Open a session and see what comes through.
Privacy Policy: https://weaseldev.com/privacy/spiritchat.html
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00046782:ios.name: Bird Identifier: BirdScope
bluejetty:00046782:ios.summary: BirdScope offers incredibly quick identification assistance, catering to bird watchers at all experience levels and outdoor enthusiasts alike. Using advanced AI image recognition and audio analysis technologies, it can identify over 10,000
bluejetty:00046782:ios.description:
BirdScope offers incredibly quick identification assistance, catering to bird watchers at all experience levels and outdoor enthusiasts alike. Using advanced AI image recognition and audio analysis technologies, it can identify over 10,000 bird species—by simply snapping a photo of a bird or recording its sounds.
IDENTIFY BIRDS IN A SNAP
•••Bird Photo Identification•••
BirdScope is one of the best Bird identifiers out there. Whenever you see a bird, just take a photo. It could be a little sparrow in your backyard or a big eagle in the park. The app uses smart technology to look at the bird’s shape, colors, and feathers. In no time, you’ll know what kind of bird it is—just like Merlin bird identifier does! BirdScope’s bird photo identification feature also gives you details about where the bird lives, what it eats, and more.
•••Bird Call & Sounds ID•••
Have you ever heard a strange chirp or tweet and wondered which bird made it? BirdScope’s bird call ID has got you covered. Record any Bird sounds you hear, whether it’s a loud caw or a soft whistle. The app compares the sound to thousands of others in its library. Even in a noisy place, it can quickly tell you which bird made that sound. With BirdScope’s bird sounds ID, you can identify birds by sound just as easily as by sight.
LEARN ALL ABOUT BIRDS
•••Bird Encyclopedia•••
Inside BirdScope, there’s a huge bird encyclopedia. It’s like a big book full of information about thousands of birds from all over the world. You can see beautiful pictures of each bird and read about what they look like, where they live, and how they raise their babies. Whether you’re curious about hummingbirds’ fast wings or owls’ silent flight, the bird encyclopedia has all the answers.
•••Bird Watching Guides•••
BirdScope’s bird - watching guides are great for everyone, from new bird - watchers to pros. They tell you the best times to see different birds. For example, some birds are more active in the early morning. The guides also tell you the best places to go bird - watching near you. Plus, they give tips on how to use binoculars and cameras to get a better look at the birds.
•••Fun Avian Stories•••
Learn interesting facts about birds with BirdScope’s avian stories. Did you know some birds can dance? Or that certain birds use tools to find food? These fun facts make bird - watching even more exciting.

Gay, Lesbian, Queer, BL and GL, welcome to GagaOOLala, the global leading LGBTQ+, BL and GL streaming platform from Asia with over 6 million members across 248 territories.
Register and gain access to the widest selection of gay, lesbian, queer, BL and GL content from around the world. 
FEATURES
• Explore a rapidly expanding LGBTQ+, BL and GL library of over 1600 titles featuring legally licensed, premium feature films, series, shorts, micro dramas, documentaries, animation, variety shows and exclusive GagaOOLala Originals. Fresh, new content is added to the platform every week. 
• Drama, Romance, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Thriller. Slice-of-Life, Coming of Age, Coming Out, Family, Adventure, Passion. Browse easily with specific categories, tags and playlists to find stories of interest to you.
• Available across smartphones, tablets, laptops/PCs and smart TVs. Stream anywhere and anytime you want. 
• Sitewide English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Thai and Spanish user interface.
• Subtitles available in multiple languages including English, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified), Thai, Spanish and more.
• Say no to Piracy. Support and do your part to support the LGBTQ+, BL and GL stories you love. All titles on GagaOOLala are officially authorized. Stream with Pride.
*Due to licensing restrictions, some titles might not be available to stream in certain territories.*
SUBSCRIPTION PLAN
GagaOOLala is a monthly subscription-based streaming service. Our subscribed, VIP members have full, uninterrupted access to all of the content available on the platform. 
• Register and access our Free section or pay a monthly fee and become our VIP member with complete access to the entire library of gay, BL, lesbian, GL and queer titles.
• Enjoy all our content in HD video quality. No ads on our VIP tier. Seamlessly stream across multiple devices.
• Simple, secure payment. No contracts or commitments. Cancel your subscription online at any time.
APP STORE PAYMENT
• Payments will be deducted from your App Store account on a monthly basis. VIP members can cancel their subscription anytime via their App Store account.
• Payments will be deducted from your App Store account 72 hours ahead of the subscription expiration date.
• Should you wish to cancel the subscription, please do so at least 72 hours in advance of your next renewal date and confirm if the automatic subscription renewal on the App Store is turned off. Your subscription will continue to work until the last day of the final subscription period. Once the payment has been processed, you will not be able to get a refund.
For full details, please refer to our: 
1) TERMS OF SERVICE: https://www.gagaoolala.com/en/terms-of-service 
2) PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.gagaoolala.com/en/privacy-policy 
3) FAQ: https://www.gagaoolala.com/en/faq

bluejetty:00147106:ios.description:
WE KNOW CO-PARENTING
And that is why AppClose is the most downloaded co-parenting app in the world, with more than 3.1M downloads, and has more daily and monthly active users than any other co-parenting app in the world. AppClose has been court-ordered in all 50 states, as well as Canada, UK, Australia, Ireland and New Zealand, based on user-supplied data. Every feature in AppClose exists to keep children first — SO THERE IS ONE PLAN, AND EVERYTHING IS IN IT. No tiers, no upsells, no add-ons. No limits on calling, call recording, storage or records exports. Messaging, recorded calls, calendars, notes, pets, expenses, payments and court-ready records, for one price, with 60 days free — includes all features, no payment, no commitment. Fee waivers are available for qualifying families experiencing financial hardship and for survivors of domestic violence. Discounts are available for active military and veterans. See if AppClose is right for your co-parenting needs.
Selected by Apple for its "Parenting Essentials" collection and named to Inc.'s 2024 Best in Business list for Operational Excellence. 
COMMUNICATE AND DOCUMENT YOUR COMMUNICATIONS
• One-on-one and group messages that users cannot edit or delete; time-stamped when sent and when first viewed
• Unlimited audio and video calls — no per-minute charge; your phone number and location are never shared
• With both parents' consent, calls are recorded and transcribed and kept with your records
• Co-Parent Assist™ (optional) reviews your draft before you send it, flags wording that could escalate conflict and offers a calmer rewrite. It never blocks or sends a message for you. It runs on privately managed AI infrastructure — your messages never go to third-party AI services and are never used to train AI
ORGANIZE THE SCHEDULE
• Shared calendars for parenting schedules, events and appointments
• Parenting-time tracker: planned vs. actual time
• Pick-up, drop-off and switch-day requests your co-parent approves or declines — each answer is recorded
• Calendar notes for what the family must remember
• Pet management and pet schedules — pets are in the plan too
SHARE THE COSTS
• Expenses by category, with receipts kept in the record
• Send and receive reimbursements with ipayou® (U.S.)
KEEP EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Child details: doctors, allergies, medications, immunizations, school and emergency contacts
• Secure file storage for photos, scans and files; location data is removed from uploaded photos and videos
• Private Check-Ins log your arrival and departure, visible only to you — never a tracker
• Your Circle: family, caregivers, guardians ad litem, attorneys and other professionals
COURT-READY RECORDS — EXPORT AS OFTEN AS YOU NEED
Every message, call, request, expense and payment is time-stamped and unalterable by users. Export at no extra cost:
• Unlimited Certified Records (U.S.), each with a unique Export ID that attorneys and courts can verify
• One-on-one and group messages
• Call logs
• Expense and reimbursement records
• Pick-up, drop-off and switch-day requests
• Check-ins
• Notes
• In-app session logs
If your subscription ends, your account goes read-only and your records stay exportable at no cost.
AppClose SOLO
Your co-parent doesn't use AppClose? Send requests, events and expenses by text or email.
WORK WITH YOUR PROFESSIONALS
Share chats or Certified Records with your attorney, mediator or guardian ad litem only when you approve it, through AppClose Pro — free for family law professionals.
MILITARY FAMILIES
Deployed or on limited access? Requests and updates still reach you by email.
BUILT FOR REAL-WORLD CO-PARENTING
Co-parenting, parallel parenting, joint custody, supervised visitation and blended families, on phone, tablet or computer — always in sync. Available in English, Spanish and six other languages.
Terms of Service: https://appclose.com/terms/ 
Privacy Policy: https://appclose.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00087174:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00087174:ios.description:
Learn a language by actually enjoying it – read real stories, hear native narration, and remember what you learn through games. No boring drills.
Lingo Books turns reading into the fastest, most natural way to learn English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, or Russian.
WHY READERS LOVE LINGO BOOKS
– Instant translations – tap a word or sentence for context-aware meaning while you read, with no flow broken
– Bilingual stories – see your language and the one you're learning side by side, so you're never lost
– Listen like a local – native-speaker narration with synced text to train your ear and pronunciation
– Lessons for every level – guided courses from absolute beginner to advanced
– Learn through play – crosswords, word-pairs, matching, and blitz games turn new words into long-term memory
– Your own dictionary – every word you save is sorted and ready to review
– Track your progress – streaks, daily goals, levels, and achievements keep you coming back
– Works offline – download books and translation models, learn on the plane or the subway
PERFECT FOR
Beginners who want a gentler start than flashcard apps, travelers prepping for a trip, students building vocabulary, and anyone who's tried other apps and quit. Just 10 minutes of reading a day adds up fast.
7 LANGUAGES
English – Spanish – French – German – Italian – Portuguese – Russian
Download Lingo Books free and read your first story today.
Notes:
Lingo Books includes an optional premium subscription. This is offered on a monthly or annual basis. If you choose to purchase a subscription your payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-02-22-35

Simple Roster also offers a feature that you can enter your friend's roster. With this you'll know when is the best time for you guys to hang out when you guys are having a day off together.
You can also share your roster with your friends and families so they know exactly what date you're free and what date you'll be home late.
With Full Version, you can choose to repeat your roster over a period. So if you have a repeated roster every 4 weeks, all you need to do is to keep repeating that period and you won’t need to manually enter your roster any more. There is also “Note” function that comes with Full Version as well which you can add note to any calendar date you want. Last but not least, you can sync your roster to your iOS calendar so you can even check your rosters without opening Simple Roster
